chapters.title: Chapter 351 -351-No Way Back, the Chitin Expeditionary Army
paragraphs: "Idiots."
Daniel sneered, his eyes filled with contempt.
They still wanted their treasures back now?
Did these fellows have something wrong with their brains?
He immediately summoned ninety-nine clones, filling the void densely.
Under the constant weakening of the Voidbound Grail, although this group of high-grade Divine-grade beings was powerful, they could at most be considered somewhat troublesome.
And he hated trouble the most!
"Celestial Grasp—!"

Daniel once again unleashed the greater Sacred Art. A heaven-covering giant palm descended from above. Within its palm, countless layers of world projections rotated, and every palm line contained transcendent Strength.
At the same time, the ninety-nine clones surged toward those native powerhouses like a tide.
A trace of cold indifference flashed across Daniel’s face.
"All of you—die!"
Rumble, rumble...!
The clones self-destructed in unison, and deafening explosions echoed through the void.
Under the weakening of the Holy Grail, he completely suppressed that group of powerhouses.
After just one round of self-destruction, the group of native high-grade Divine-grade powerhouses had already been blasted into utter misery.
"Again—!"
An almost frenzied battle intent burned in Daniel’s eyes.
Ninety-nine clones instantly condensed into form once more, like endless waves surging out of nothingness, charging overwhelmingly toward the powerhouses fleeing in panic.
"Run! Run now—! He’s a demon!"
"He’s insane! He wants to kill us all!"
"In the name of the Creator, go! If we don’t leave now, it’ll be too late—!"

That group of powerhouses watched helplessly as Daniel’s clones emerged endlessly like steel warriors from an assembly line. Their hearts felt as though they had swallowed an entire nest of poisonous bees—bitter and agonizing.
At this moment, how could they dare linger for even half a breath?
They only wanted to use all their strength to flee this nightmare-like void.
They knew very well that if another round of self-destruction came, they would likely all be buried here, without even bone fragments remaining.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
The powerhouses fled desperately, wishing they could tear through space and vanish instantly.
But very quickly, they discovered something.
"Not good! Space has been locked down—!"
"It’s over. We can’t escape at all! What kind of demon is this? He wants all of us dead!"
Desperate wails echoed through the void.
Daniel’s clones, however, were incomparably excited, bloodthirsty light flashing in their eyes.
Boom!
Rumble, rumble!
Deafening explosions connected into a continuous roar, like the war drums of ancient titans pounding through the void.
Firelight and energy storms swept across the entire stretch of heaven and earth, completely swallowing the figures of those seven or eight high-grade Divine-grade powerhouses.
After the explosions faded, not a single living being remained in the void.
Only drifting blood mist and shattered remains silently recounted the one-sided slaughter that had just taken place.
At the same time,
Dense system prompts rang beside Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have killed Divine-grade powerhouse Richie Ironhorn... You have obtained Origin Crystal ×12.3 million cubic units!]
[Ding! You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse...]
Daniel listened to the continuous system prompts beside his ears, feeling extremely pleased.
The treasures harvested from these powerhouses were the true bulk of the gains. The kill rewards were merely icing on the cake.
He began counting the spoils inside the Basin of Greed.
Especially after enhancement, every single item had undergone a qualitative leap.
[Ding! ... You have triggered Millionfold Boost! You have obtained Bloodstained Sacred Cloth (Primordial Grade)!]
[Ding! ... You have triggered Millionfold Boost! You have obtained Violet Star Sword (Primordial Grade)!]
[Ding! ... You have triggered Millionfold Boost! You have obtained Lorliland’s Box (Primordial Grade)!]
These secret treasures had originally only been Sacred Artisan Law Grade, but after Millionfold Boost, all of them had leapt to Primordial Grade.
They were existences on the same level as the Voidbound Grail. Every single one was priceless.
Daniel’s harvest was abundant, and his mood was incomparably pleasant.
The Chitin Universe.
This universe had almost no sense of presence among the many universes. It was located in a barren and lonely corner of the starsea.
There were three major forces in this universe, and the Chitin Royal Court was one of them.
But not long ago, a terrifying powerhouse had suddenly descended and forcefully occupied the Chitin Royal Court.
The other two major forces likewise did not dare make a sound. They were even trembling faintly, like lambs targeted by a giant dragon.
Including the Chitin Royal Court, all three major forces had once had great Oracle-grade beings above T6 attempt to communicate with their own Eternal Divine-grade ancestors.
But after those Eternal Divine-grade ancestors learned the details, they likewise did not dare utter a single word and all responded with silence.

This instantly made the three major forces become perfectly obedient. From then on, they treated the Eternal Sage known as "Synros" with extreme reverence and did not dare show even the slightest defiance.
The core of the Chitin Royal Court was a heaven-piercing mountain a million meters tall.
At the summit, a figure stood proudly, like a spear thrust into the sky.
Synros allowed the fierce cold wind to howl past, blowing his long robes and long hair.
He gazed toward the distant starry sky, his eyes as deep as an abyss, as though staring into some unknown future.
At that moment—
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Two figures appeared at the summit. Astonishingly, both were T8 Oracle-grade great Oracle-grade beings!
The two powerhouses landed in the distance, then carefully walked over. Their footsteps were as light as though they were stepping on thin ice.
The two great Oracle-grade beings stopped twenty meters behind Synros and bowed in unison.
"Your Excellency, all the Eternal Divine-grade Holy Relics you require have been prepared."
The great Oracle-grade being on the left spoke respectfully, his voice carrying a trace of exhaustion that was difficult to conceal.
During this period, he had searched the entire universe for every top-tier Holy Relic, all to gather the materials this Excellency needed to forge the legendary Eternal Sacred Artifact!
"Good."
Synros did not turn around and continued asking,
"How are the arrangements for the army to conquer the Chaosverse?"
The great Oracle-grade being on the right hurriedly bowed and replied,

"Reporting to Your Excellency, the Chitin Royal Court swears to follow you to the death and is willing to devote everything to Your Excellency. It is only the other two major forces... I truly have no ability to persuade them."
Conquering a universe usually meant attacking a neighboring universe.
Who would do something like Synros, crossing the boundless Chaos Starsea to wage war against the Chaosverse?
The Chitin Royal Court had also been forced into helplessness. Otherwise, they would never have agreed to such a mad undertaking.
"Heh—!"
Synros let out a cold laugh.
That laugh was sharp and bone-piercing, stabbing straight into the souls of the two great Oracle-grade beings.
The two great Oracle-grade beings instantly felt chills crawl up their spines, and fine cold sweat seeped across their foreheads.
This Excellency was no merciful figure!
Back when he had established his authority, he had casually crushed a great Oracle-grade being of the Chitin Royal Court to death!
That had been a supreme T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse, yet before this Excellency, he had been crushed like an ant!
Synros’s voice was not loud, yet it sounded like a sentence being passed.
"Go tell them—if they are unwilling to join the conquest, then there is no need for them to continue existing!"
"Remember, if they hesitate for more than one second, I will erase them all. Not one will be left!"

chapters.title: Chapter 352 -352-Starbeast Clone, Synros
paragraphs: Hiss—!
The two great Oracle-grade beings looked at each other, and a chill shot up their spines straight into their minds, as though an invisible icy hand had clenched their hearts.
This Excellency was far too domineering!
They had heard from their ancestors that Lord Synros was a supreme-grade powerhouse who had walked out of the Sea of Ruin.
He was simply forceful beyond reason!
However, they truly could not afford to provoke him.
"As you command, Your Excellency."
Their voices were filled with bitterness and helplessness.
Synros gave a faint "Mm."
"Send over all the Holy Relics. I need a few days to forge the secret treasure. The day that Eternal Sacred Artifact is successfully forged will be the day we march against the Chaosverse."
"Understood, Your Excellency."
Earth.
Daniel’s puppet clone suddenly sensed unusual fluctuations coming from the Chrono Temple.
He silently calculated the passage of time.
By his count, that Starbeast clone should have reached the time to break out of its shell.
Thinking of this, he raised his hand and summoned the Chrono Temple from the void.
Whoosh—!
A small palace appeared out of thin air, then expanded rapidly in the wind in the blink of an eye.
The scene was like an ancient giant beast awakening from slumber and stretching out its enormous body.
Rumble—!
The palace landed, and the entire land trembled lightly.
The puppet clone stood outside the palace and waved his hand again.
Boom—
The palace gates opened with a crash, and a vast, ancient aura rushed out.
A Starbeast egg slowly flew out from the palace, hovering in midair. Dark starlight flowed across the surface of the eggshell, making it look like a dark star on the verge of shattering.
"As expected..."
The puppet clone looked at the dense cracks covering the eggshell and determined in his heart that the moment of hatching had arrived.
At that moment, crack, crack...
A series of crisp sounds rang out.
A dark opening appeared at the top of the eggshell.
Immediately afterward, a black shadow nimbly crawled out from that opening.
That shadow was born surrounded by Law power!
The space around it twisted like the surface of water ruffled by wind, making it impossible to see its full appearance. Only a rough outline could be barely discerned.
It looked extremely similar to the innate phantom that Harris had once summoned, only many times smaller—a juvenile version.

At that moment, the black shadow swiftly devoured all the empty eggshell fragments, producing crisp crunching sounds from its mouth, as though it were chewing the most delicious delicacy in the world.
At the same time, its body began to expand at a visible speed, like a balloon being inflated.
Buzz, buzz, buzz...
The entire Earth trembled faintly, as though the whole planet were welcoming the birth of a new king!
All kinds of Law Strength mixed together like invisible streams, greedily swallowed into the black shadow’s stomach.
As time passed, the black shadow gradually transformed into a humanoid shape. Only when it grew slightly taller than the puppet clone did it finally stop growing.
At the same time, its aura continued to climb.
The puppet clone could clearly sense that the black figure before him was now exuding the aura of a legendary-grade powerhouse, and it was still rising, unstoppable.
"As expected of its reputation!"
A trace of satisfaction flashed through the puppet clone’s eyes.
"Once a Starbeast enters its juvenile stage, it possesses extraordinary strength. It truly deserves to be called the strongest race in this starsea."
The black shadow’s strength continued to rise steadily and slowly.
At a certain moment, the Laws around it suddenly dispersed, revealing its true appearance!
His features were not exactly identical to Daniel’s, but they were seventy percent similar.
His face still retained traces of starry beastfolk, such as a slightly higher nose bridge, ears that turned outward a little, and a tall forehead.
The puppet clone looked at the Starbeast clone before him and said softly,
"You and I were originally one. However, my main body is currently in another universe, and what remains here is only a puppet."
"But you are different from this puppet. You possess your own independent consciousness. Congratulations on obtaining new life. Shall I give you a name?"
The Starbeast clone’s gaze carried a trace of intimacy.
He naturally walked forward and gently sniffed the scent of Daniel coming from the puppet clone.
The puppet clone felt somewhat helpless.
A Starbeast was not human. More or less, it still retained some basic instincts of the starry beastfolk.
Rubbing against bodies and smelling scents were instincts carved into its bones.
However, what came out of the Starbeast clone’s mouth was standard Earth language.
"I have a name."
The Starbeast clone’s voice still carried a hint of childishness.
"When I received all the information from this world, I gave myself a name."
The puppet clone was slightly stunned, surprise rising in his heart.
It could even do that?
How interesting!
When a Starbeast was born, it could actually automatically receive information from the current world. It was truly gifted beyond measure.
"What is your name?"
The puppet clone asked with a smile.
The Starbeast clone grinned, revealing snow-white and sharp teeth.
"My name is Synros."
He said firmly,
"Synros."
The puppet clone blinked.
"Synros... That is an interesting name. Very well. From today onward, you shall be called Synros."
"Mm!"
Excited light flashed in Synros’s eyes.
"I am Synros!"
Astral Realm.
"Synros..."
Daniel and the puppet clone could share all perceptions. Everything the puppet clone saw and heard was also seen and heard by his main body.
After learning that the Starbeast clone had given itself such a name, he could not help but shake his head and laugh.
At the same time, he could clearly sense that a strange connection had formed in the unseen between himself and the clone named Synros.
That feeling was as though he were sensing another version of himself.
But that was normal.
Synros was a clone Daniel had condensed using countless Divine Blood and Divine Soul. Calling him another self was not wrong.
"Synros needs time to advance. That Chrono Temple can help him improve quickly."
Daniel pondered inwardly.
"As for the Holy Relics and resources he needs, those are precisely what I lack least right now!"
"These resources are enough to let him develop as quickly as possible. After all, the puppet clone’s upper limit is only demi-sage, while this Synros clone has no upper limit."
He was not worried that the clone would possess its own thoughts.
"I am Synros, and Synros is me."
"In that case, I no longer need to worry about those great Oracle-grade beings erasing me out of nowhere..."
"As long as Synros exists, I exist. If something happens to my main body, then with Synros here, I will not truly die completely."
This was also the reason why he had refined the Starbeast clone in the first place!
Daniel thought this to himself.
Then, carrying his abundant gains, he continued searching for opportunities within this newly born heaven and earth.
Before long, Daniel suddenly caught sight of a petite figure ahead.
It was Vera!
Vera also saw him at a glance.
Whoosh—!
Vera instantly held the battle blade, which was larger than her entire body, horizontally in front of herself. Dried blood still remained on the blade’s edge.
Her eyes widened roundly, like a small beast whose fur had bristled.
"You... y-you-you, don’t come over!"
"If you take one more step forward, I’ll cut you down—cut you in half! No, cut you into four pieces!"
Daniel was slightly stunned.
Was he really that frightening?
Why did Vera look as though she had seen a wicked uncle who abducted children?
Do I really look like a bad person?

chapters.title: Chapter 353 -353-The Stone Tablets, the Little Girl’s Mischief
paragraphs: The corner of Daniel’s mouth twitched, and he asked helplessly,
"Why are you here? Where is Vincent?"
In his impression, those two seemed to have been traveling together.
Hearing this, Vera’s eyes suddenly rolled.
"I’ll tell you a big secret!"
She blinked, her voice suddenly dropping low.
"As long as you let me go, I’ll tell you where that fool Vincent is!"
"There are lots and lots of treasures where he is..."
Daniel’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"Lots of treasures?"
"That’s right!"
Vera nodded repeatedly, her head bobbing like a chick pecking rice, her eyes full of sincerity.
"Fine. Explain clearly, and I’ll let you go."
Daniel smiled faintly.
Vera’s shoulders relaxed a little.
"There’s... there’s a place, and it’s really magical!"
Vera lowered her voice mysteriously, gesturing with both hands, her eyes round and wide.
"That place has eight really, really huge stones. There are all kinds of twisty, winding things drawn on them, and I couldn’t understand a single one!"
"But that fool Vincent treasured them so much. He hugged the stones and refused to let go!"
"Oh?"
A sharp light flickered in Daniel’s eyes.
"Vincent said the things on those stones are extremely wondrous, and that you can obtain very powerful treasures from them!"
Vera spoke seriously, then pouted and waved her hand with a look of indifference.
"But I couldn’t understand them, so I left. I’m not wasting my time!"
Daniel secretly considered whether Vera might be lying to him.
Although Vera looked cute and somewhat foolish, she actually had very clear awareness.
Otherwise, she would not have directly abandoned the opportunity.
She understood very well: since she could not comprehend it, that meant the opportunity was not suited for her.
It was better to go elsewhere and search for opportunities more suitable for herself.
Vera seemed to guess what Daniel was thinking. She widened her innocent eyes and said solemnly,
"I-I’m not lying to you! Really! If I lie, I’m a dog. The kind that goes woof!"
The corner of Daniel’s mouth twitched slightly.
"Fine. Then tell me where that place is first."
He spoke calmly.
Vera obediently told Daniel the location of that secret place. After she finished, she shouldered the giant blade that was bigger than she was and ran off in a flash, not even daring to look back.
The Realm Beyond the Shore.
This place seemed to exist in outer space, yet it also truly existed within the current plane, like a hidden secret realm.
Eight enormous stone tablets stood towering and majestic, each ten thousand meters tall, piercing into the clouds.
The surfaces of the tablets glowed with a hazy light and were covered in mysterious, unfathomable words and patterns.
Some were twisted runes, some were flowing Star Charts, and others looked like the outlines of ancient beings.
The eight stone tablets were located in eight different directions, like a magic array that had been laid down.
Before each stone tablet, one or two powerhouses were quietly studying.
Some flew to the top of the tablets and looked down at the patterns on their surfaces.
Some sat cross-legged at the base, eyes closed in deep thought.
Some stood there stiffly like wooden statues, their gazes hollow, as though their spirits had already been sucked away by the stone tablets.
Even with so many powerhouses gathered here, this space remained as silent as a soundless realm. Even breathing seemed to become cautious.
Only every once in a while would Law ripples slowly spread outward like waves across a lake.
Each time the ripples appeared, some powerhouses would reveal expressions of joy, then devote themselves even more fully to their research.
It was as though, in the eyes of these powerhouses, nothing existed except the stone tablets.
Even Vincent, a being from another universe, was ignored by the many native powerhouses.
They were focused only on the stone tablets before them. How could they have any attention left for anything else?

And Vincent likewise paid no attention at all to the existence of those native powerhouses, even though he knew that standing here were not merely one or two peak Divine-grade beings, but an entire group!
An entire group of peak Divine-grade beings!
Yet everyone tacitly treated the others as though they did not exist. Each of them was immersed in the mysteries of the stone tablets, fully concentrated and free of distraction.
However, everything happening in the Realm Beyond the Shore was being clearly displayed somewhere else.
It was a treasure as smooth as a mirror, and upon the mirror’s surface, everything occurring in the Realm Beyond the Shore was being reflected.
It even clearly captured a figure stepping into the Realm Beyond the Shore and slowly walking toward those stone tablets.
That figure was Daniel.
"Hmm? Is he the person you’re looking for?"
A little girl who looked about five or six raised her head, blinking her large eyes as she looked at Kelly beside her.
When she smiled, two shallow dimples appeared, and her small tiger teeth were white and bright.
Kelly smiled gently and nodded.
She stared at the figure in the mirror, with indescribable waves hidden in the depths of her eyes.
"I-I want to see if he’s strong!"
The girl blinked mischievously and flicked out her chubby little finger.
A nearly invisible ray of light silently entered the mirror.
Within the mirror’s image of the Realm Beyond the Shore, the light of the eight stone tablets suddenly dimmed the instant Daniel appeared, as though an invisible hand had covered their radiance.
The powerhouses who had been studying with great enthusiasm saw this change and could not help turning their heads one after another, their gazes landing in unison on Daniel, who had just arrived.
Dozens of peak Divine-grade gazes were like sharp blades, enough to make one’s back turn cold.
But at that very moment, the light of the eight stone tablets suddenly blazed intensely.
So bright it was dazzling, as though eight blazing suns had risen at the same time!

These stone tablets had stood here since the birth of the world. Countless beings had comprehended the mysteries upon them, learned Sacred Arts, and broken through their Ranks, yet such a strange change had never occurred before.
And now, Daniel had triggered such an astonishing disturbance the moment he arrived.
Immediately, the eyes of all the powerhouses once again fixed firmly on Daniel.
Being stared at by more than ten peak Divine-grade powerhouses would have made any ordinary powerhouse’s legs go weak.
Daniel, however, remained calm.
Whoosh—!
The light of the eight stone tablets suddenly dimmed.
In the image, those powerhouses turned their heads back one after another and continued studying the stone tablets, as though the scene just now had never happened.
The little girl’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Haha, how did he do that? So interesting!"
The little girl laughed happily, revealing a pair of small tiger teeth.
"Sister, I feel that teasing others is the most interesting thing, just like when punishing others! Hahaha!"
Kelly looked at her with a complicated gaze.
This girl was the will of this entire newborn world!
Kelly asked softly,
"Punishing... is fun?"
The little girl grinned.
"It’s fun! Those beings are so afraid of being punished that they cry and wail like the sky is falling. Actually, it’s not that terrifying—"
She pursed her lips.
"But there is one kind of tribulation that even the most determined beings may not necessarily be able to overcome."
"Which kind?"
Kelly asked curiously.
"Egoless Judgment!"
The little girl’s eyes lit up.
"Egoless Judgment is amazing! Once, there was a powerful being who wanted to achieve supreme-grade, so I arranged an Egoless Judgment for him!"
"What is that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 354 -354-Egoless Judgment, A Momentary Radiance
paragraphs: The corner of the little girl’s mouth curved upward slightly, and she began explaining while counting on her fingers.

"First, I sealed away all of his memories. Then I locked away part of his Strength as well. After that, I created a copy that was exactly identical to him. That copy possessed all his memories, all his Strength, and was even more like him than he himself was."
The more the little girl spoke, the more excited she became, her two small hands gesturing in the air.
"You see, the one who understands a person best will always be himself!"

"That copy would slowly deceive him and guide him, making that poor fellow foolishly believe that he was the reason he could not successfully pass the tribulation. In the end, he actually chose self-annihilation willingly!"
"Pfft—just like a candle blowing out its own flame! Hahaha, tell me, isn’t that the most interesting thing in the world?"
The little girl laughed until her eyes curved into crescents.
On that innocent little face hung a mischievous cruelty enough to send chills down the spine of even the bravest warrior.
She raised her head and blinked those bright, sparkling eyes, asking in a tone that seemed to be seeking praise,

"Sister, am I super amazing? Those adults all say I have a wicked sense of humor, but they don’t understand. Watching prey walk into a trap by themselves is ten thousand times more interesting than catching them with your own hands!"
After listening to this, Kelly froze where she stood.
It was as though an invisible bolt of lightning had split through the void and struck deep into her soul, exploding thunderously inside her mind.
That sound was like the whisper of fate, yet also like the tolling of a judgment bell, making her vision darken again and again.
In her once-determined eyes, only an empty confusion remained.
The Realm Beyond the Shore.
Daniel raised his hand to shield his eyes from the blinding light of the stone tablets.
He did not know why such an abnormal situation had appeared the moment he arrived here.

Especially when more than ten peak Divine-grade powerhouses stared at him at the same time, it felt like standing empty-handed under the gaze of a group of giant dragons. His whole body felt uncomfortable.
"But why are there so many peak Divine-grade powerhouses in the Astral Realm?"
Daniel could not quite understand.

Logically speaking, the strongest beings in the Astral Realm should only be at the peak of Divine-grade, and it should be extremely rare for a group of peak Divine-grade beings to gather in one place.
So why were so many gathered here?
Ridiculous!
Absolutely ridiculous!
He had already secretly prepared to flee at any moment.
But those peak Divine-grade powerhouses merely glanced at him once before their attention was once again drawn back to the stone tablets after the tablets returned to normal.
No one truly cared about him, this outsider.
"What exactly are these stone tablets?"
Daniel saw Vincent, who was painstakingly studying them.
But Vincent also treated Daniel as though he did not exist, focusing only on researching the stone tablet before him.
It was as though these stone tablets possessed a kind of MP that could make people forget everything else.
Seeing this, Daniel also developed a trace of curiosity toward the stone tablets.
He arrived before the stone tablet closest to him and looked up at its towering surface.
Boom—!
In an instant, a vast surge of information poured violently into his mind like a flood.
Daniel felt a sharp pain in his head, as though something were tearing his consciousness apart.
After the intense pain passed, however, what followed was a harvest that left him incomparably astonished!
He searched through the vast information in his mind and discovered that it was actually so clear, so incredibly easy to understand.

Even Daniel, who had always relied on the system to improve his strength and only had a vague understanding of the path of advancement, could understand it. It was as though this knowledge had been engraved into his soul from birth.
This information was the most fundamental information, the cornerstone of the path of the strong.
It described how the strong truly became strong.
Daniel involuntarily became immersed in it.
He also wanted to know how he should unleash the Strength he possessed to its utmost limit.
In the past, the opponents he encountered were either far weaker than him or far stronger than him. With the system assisting him from behind, he had never deeply explored these matters.
But now, this mysterious information allowed him to understand and allowed him to gain something!
Daniel absorbed the knowledge with the same hunger and thirst, as though nothing else in the world mattered anymore.
"What did you just... do to him?"
Kelly watched as the little girl sent specks of golden light drifting like fireflies into the mirror, then transmitted them onto Daniel.
"Hahaha..."
The little girl laughed. Her little face had gone a little pale, but her eyes had brightened.
"I gave that big brother a gift. It should be enough for him to use for a while."
Kelly sighed softly, her gaze filled with complexity.

"But you are the rule guardian, weaver, and judge of this plane. If you squander your Strength like this, one day you will be replaced by a new will. When that time comes, you will no longer exist..."
"Why don’t you walk the path that all plane wills walk?"
"Oh, Sister."
The little girl grinned and tilted her head as she asked,
"So what if I don’t walk the path I’m supposed to walk?"
"It’s just like ordinary living beings. Their elders arrange every step of their lives early on. If I refuse to walk the path that has already been paved for me, does that make me rebellious?"
"This..."
Kelly fell into thought.
"If it does, then I’ll be rebellious."
A mischievous smile rose at the corner of the little girl’s mouth.
"If the price of growing up is becoming a ’thing’ that even I don’t like, then how is that any different from dying?"
"If I become that kind of high and mighty, cold and emotionless will, then I will never be able to step out of this plane for the rest of my life..."
"Then I would never again be able to see the vastness of the Endless Starsea, never see those brilliant star rivers, those burning stars, nor the beauty and darkness deep within the starsea."

"Is possessing supreme Strength necessarily a good thing? I don’t like being bound by Strength. I yearn for freedom. I want to see the wonder of life and the magnificence of the starsea with my own eyes!"
After hearing this, Kelly suddenly smiled.
In that smile, there was relief, and also a trace of indescribable admiration.

"All living beings are guided by fate. Everything moves slowly along the trajectory of destiny, just as every person will eventually die. But people do not stop living simply because death waits at the end."
"On the contrary, it is precisely because the shadow of death looms at the end that the meaning of life becomes even clearer, and people cherish every step beneath their feet even more."
The corner of Kelly’s mouth curved slightly, and a gentle light shone in her eyes.
"Actually... I am the same. I also want to give this Endless Starsea one more choice. I want to live as the person I wish to become before the end of time arrives. So how could I not understand you?"
The little girl smiled as well, her brows and eyes curving.

"Eternity is far, far too distant. I only want that one moment of radiance. Although that light may be so brief as to be insignificant, I believe it will surely pierce through the darkness of this starry sky and allow those walking through the night to see a beam of light."
She paused, and a sly gleam flashed in her eyes.
"Sister, if that big brother really is a brave one worthy of this Strength, then I’ll give him an even greater gift."
"After all, who told Sister to care about him so much?"
Kelly’s cheeks turned slightly red, like clouds dyed by the evening glow.
She opened her mouth but said nothing. She only lowered her eyes gently.

chapters.title: Chapter 355 -355-The Mental State of a Peak Sage, Group Battle
paragraphs: The Realm Beyond the Shore.
Daniel had just finished digesting that vast amount of information and had yet to carefully savor it.
Boom!

Another torrent of information, thousands of times more violent than the previous one, came crashing down like the overturning of the entire starsea, forcefully flooding into the depths of his consciousness!
This information was even more mysterious and even more profound.
In a daze, Daniel felt as though he had transformed into the world will of this very world!
He was born with his first consciousness amid hazy chaos. Countless strands of Law power coiled around him like swimming fish, swiftly absorbed, assimilated, and fused into his being.

He personally witnessed the birth of the Astral Realm, from the first wisp of starlight condensed from Chaotic Essence, to the formation of the first continent, and then to the spreading of the web of Laws.
He witnessed the original forms of the Laws, as well as how they evolved, combined, and developed into deeper mysteries.
Everything happened naturally, as though he had been born knowing it, without even needing to learn.
And while he was lost in that state of self-forgetfulness, system prompts had already exploded countless times in succession.
[Ding... You have obtained divine energy +100 billion!]
[Ding... You have obtained divine energy +100 billion!]
[Ding... You have obtained divine energy +100 billion!]
Within that mysterious Rank, time seemed to lose all meaning.
At a certain moment, he finally finished receiving all the information and slowly opened his eyes.
At this moment, he felt that his comprehension of the world will had at least reached the level of peak Divine-grade.
This time, it was no longer an enhancement granted to him by the system, but divine energy that he had truly comprehended on his own from the information of the world will.
The difference between the two was as vast as a heavenly chasm!
In other words, even if he lost the system from this moment onward, Daniel’s own comprehension of the Path of the World had already reached the height of peak Divine-grade.
It was just that he had not yet constructed his sage rank, so his Strength had not fully matched his Rank.
Daniel let out a long breath, and his consciousness completely returned.
Now, when he looked at the towering stone tablets before him again, he saw something completely different.
"These stone tablets... are fragments of the world will Laws. Eight stone tablets, meaning eight fragments."
A smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth, filled with clarity and confidence.
"I understand now."
"When the eight fragments are combined, they become a complete Holy Relic. Perhaps I can create a greater Sacred Art from them!"
Thinking of this, he slowly stood up. His tall figure cast a sharp silhouette beneath the shadow of the stone tablet.
"Immortal Icon—!"
Boom—!

Daniel’s body rapidly expanded. His muscles and bones seemed to be infused with the Strength of stars, and in the blink of an eye, he transformed into a hundred-thousand-meter-tall giant supporting the heavens.
The stone tablets that had originally towered into the clouds suddenly seemed somewhat small in his eyes, like stone pillars before a temple compared to a giant god.
He stretched out a massive hand, his five fingers locking onto the edge of a stone tablet.
"Rise!"
Rumble—!
The entire Realm Beyond the Shore shook violently. The earth cracked, and the void trembled.
That stone tablet was pulled out from the ground, as easily as uprooting a stalk of wild grass.
Whoosh—!
"Hmm?"
"Courting death!?"
His action immediately drew furious glares from every powerhouse present.
The way those powerhouses looked at him was like they were staring at a madman desecrating something sacred.
Those stone tablets were supreme Holy Relics in their hearts, sacred objects that allowed them to comprehend Laws and break through their Ranks!
Was this otherworldly being trying to monopolize them?
Unforgivable!
In their eyes, Daniel’s actions were far too arrogant.
The Realm Beyond the Shore had always been peaceful and harmonious precisely because the eight sacred tablets suppressed it.
Those eight sacred tablets were the most important opportunity in the core plane of the Astral Realm. They were a gate open to all living beings, a shared fortune.
Almost every powerhouse who stepped into this place could obtain tremendous gains from the stone tablets.
Some comprehended a Sacred Art. Others broke through an entire Rank.
In pursuit of higher and deeper Ranks, these native beings were willing to sit here in silence and absorb nourishment.
But now...
A newly arrived otherworldly being actually dared to target the sacred tablets?
Was this not courting death?
Whoosh, whoosh—!
More than ten peak Divine-grade powerhouses surrounded Daniel like a group of enraged eagles.
They unfolded their sage ranks, and terrifying auras pressed over him like a storm covering heaven and earth.

Vincent reacted extremely quickly. Almost the instant those powerhouses surrounded Daniel, he flew to Daniel’s side and stood shoulder to shoulder with him, facing the dozen-plus peak Divine-grade powerhouses together.
"Faustus, what are you doing..."
Vincent frowned tightly and asked in confusion.
"Combining them."
Daniel’s tone was calm.
Vincent’s gaze fell on the stone tablet Daniel had pulled out.
"Combining eight stone tablets into one? That is an interesting idea."
"But with so many peak Divine-grade powerhouses eyeing you like tigers, are you not afraid at all?"
The sage ranks of more than ten peak Divine-grade powerhouses surged over like waves, making the void tremble faintly.
Daniel smiled.
"What do you think?"
Peak Divine-grade?
Heh!
"Chaotic Reincarnation—!"
"Titan Body—!"
"Immortal Icon—!"
"Voidbound Grail—!"
"Basin of Greed—!"
Daniel revealed all his trump cards at once.
The Voidbound Grail hung high in the sky, sending out rings of Law ripples that firmly sealed this stretch of heaven and earth.
The Basin of Greed hovered on the other side, like a greedy eye scanning the secret treasures of every powerhouse present.
Ninety-nine clones simultaneously activated Immortal Icon and Titan Body, transforming into ninety-nine ten-thousand-meter giants, like an army of titans walking out from legendary-grade myth!
"Kill—!"
With a great shout, Daniel led one hundred giants charging fiercely toward the dozen-plus powerhouses.
"Forget it. I’ll go mad with you this once—!"
After hesitating for a moment, Vincent summoned his Divine Domain without hesitation and joined the battle.
Vincent saw the situation clearly. Both he and Daniel were otherworldly beings, and these native residents had already been angered. It would be difficult to settle this peacefully.
Daniel’s actions had already tied him to the same war chariot.
Rather than stand aside and watch, he might as well follow Daniel into battle!
In any case, this was not his first time doing something like this.
Rumble—!
The moment those dozen-plus "peak Divine-grade" powerhouses clashed with Daniel, all illusions shattered.
It turned out that these powerhouses were not truly peak Divine-grade at all.
They were merely wearing false auras of peak Divine-grade.
Their true strength was only high-grade sage.
High-grade?
To Daniel, that was nothing more than a string of numbers.
The Voidbound Grail was like an invisible shackle, continuously weakening the Strength of those native powerhouses.
The Basin of Greed was like a starving cat, forcibly snatching away all the Divine-grade secret treasures of the native powerhouses.
It erased the old marks on them and branded them with Daniel’s mark. In the blink of an eye, those treasures changed owners and obediently fell into the basin.
Daniel’s clones and true body charged through the enemy ranks like tigers entering a flock of sheep.
"Celestial Grasp—!"
One heaven-covering giant palm after another slammed into those powerhouses.
The lighter ones were heavily injured and collapsed to the ground.
The worse ones were beaten until they were barely breathing.
Before long, the one hundred giants had killed all fourteen high-grade Divine-grade powerhouses, leaving not a single one alive.

[Ding! You have killed fourteen Divine-grade powerhouses... Detected that you have performed a selling action. Millionfold Boost triggered! In total, you have obtained Origin Crystal ×57.69 million cubic units and Primal Spirit ×12 billion points!]

chapters.title: Chapter 356 -356-True Sight, Star Dome Shattering
paragraphs: "What is going on!"
"They’re actually not peak Divine-grade!?"
Vincent put away his secret treasure and looked at Daniel with a complicated expression.
"How did you see through it?"
"Intuition."
Daniel answered honestly, his tone calm.
In truth, he had only been somewhat suspicious. Could a newborn world like the Astral Realm truly have so many peak Divine-grade powerhouses?
On the other hand, he had also wanted to gamble.
The worst possible outcome would merely have been that he was outnumbered and forced to retreat.
He had not expected that his guess would actually be right. That group of aggressively imposing fellows had been nothing more than sheep wearing tiger skins!
"However... all of this is going far too smoothly. Something isn’t right."
Daniel raised his vigilance to the extreme, taking every step with utmost caution.

He faintly felt as though he were being pushed forward by some invisible hand. Somewhere in the unseen, some existence seemed to be watching him, arranging all of this, yet no matter what he did, he could not capture the truth behind it.
The more this was the case, the more uneasy he felt, as though he were walking at night along the edge of an abyss.
"Forget it. I’ll complete this puzzle first."
Daniel carried that stone tablet and swiftly gathered the other seven stone tablets together one by one.
The instant they were brought together, the eight stone tablets actually began to fuse on their own.
The gaps between them melted away as though dissolved by invisible flames. Their radiance intertwined and coiled, like eight streams flowing into the same lake.
In the end, all the light converged, transforming into a complete black stone tablet that emitted a幽光 as it quietly hovered in the void!
Somewhere in the Realm Beyond the Shore.
Before the mirror,
The little girl and Kelly quietly watched the scene reflected within the mirror.
"This big brother really isn’t simple."
Admiration shone in the little girl’s curved eyes.
"There is an unstoppable spirit burning within him, like an arrow that has left the bowstring, never turning back and never trembling."
The little girl gently swayed her head, a smile resting on her lips.

"The peak Divine-grade auras on those beings were indeed disguises I personally wove. But looking across this place, almost no one could see through that layer of mist. This big brother is the sole exception. May the stars bless his journey."
Kelly nodded, her gaze drifting into the distance.
She remembered that first day.
Daniel had stood alone before the shattered defensive line. Behind him was a homeland on the verge of collapse. Before him were non-human race powerhouses surging forward like a tide.
He had not taken even half a step back. He had not lowered his gaze. He had not revealed the slightest trace of fear.
He had always been like that.
Never retreating.
Never yielding.
Never fearing.
Like a solitary peak, standing unmoved no matter how the storm tore at it.
"Sister, why don’t you go see him?"
The little girl tilted her head, Kelly’s reflection shining in her eyes.
"If you miss someone, then go see him. Hiding in the dark and longing for him is like wind passing through an empty valley. Aside from echoes, it leaves nothing behind."
"I will reunite with him."
Kelly’s voice was as gentle as the night breeze, yet it carried the firmness of bedrock.
"But not now."
"We are both standing beneath the shadow of tribulation. That sword called the Eternal Tribulation hangs above our heads and may fall at any moment."

"I also cannot allow myself to become a shackle on his path. That would not be love. That would be a chain. His journey belongs to the stars. I cannot tug at the hem of his clothes at a time like this."
"Tribulation?"
The little girl blinked, and a serious expression appeared on her childish face.
"So... Sister wants to block the tribulation for that big brother?"
"Yes."
Kelly smiled, and within that smile was a tenderness beyond words.
"Since fate has placed this thread in my hand, I cannot allow it to break elsewhere."
"Then, Sister... will you die?"
The little girl suddenly asked.
Kelly blinked. Light flickered in her eyes, a light that had surpassed fear and hesitation, bright and firm.
She said softly,
"Of course... I won’t!"
"There are still many things I haven’t done, many words I haven’t said. I still owe him an answer."
As she spoke, she raised her chin slightly, as though declaring war against fate itself.
The little girl did not continue asking. She only smiled quietly.
She lowered her eyes and muttered softly,
"May both of you cross that field of thorns and meet at the end of dawn."
Before the black stone tablet.
The patterns on the stone tablet were incomparably complex, as though the mysteries of the entire starry sky had been compressed into a small space.
Looking carefully, there seemed to be a certain order hidden among those intricate lines.
Like the flow of star rivers, the rising of the sun and the setting of the moon, everything possessed its own path.
Daniel and Vincent both focused their minds and looked toward the stone tablet.
Vincent suddenly let out a pained scream.
"Ah! My head hurts!!"
His head felt as though it were splitting apart, as if something were tearing through his consciousness.
He could no longer pay any attention to Daniel. Turning into a streak of light, he immediately flew away and vanished at the end of the void in the blink of an eye.
Daniel watched his departing figure, his eyes glowing faintly.
It seemed that obtaining benefits from what was engraved on the stone tablet was not that easy.
"I wonder if I can withstand it!"
He steadily landed before the stone tablet and carefully observed the mysterious patterns upon the black surface.
A moment later, he closed his eyes and began continuously calculating within his mind, like a craftsman carving an unpolished jade within his heart.
An unknown amount of time passed.
Perhaps it was only an instant.
Perhaps it was an entire day.
Suddenly, a system prompt rang beside his ears.
[Ding! You have comprehended the World Will Stone Tablet and created the greater Sacred Art Hundredfold Eye of Truth (Divine-grade)!]
[Ding... Detected that you have sold this item. Millionfold Boost triggered! You have obtained the greater Sacred Art True Sight (Divine Radiant Grade)!]
Listening to the prompt beside his ears, Daniel slowly opened his eyes.
Black light glowed within his eyes.
That black radiance was like a thin veil. Beneath its concealment, something deep within his pupils was constantly being deduced.

Laws were broken down into countless lines, like a piece of brocade being taken apart. Those lines recombined within his eyes, transforming into specific information that he received, understood, and digested one by one.
At the same time, another system prompt rang beside his ears.
[Ding! You have explored the World Will Stone Tablet and created the greater Sacred Art Star Dome Shattering (Divine-grade)!]
[Ding... Detected that you have sold this item. Millionfold Boost triggered! You have obtained the greater Sacred Art Star Dome Shattering (Divine Radiant Grade)!]
Only then did Daniel stop his comprehension and carefully examine the two greater Sacred Arts he had created.
[True Sight (Divine Radiant Grade)]
Creator: Faustus
Grade: Divine Radiant Grade
Effect: See through the veins of all Laws, deduce their flow, and evolve their transformations.
Description: What the eyes perceive is only the first step. True gain lies in comprehending it within the heart.
[Star Dome Shattering (Divine Radiant Grade)]
Creator: Faustus
Type: All-purpose Sacred Art
Grade: Divine Radiant Grade

Effect: Can be cast directly, or its might can be added to other Sacred Arts. When used alone, its destructive power is comparable to a strike from a peak Divine-grade powerhouse. When used as an enhancement, it is equivalent to the full-power strike of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse, its might like shattered stars and an overturned firmament.

Description: At the dawn of heaven and earth, chaos surged, and stars were born and extinguished within the void. The sun and moon revolved, star rivers formed their arrays, and ancient Strength awakened in every collision.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 -357-Holy Grail Advancement, Sacrificing a Supreme Treasure
paragraphs: Creating a greater Sacred Art!
In the Endless Starsea, this was a supreme-grade symbol of talent and comprehension.

Anyone capable of creating a Sacred Art would, once they broke through, step directly into the realm of peak Divine-grade. They would possess the potential of an Oracle-grade being, and their future would be limitless.
Yet Daniel had created two greater Sacred Arts in succession.
It was truly astonishing.
"Still not enough."
Daniel withdrew his thoughts, his gaze falling upon the black stone tablet before him.
The black stone tablet itself was a supreme treasure.
The state formed by the fusion of the eight stone tablets was already an excellent prototype of a Divine-grade secret treasure. In fact, even this embryo alone already contained boundless might.
This was an extremely powerful half-finished secret treasure, like a sharp sword that had yet to be quenched.
"I’ll put it away first."
He placed the black stone tablet into the Basin of Greed.
At that moment—
[Ding! Basin of Greed trait activated! One of your Divine-grade treasures has successfully advanced!]
Daniel was slightly stunned, then quickly reacted.
One of the traits of the Basin of Greed was that it had a chance of advancing one of the treasures within it by one grade.
The upper limit could not exceed the Basin of Greed’s own grade.
"If I can get another Primordial Law Grade treasure, that would be perfect."
He secretly looked forward to it and sent his mind power into the Basin of Greed, finding the treasure that had successfully advanced.
"Holy shit!"
The moment he saw that treasure, Daniel’s eyes lit up sharply.
The treasure that had advanced was none other than his old partner—
The Voidbound Grail!
This was the secret treasure that had accompanied him through the most battles.
[Voidbound Grail (Primordial Law Grade)]
Grade: Primordial Law Grade
Effects: After activation, this treasure can be used to perform three special operations: [Space-Time Seal], [Break Space-Time Restriction], and [Suppressive Seal].
[Space-Time Seal]: Can seal the current space. Its range depends on the strength of the user’s mind power.
[Break Space-Time Restriction]: Can break through current space-time lockdowns, seals, suppression states, and similar restrictions.
[Suppressive Seal]: Can suppress and absorb targets or secret treasures weaker than the user, and weaken the strength or treasures of powerhouses above the user’s Rank.

(New) [Space-Time Anchor Point]: Immune to the influence of lower-grade space-time Laws. Anchors the user within the current space-time, like a boulder in the abyss, unmoved no matter how violent the waves become.
(New) [Law Devouring]: Can devour all lower-grade Laws of the enemy, resist mid-grade Laws, and weaken high-grade Laws, like an abyss opening its massive mouth and accepting all that comes.

Note: Divine-grade secret treasures are divided into ordinary grade, Master Grade, Sacred Artisan Grade, Sacred Artisan Law Grade, Primordial Grade, Primordial Law Grade, Sacred Artisan Treasure, Primordial Supreme Treasure, and more...
After the Voidbound Grail advanced, it had actually gained two brand-new abilities in one breath!
And every single one of them could be called heaven-defying!
Daniel stared at the details of the Holy Grail, almost unable to believe his own luck.

With the special effect [Space-Time Anchor Point], from now on, he would no longer need to worry about powerful enemies proficient in space-time Laws banishing him into a chaotic torrent of time, or imposing some strange space-time state upon him.
His anchor had already been driven deep into the depths of space-time. No matter how violently the storm surged, he would remain unmoved.
As for the excellence of [Law Devouring], that went without saying.
It could make an enemy’s lower-grade Laws completely useless, fully resist the invasion of mid-grade Laws, and even forcibly cut away part of the might of high-grade Laws.
This was practically a dimensional strike on the level of Laws.
It was impossible to call it anything other than heaven-defying.
What was luck?
This was luck!
If some other secret treasure had advanced instead, its might probably would not even compare to a fraction of the Voidbound Grail’s.
"Excellent!"
A satisfied curve rose at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
The advancement of the Voidbound Grail this time was purely an unexpected surprise.
At this moment, he calmed down and began calculating what he still lacked before constructing his sage rank.
The sooner he advanced to Divine-grade, the sooner he could step into the core circle of the Endless Starsea.
In this vast starsea, only at Divine-grade could one be considered to have just touched the threshold.

It was just that Daniel was truly an anomaly. With the body of a demi-sage rank being, he could already suppress Divine-grade powerhouses. Looking across the entire starsea, such people were as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns.
And once he successfully advanced, he would directly leap to the Rank of peak Divine-grade.
Constructing his sage rank was already like an arrow on the string.
It had to be released.
"Right now, my total divine energy has already exceeded ten trillion points. That should be enough to support the construction of a supreme sage rank."
"As for Holy Relics, I have more than enough. If I use those Primordial Grade secret treasures as well, there will even be some surplus."
Daniel’s gaze burned brightly.
"It’s time."
He recalled the sage rank secret codex he had obtained after the Starlight Rankings tournament ended.
That secret codex could be called an encyclopedia of sage rank templates, containing everything one could imagine.
Back when he was still at supreme-grade, he had relied on the Divine Domain secret codex to forge a supreme Divine Domain capable of killing across Ranks.
Thinking of this, he took out the long-sealed sage rank secret codex.
[Ding! You are reading the sage rank secret codex!]
Whoosh—!
Daniel’s vision suddenly unfolded, as though he had opened a heavenly book written with stars as paper and Laws as ink.
Countless sage rank templates appeared one after another before his eyes, each with a different form, dazzling like a river of stars.
Among them was the advanced version corresponding to his Divine Domain, Chaotic Reincarnation.
However, the price required to unlock the supreme template of that reincarnation sage rank...
Truly made him draw in a cold breath!
Daniel froze in place.
"The price required to unlock a supreme sage rank template... is this high? Are you joking with me?!"
He saw it clearly.
The unlock condition was written plainly:
A [Sacred Artisan Treasure] must be sacrificed.
Buzz!
For a moment, Daniel’s mind buzzed.
"This isn’t a joke?"
He stared speechlessly at that line of words, the corner of his mouth twitching.
"Forget it. I’ll close my eyes and charge forward!"
He let out a heavy sigh.
The highest-grade secret treasures he currently possessed were only Primordial Law Grade, and there was still an entire major grade between them and Sacred Artisan Treasure.
Moreover, who would be willing to sacrifice a Sacred Artisan Treasure?
Even those lofty Oracle-grade beings probably would not be willing, right?
But...
Although secret treasures at the Sacred Artisan Treasure grade were top-tier, they were not impossible to obtain.
The treasury of the Golden Holy Mountain had Sacred Artisan Treasures listed all year round. Once one was exchanged, a new one would be listed.
"As long as I have enough points, I can exchange for a Sacred Artisan Treasure."
Daniel gritted his teeth, and a flame of all-or-nothing determination ignited in his eyes.
"First, exchange for points!"
Now, he had confidence.
His harvest from sweeping through the Astral Realm could be described as astronomical. There were almost no secret treasures below Sacred Artisan Grade.
They were all Sacred Artisan Law Grade or higher supreme treasures, and the quantity was enormous!
It should be enough to exchange for the points required to obtain a Sacred Artisan Treasure.
"Good thing I have the boost system."
A thin layer of sweat seeped across his forehead.
If not for this system, where would he have obtained so many secret treasures, many of them even top-tier?
He opened Ivahpin World and first checked the exchange price of a Sacred Artisan Treasure.
"The required points... 999.9 billion!"
Daniel could not help but draw in a cold breath.

In the Endless Starsea, this was a supreme-grade symbol of talent and comprehension.
Anyone capable of creating a Sacred Art would, once they broke through, step directly into the realm of peak Divine-grade.
They would possess the potential of an Oracle-grade being, and their future would be limitless.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 -358-Reincarnation Furnace, Immortal Will
paragraphs: After the shock passed, however, Daniel still compromised.
He took out all the Origin Crystals he had obtained, along with the Origin Crystals his puppet clone had accumulated on Earth during this period.
These Origin Crystals had all been multiplied through Millionfold Boost, reaching an astonishing total of ten billion cubic units.
He exchanged all the Origin Crystals for points in the Golden Holy Mountain, obtaining 600 billion points.
Then, he continued by exchanging all the secret treasures under his name that were below Sacred Artisan Law Grade, a total of 1,256 items, in one go. This brought him another 500 billion points.
"Enough."
Daniel let out a long breath.
He spent 999.9 billion points and finally exchanged for that Sacred Artisan Treasure.
"It’s just one Sacred Artisan Treasure."
He muttered to himself, as though trying to convince a hesitant child.
"I’ll have more and better ones in the future. But there is only one chance to construct a supreme sage rank."

"Still... to think unlocking a supreme sage rank requires consuming a Sacred Artisan Treasure. This condition is too absurd! I hope this supreme sage rank is worthy of this Sacred Artisan Treasure. I’m going all in!"
Without the slightest hesitation, he chose to sacrifice it and unlock the supreme sage rank!
Whoosh—!
Within his vision, the supreme sage rank template that had cost him 999.9 billion Golden Holy Mountain points finally unveiled its mysterious face.

He had nearly emptied everything he had. All his Origin Crystals and all his secret treasures below Sacred Artisan Law Grade had been turned into points before he had managed to gather this astronomical sum.
He personally sacrificed that supreme treasure and finally pushed open this long-sealed gate.
[Supreme Sage Rank Template · Chaotic Reincarnation]
Prerequisite: Supreme Divine Domain
Core Law: Ultimate Reincarnation Law
Note: Law grades are divided into low-grade, mid-grade, high-grade, transcendent, ultimate, infinite...
[Sage Rank Might]

[Reincarnation Furnace]: Can devour, smelt, and fuse all Law power, sage rank fragments, and even complete sage ranks of the same source and grade, thereby strengthening one’s own sage rank. This might can be advanced through sacrifice.
Note: Only power of the same source and grade can serve as fuel to ignite the flames of the furnace.

[Reincarnation Scale]: Can layer the sage rank power accumulated in every "micro-instant" of the past and future, like gathering the torrents of countless moments onto the same wave crest. This might can be advanced through sacrifice.
Current limit: One second.
The extremely fine scales of time—minute, fraction, millisecond, micro-instant, infinitesimal...
A micro-instant is a moment thousands of times shorter than the blink of a star, so brief that even fate has no time to turn its gears!

[Momentary Canticle]: Can bring back all Strength devoured within the Reincarnation Furnace from the gaps of time, and freely adjust the starting point and endpoint of the time-stacking within the Reincarnation Scale, allowing it to match the pulse of the current space-time. This might can be advanced through sacrifice.
[Holy Relics Required to Construct This Sage Rank]

Law Essence Divine energy: 9.9999 trillion points. Additional divine energy may continue to be infused to strengthen the foundation. Several Primordial Law Grade secret treasures Several Primordial Grade secret treasures Several Primordial Law Grade Holy Relics Several Primordial Grade Holy Relics
[Description]
Constructing a supreme sage rank is like a long pilgrimage. There is no need to rush it all at once. It may be completed gradually in stages.

Only one thing must be remembered: when the sage rank is finally forged, it will greedily devour a massive amount of Law power. Therefore, one must choose a newborn world like the Astral Realm, where Laws surge like a tide, in order to bring the sage rank to perfection.
[Introduction]
A supreme sage rank is the exalted king among all top-tier sage rank templates, a legend that stands above all ordinary sage ranks.
It never opens its gate to the mediocre. Only a traveler personally favored by fate is qualified to touch its radiance!
Daniel carefully finished reading every line, yet instead calmed down to an unusual degree.
Since he had already thrown in a Sacred Artisan Treasure, he could only walk this road to the end.
Even if this supreme sage rank was a bottomless pit, he would fill it shovelful by shovelful.
"Besides... this supreme sage rank looks strong. Absurdly strong."
His eyes flickered slightly.
The traits of this sage rank were on a completely different level from a Divine Domain.
It was playing with the past and future!
At the end of the Endless Starsea, everything ultimately came down to two words: space-time.
The final destination of Chaotic Reincarnation was also bound to point toward the Laws of space-time.
So there was nothing strange about this.
Once this supreme sage rank was successfully constructed, it would surely shake heaven and earth.
His heart was eager to try.
"Constructing a sage rank is far too important. I should find a place where I won’t be disturbed."
He began searching for a suitable secret place.
Daniel did not know that his every move was being watched by countless pairs of eyes from the shadows.
The Realm Beyond the Shore.
"Look. If nothing unexpected happens, Big Brother is about to start constructing his sage rank."
A trace of reluctance flashed through the little girl’s clear eyes.
"Sister, I have to leave now."
Kelly reached out, stopping her hand above the little girl’s head.
She wanted to pat her head, yet seemed afraid of disturbing something.
The little girl lightly jumped up and pressed her head against Kelly’s palm. Closing her eyes, she enjoyed this final warmth.
Kelly stroked her hair, her fingertips brushing over those soft ends, and asked softly,
"Are you planning to pour all the Strength you have accumulated for so long into him while he constructs his sage rank?"
"That’s right."
The little girl’s voice was gentle.

"A sage rank that receives the blessing of plane will power will become stronger and more perfect. I want him to stand at the highest place and look at that starsea for me, the starsea I will never be able to see with my own eyes."
"But if you do that, you will disappear."
There was an almost imperceptible tremble in Kelly’s voice.
"I will disappear, but at the same time, I will also exist forever."
There was no sorrow in the little girl’s smile, only a clarity far beyond her age.
"There are three ways for a living being to die."
"The first is when the heart dies. That is called becoming a walking corpse. Though still breathing, it is no different from being dead."
"The second is when the soul scatters completely, vanishing from the world without even ashes left behind."
"The third is being forgotten by everyone, as though one had never existed at all."
She opened her eyes and looked up at Kelly, Kelly’s face reflected within them.
"Sister, you’ll remember me, won’t you?"
"Of course."
Kelly’s voice was as firm as an oath.
"But the gift you are giving him is too precious..."
"What I mean is, why him? There are so many prodigies and so many powerhouses in the starsea. Why did you choose him?"
A depth that did not belong to her appearance flashed through the little girl’s eyes.
"I deduced countless branches of fate, and in the end, I discovered that only this big brother can carry my will!"

"This is my resistance, my charge against the will of the great universe! Why must a plane will be forever trapped in this small patch of heaven and earth? Why must a plane will, after giving birth to its own will, follow that old, unchanging path that was laid out long ago?"
"Why must I crawl at the feet of the great universe will?"
Her voice became firmer and firmer, like a hammer striking an anvil.
"I want to resist! I want to break free from my shackles! And this big brother—he can do it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 359 -359-Space-Time Confinement, Law Subversion
paragraphs: Kelly’s gaze was distant, as though it could see through layer after layer of the void.
She said softly, "Go. I might... come as well."
"You too?"
The little girl’s eyes were filled with astonishment.
"You also want to..."
"He will soon encounter a crisis."
Kelly smiled, and hidden within that smile was an indescribable resolve.
"If he cannot survive this crisis, he will be unable to break through to Divine-grade."
"And I am the only one who can help him. If he cannot succeed, then your wish will be nothing more than fishing for the moon in water."
The little girl nodded heavily.
"As expected! When you first came here, I already felt that there was some kind of connection between us in the unseen."
"I never thought our fates would be entangled this deeply!"
Kelly stroked the little girl’s head, her gaze turning toward Daniel’s location.
Beside the Time River.
Eternal Sage Kelly quietly watched the flow of the long river.
When she caught the moment Daniel was preparing to construct his sage rank, a cold smile tugged at the corner of her mouth.
"The critical moment has arrived."
Daniel constructing his sage rank was the most critical moment.
It was just unknown whose tribulation this truly was, and who would have to endure it.
The long thread of fate was finally about to be drawn tight!
Within the endless Chaos Starsea.
Several massive Primordial Supreme Treasure-grade Starships tore through the mist of the starsea and flew at extreme speed.
Synros stood at the bow of the foremost Starship, his gaze fixed upon the endless distance.
Suddenly, his brows furrowed, and a trace of solemnity flashed through his eyes.
"Is he finally about to construct his sage rank? The key node is coming."
His voice was swallowed by the winds of the starsea.
"Egoless Judgment is truly troublesome. If I had been one step later, I could only have watched helplessly in the face of this tribulation. But now... I already have a way to deal with it."
Jingle—!
A bell appeared before him.
The bell was half-transparent, like solidified morning dew. Golden radiance circled and flowed around it, emitting a pressure that made the soul tremble.
"With this Eternal Sacred Artifact in hand..."
Synros’s fingertip brushed across the surface of the bell.
"Even if I cannot completely break the deadlock, I can at least delay it for a little while. Once enough time passes, even an unsolvable deathtrap can be brought back to life."
He glanced at the bell hovering before him, his gaze burning like a torch.
"Go."
His low call was like both a command and a blessing.
The golden bell flashed slightly and vanished into the depths of space within the Endless Starsea in the blink of an eye.
At the same time,
within the Chaosverse, a bell glowing with golden light appeared.
From disappearance to reappearance, its speed was so fast that it was as though it had completely crossed the barrier of space-time, unbound by distance.
At that very moment, the bell gently swayed.
Jingle!
Jingle!!
The bell released clear, crisp sounds.
The sound was not loud, yet it seemed to pierce through space-time across the ages.
The sound transformed into countless golden runes that fell like torrential rain, scattering into every inch of the void within the Chaosverse.
Under the soaking of those runes, the Laws of the Chaosverse instantly underwent a fundamental change.
What did a change in the rules mean?
It meant an overturning at the root, at the level of the great universe will itself!
Originally, flowing river water could extinguish blazing flames.
But now, that principle was reversed.
The flames instead evaporated the river dry!
The eternal order of living beings being born, aging, falling ill, and dying could be completely overturned. Death could come before illness, illness before aging, and aging before birth.
The sky overturned, and the earth flipped upside down.
The very foundation of the entire universe trembled beneath the chime of that bell!
The Chaosverse welcomed an indescribable upheaval!
Synros’s Eternal Sacred Artifact bell crossed space-time and descended upon the Chaosverse.
As it jingled, the bell sound transformed into runes and sank into the void, immediately altering the Laws of the great universe will of the Chaosverse beyond recognition.
In truth, the instant the bell rang for the first time, the first ones to sense the change were those lofty great Oracle-grade beings.

They were constantly comprehending the pulse of the Laws of the great universe will, and changes to the Laws affected them the most deeply, like fish in water suddenly discovering that the sea had turned into wine.
Almost at the same instant, the great Oracle-grade beings of the Chaosverse turned deathly pale.
The Chaos Humans.
A Forefather who had meditated for millions of years burst out through the doors.
At this moment, his hair was disheveled, and he stood atop a mountain peak with a lost expression.
"How is this possible... The Laws of the great universe will of the Chaosverse have suddenly been changed. All living beings no longer have any path of advancement!"
His voice was hoarse and trembling, like a candle flickering in the wind.
"A mighty power from beyond the universe has completely blocked the path of advancement!"
"The terrifying part of this Strength is that it affects living beings of every single Rank, from the humblest apprentice to the lofty Oracle-grade. No one can escape it."
"To be able to alter the foundation of the universe will of an entire universe... This must be the work of an Eternal Sage!"
Thinking of this, the human Forefather trembled all over, his eyes filled with shock.
"Could it be that an Eternal Sage... wants to target the Chaosverse!?"
The Order Faction.
The three strongest T9 Oracle-grade beings gathered urgently, their expressions grave.
"The Laws have been tampered with. The shackles of Rank have already descended."
The first Oracle-grade said in a deep voice, his voice echoing as though from an abyss.
"Right now, all living beings in the Chaosverse can no longer take even half a step forward or break through their current Rank."
"And this is still far from the worst of it."
The second Oracle-grade took over with deep worry, his brows locked tightly.

"Measured by galaxies, the entire space-time has also been nailed in place. This means that even we T9 Oracle-grade beings cannot step even half a step beyond the borders of our respective starfields! We are like birds trapped in cages, able to see the sky but forever unable to touch it."
The entire Chaosverse had undergone a heaven-shaking transformation under the clear chime of that bell.
The third T9 Oracle-grade sighed repeatedly, his eyes filled with exhaustion and despair.

"There is another point—the energy of the Chaosverse has also been locked down. Energy has solidified like a frozen river. Even the most basic portal can no longer function, let alone advancement. Everyone can imagine what kind of profound disaster this will become!"
The Chaosverse had been bound tightly by three invisible chains.
The first layer: Rank Lockdown!
All paths of advancement had been completely severed, like an eagle with its wings cut off.
The second layer: Space-Time Lockdown!
The current space-time had been firmly anchored. No one could step even half a step beyond the starfield they were in, like prisoners trapped on lonely islands.
The third layer: Energy Lockdown!
The universe’s energy had solidified. Even the most basic advancement could no longer be carried out, like a river that had run dry.
Under these three layers of lockdown, the Chaosverse was like a giant beast bound by countless chains, struggling in vain yet unable to move.
The truth that the universe’s Laws had been tampered with would inevitably spread to every corner like wildfire.
A catastrophe sweeping across the entire universe was coming, and no one would be spared.
"Our most urgent task right now—"
The Oracle-grade of the Order Faction had solemnity filling his eyes.

"—is to find the manipulator hidden in the shadows. But only a sage who has stepped into the realm of eternity is qualified to tamper with the Laws of the universe will and play everything in the palm of their hand!"
Another Oracle-grade drew in a deep breath and added,
"An existence of that level can make stars shift with a single thought. Even if we find traces of that Eternal Sage, how much confidence do we have in making them show mercy?"
"Or perhaps we can still beg another existence of the same level to descend. Otherwise, the entire Chaosverse will become a prison!"
