chapters.title: Chapter 360 -360-An Existence Even Eternal Forefathers Dare Not Provoke
paragraphs: Eternal Sage.
A supreme-grade existence that stood above T9 Oracle-grade.

They could freely shuttle through various nodes of the Time River, even leap beyond the long river itself and stand above the passage of time. They could also open up an entirely new universe through their own power.
To them, tampering with the constant Laws of a universe was nothing more than an ordinary method.
Usually, once an existence stepped into the realm of eternity, they would not linger in the Endless Starsea for long.
They would set out for the deepest reaches of the Chaos Starsea.
According to legend, there was a broader and more mysterious world there, a place only Eternal Sages were qualified to enter.
Only extremely fortunate T9 Oracle-grade beings who obtained great opportunities would have the chance to glimpse its true appearance.
Generally speaking, Eternal Sages would not spend long years in the Endless Starsea unless there was some matter of utmost importance that required them to handle it personally.

However, they also would not completely cut off their connection with the Endless Starsea. More or less, they would leave behind certain methods of contact, and such means were usually reserved for the forces of their respective homelands.
Yet the Chaosverse was a newborn universe.
Aside from native races, most members of the Order Faction were major races that had migrated here from other universes.
If those major races had Eternal Sages backing them, why would they have needed to migrate their entire race?
Thinking of this, the Oracle-grade beings of the Order Faction looked at one another.
For a moment, they actually could not find any way to contact an Eternal Sage.
"We cannot find one, but those old fellows on the Chaos Faction’s side may very well have a way to find an Eternal Sage."
One T9 Oracle-grade spoke.
"Whether we need to contact the manipulator behind the scenes or seek help from another Eternal Sage, this is still a path."
"That existence behind the scenes has already broken the rules. Presumably, other Eternal Sages will step in... to restore order."
The Chaosverse, Chaos Faction.
Several T9 Oracle-grade beings gathered together, their expressions as ugly as if they had swallowed flies alive.
The Laws of the Chaosverse had been sealed by three layers of lockdown.
This was practically an apocalyptic disaster.
Clearly, an Eternal Sage intended to make a move against the Chaosverse.

"We are devouring the Chaosverse by order of our Eternal Forefathers. Now that another Eternal Sage has interfered, we only need to report this matter upward. Perhaps this deathtrap can be easily broken."
One T9 Oracle-grade spoke in a resentful tone.

"That supreme-grade existence behind the scenes is far too tyrannical! If they wanted to fight for this territory, they should have at least sent a word first. To strike without any warning like this is simply disgusting—as though they regard us as ants, unworthy even of being informed!"
"You’re finished."
Another T9 Oracle-grade lowered his voice to an extreme degree.
"You mentioned something you should not have mentioned."
He did not dare to say it more clearly. He only swept the corner of his eye across the void, as though there was an eye there coldly watching them.
The furious Oracle-grade immediately turned as pale as paper. Cold sweat dripped from his temples onto his clothes.
It was over!
He had lost control of his tongue in a moment of anger!
Even if the outline of such an existence merely flashed through one’s mind, the other party would instantly perceive everything.
It was like raising a torch before a clear mirror.
There was nowhere to hide.
"Pfft—!"
Suddenly, that T9 Oracle-grade spat out blood.
His expression instantly wilted, as though his spine had been pulled out.
The other two T9 Oracle-grade beings looked at each other in horror, their pupils filled with fear.
As expected, that existence had noticed him!
There was no need to descend.
No need for words.
Just a single thought was enough to make a T9 Oracle-grade suffer as if struck by lightning.
The Oracle-grade who had spat blood wore a miserable expression, weak like a candle flickering in the wind.
"Your Excellency... please forgive me."
"I was reckless with my words. I was foolish and ignorant!"
The other two great Oracle-grade beings tacitly even slowed their breathing on purpose.
It was as though the entire universe had become that existence’s ear, and any trace of noise might invite catastrophe.
Fortunately, that terrifying Strength did not continue descending.
"Good thing I have a supreme treasure protecting me. Otherwise, I would have definitely suffered severe damage."
The injured Oracle-grade’s eyes were filled with lingering fear, and he let out a long breath.
"That existence shattered my Origin with will alone. If this ancestral treasure had not blocked most of the might for me, I might already have become crippled by now."
The T9 Oracle-grade beings looked at one another.
They themselves possessed similar abilities.
Whenever a living being called their name or had thoughts related to them, they could sense it along that thread of causality.
They could even rely on that sensation alone to erase that living being from afar!
This was the terror of a great Oracle-grade being, like every tremor on a spider’s sensing web.
And when the prey faced an Eternal Sage, every strand of that web was soaked in deadly poison!
"In the current situation, we should go find our Forefathers first and see what they decide."
One Oracle-grade said in a low voice, his gaze filled with caution.
"Agreed. Contact the Forefathers first."
The other two spoke with a humility that was almost pleading.
The powerhouses of the Chaos Faction were all great forces that had invaded from other universes to seize territory.
Behind them, there were even shadows of Eternal Sages. This was also the confidence that allowed them to dare launch expeditions into foreign universes.
They were like a group of young beasts relying on the giant dragons behind them, and only because of that did they dare run rampant in an unfamiliar jungle.
Soon, the three T9 Oracle-grade beings each contacted the Forefathers of their own races.
However, not long after, their expressions became even uglier!
"What attitude did your Forefathers have?"
An Oracle-grade asked, his voice tight.
"My Forefather said... even he cannot afford to provoke that existence. He told us to handle it ourselves."
The injured Oracle-grade’s expression was numb.
"What about your side?"
"My clan’s Forefather only said one word."
"What word?"
"Scram!"
The several Oracle-grade beings were completely dumbfounded. They stood frozen in place, like puppets whose souls had been pulled out.
"Sigh—"
The last Oracle-grade let out a long sigh.
"My clan’s Forefather had roughly the same attitude. He told us to handle it ourselves. Even he does not dare provoke that existence!"
Hiss—!
The three T9 Oracle-grade beings stared at one another.
Who exactly was it?
Who possessed such terrifying authority?
Terrifying enough that three Eternal Sages changed color upon hearing of them, almost to the point of urgently wanting to cut ties with them.
This...
The more one thought about it, the more terrifying it became.
"What kind of terrifying existence is this? And what does our Chaosverse even have that is worth such an existence making a move?"
The great Oracle-grade beings looked dispirited, as though they had already seen the end of the world descend.
The Astral Realm.
Daniel found a relatively safe place.
"This place is not bad. It is suitable for constructing my sage rank."
"Right now, I have enough Holy Relics and divine energy. Constructing a sage rank will also take quite some time."
He opened the sage rank template, intending to devote himself entirely to it.
In the void, a gray lotus slowly appeared and gently drifted into the supreme sage rank template.
This was that Law Essence!
It was a top-tier Holy Relic most compatible with the sage rank template, as though the two had originally been born from the same root and had only been waiting for this reunion.
Very soon, the Gray Lotus sank into it.
Faint gray light rippled outward like water, gently enveloping the entire sage rank.
That sage rank was like a quiet pond.
The seed of the lotus had already been buried deep within it and was silently growing.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 -361-Advancement Failure, Thorns Blocking the Path
paragraphs: Time flowed like water.
Ten years passed in the blink of an eye.
Those seeds finally broke through the soil, unfurling their petals and transforming into countless blooming Gray Lotuses. Layer upon layer, they covered the entire void.
"With the Law Essence as the foundation, and Divine-grade secret treasures as the main framework."
Daniel methodically placed ninety percent of his Primordial Grade secret treasures into the supreme sage rank template.
The blood-colored sacred cloth, the ancient treasure box, the burning sacred lamp, the warm jade treasure...
One by one, they were thrown into the supreme sage rank template.

Every one of these secret treasures was a Primordial Grade or Primordial Law Grade Sacred Artifact. If placed in the outside world, any one of them would be enough to drive Divine-grade powerhouses mad.
Yet at this moment, they were rapidly decomposed by the sage rank template, turning into trickling streams that filled the bones and veins of the sage rank bit by bit.
Another ten years quietly passed.
As expected, under Daniel’s reckless investment regardless of cost, the foundation of the supreme sage rank template was constructed as solid as bedrock.
An ordinary demi-sage might have stopped at this point, advancing to Divine-grade first before slowly searching for opportunities to enhance it later.
After all, once one’s strength increased, the chance of obtaining top-tier Holy Relics would also become greater.
But Daniel was not satisfied with this.
What he wanted was a true supreme sage rank.
And he had the ability, as well as the confidence, to seize even more top-tier Holy Relics.
"Continue."
With a wave of Daniel’s hand, countless gemstones, sacred medicines, sacred fruits, sacred trees...
One top-tier Holy Relic after another fell into the sage rank, transforming into the purest nourishment and silently strengthening his sage rank.
The third decade passed without a sound...
Rumble—!
A thunderous roar exploded like lightning!
Energy surged within Daniel’s sage rank like a tide, and its range expanded outward at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In the blink of an eye, the territory of the sage rank had expanded fivefold from nothing!
"Continue!"
Without the slightest hesitation, he invested divine energy.
[Ding! You have consumed divine energy ×10 trillion points!]
Rumble—!
The sage rank expanded once more, increasing by another fivefold!
Daniel’s sage rank was completely different from that of other sages.
The sage ranks ordinary sages were so proud of were more than half smaller compared to his!
Whether in range or intensity, his sage rank was several times stronger than those of other powerhouses!
"Now that’s more like it."
Daniel stared at his sage rank, extremely satisfied.
His sage rank was guided by that Gray Lotus. It was only missing the final step of merging with his supreme Divine Domain, and then his advancement would be complete.
He would step into the palace of peak Divine-grade in one leap.
Thinking of this, he immediately unfolded his Divine Domain—
Chaotic Reincarnation.
Whoosh—!
A pair of black-and-white eyes opened like an ancient god awakening from the abyss, attempting to merge with the sage rank template.
But at that very instant, the moment the Divine Domain came into contact with the sage rank, it could no longer continue.
It was as though an invisible barrier stood between them, stubbornly blocking their fusion.
It was strange beyond words.
"How could this be?"
Daniel was deeply shocked.
"If the Divine Domain cannot merge with the sage rank template, the sage rank can only remain inside the template. I won’t be able to advance—I’ll be trapped at demi-sage Rank forever!"
His heart shook violently.
How could this be?
Wasn’t constructing the sage rank supposed to be the most difficult part of advancing to Divine-grade?
The fusion of the Divine Domain and sage rank should have been the simplest step.
Why had he crossed the most difficult part, only to fall at the easiest stage?
What kind of absurd logic was this?
Daniel was stunned.
"I... can’t advance?"
The outer regions of the Astral Realm.
At this time, most of the stronger demi-sages had already gathered enough Holy Relics. It was the perfect opportunity to construct their sage ranks.
The era when the Astral Realm opened was, in itself, an era when peak Divine-grade powerhouses were born in batches.
With enough top-tier Holy Relics, many powerhouses chose to advance here and now.
Dustin’s sage rank template had already unfolded.
He was the strongest demi-sage among the Chaos Humans of the current generation. All the resources he possessed were top-tier, and his sage rank template was also among the best of the best.
At this moment, he was continuously filling the framework of his sage rank with resources.
"My Divine Domain is already one of the top-tier Divine Domains in this starsea. Constructing a top-tier sage rank is nothing more than lifting a hand for me."
Dustin thought silently, his gaze carrying a calm confidence.
"Moreover, I have already created my own Sacred Art. This means that once I cross that threshold, I will be able to directly step into the ranks of peak Divine-grade."

"Peak Divine-grade... In the Endless Starsea, the resources one can obtain will increase severalfold. The ancient ruins deep within the starsea, the treasure lands left behind at the dawn of the universe, and even dangerous zones that Oracle-grade beings fear all require the Rank of peak Divine-grade to enter."
"And advancing within a newborn world like the Astral Realm also has immeasurable benefits for stabilizing the foundation of my sage rank."
He was completely confident about advancing to peak Divine-grade.
After all, he was someone who had created his own Sacred Art.
That talent alone was enough to make countless demi-sage rank beings look up to him.
"After I ascend to peak Divine-grade, I will continue polishing my sage rank until it reaches perfection, stepping into the realm of Divine Descendant."
"I am not like certain impatient fools who knock on the gate of tribulation the moment they enter peak Divine-grade."
A smile appeared at the corner of Dustin’s mouth, carrying both confidence and a trace of disdain toward the mediocre.
The powerhouses of the Endless Starsea began walking entirely different paths starting from Divine-grade.
Some peak Divine-grade powerhouses chose to immediately become Oracle-grade...
This was the path taken by the greatest number of powerhouses, like a broad and crowded road.

Meanwhile, other Divine-grade powerhouses would continue pushing their sage ranks toward perfection after reaching peak Divine-grade. Only after arriving at the legendary realm of Divine Descendant would they attempt to cross the tribulation.
The conventional path allowed one to advance to Oracle-grade the fastest, but its foundation was like a tower built on sand, unable to endure storms.
Just the nine tribulations that Oracle-grade beings had to face were enough to make those who walked that path risk being reduced to ashes at any moment.

As for the path of Divine Radiant, Divine Sovereign, Divine Lord, and Divine Descendant, although it would not allow one to immediately become Oracle-grade, its advantage lay in a foundation as solid as bedrock. It allowed one to deal with the first three tribulations with extreme ease, while also possessing the strength to confront low-tier Oracle-grade beings head-on!
Dustin naturally wanted to choose that more difficult yet far more glorious path of thorns.
"The seniors of the Chaos Humans have all done their utmost to move along this thorny road. As the hope of the Chaos Humans, how can I be an exception?"
Very soon, he finished filling the top-tier sage rank template.
The template before him was like a precise Star Chart, every inch flashing with the radiance of Laws.
"The next step is the fusion of my Divine Domain and sage rank."
He took a deep breath and slowly unfolded his Divine Domain, allowing the light of the Divine Domain to gently blend with the sage rank template.
According to common sense, as long as he reached this step, there should be no further obstacles.
He would naturally advance straight to Divine-grade.
However, Dustin’s Divine Domain could not merge with his sage rank no matter what!
"What is going on?!"
It was as though an invisible ice spike had pierced his heart.
"No... impossible!"
A chill surged straight to the top of his head.
He hurriedly used a special communication channel to send word of this strange incident back to the Chaos Humans.
Very soon, he learned of the earth-shaking upheaval in the Chaosverse.
The entire Chaosverse had been locked down by a Strength from a higher dimension!
Three layers of shackles.
Three layers of despair.
No breakthroughs.
No crossing galaxies.
No absorbing any energy from heaven and earth!

chapters.title: Chapter 362 -362-Chessboard and Pawns, Life-and-Death Crisis
paragraphs: Dustin took a long time before he barely managed to accept this suffocatingly cruel reality.
For those demi-sage rank beings who were just about to become Divine-grade powerhouses, this blow was simply too great!
"In the name of the gods... I was clearly only a little away. Just one step away from becoming a sage..."
His voice was filled with bitterness.
"Why did this disaster have to descend at this exact moment?"
He forced himself to gather his collapsing emotions.
"I must tell Faustus about this immediately and have him prepare... A storm is coming, and no one can stay out of it."
Within the Astral Realm.
Many demi-sages were preparing to advance to Divine-grade, only to suddenly discover that their Rank had been firmly locked by an invisible barrier.
It was as though a mysterious layer of energy had appeared before them, separating them from the hall of Divine-grade.
One after another, they reported their encounters to the forces behind them, and at almost the same time, they all learned that chilling piece of news:
The Chaosverse had already become the chessboard of an Eternal Sage!
The chess player had begun placing pieces, and every living being standing upon the board had now entered the game.
Unless another Eternal Sage interfered, they could only leave their fate to the heavens.
Deep within the Astral Realm.
Daniel flew out from the core plane with a grave expression.
"I just received a message from Dustin. He said there is something we need to discuss."
His brows furrowed slightly.
"It’s most likely related to advancement."
He had noticed that he was not the only one preparing to advance. Many demi-sages had already polished their sage ranks to completion and were only missing the final step.
For Dustin to gather everyone so urgently, it had to be because of this strange matter.
At that moment, the Ivahpin Scroll in Daniel’s arms suddenly grew slightly hot.
He hurriedly sent in his mind power and entered that world between reality and illusion, where he received the urgent message left for him by Chanelle, the Oracle-grade of the Golden Holy Mountain.
"...What? The Chaosverse has been locked down by an Eternal Sage?"
His pupils suddenly contracted.
He had spent a full thirty years and poured in countless resources to construct his sage rank, only for this sudden move by an Eternal Sage to make him unable to advance his Rank at all?
This was truly terrible!
"Lord Chanelle of the Golden Holy Mountain left too little information. But the Myriad-Star Cosmos is not the universe directly involved, so it is understandable that they know only so much."
"However, the forces within the Chaosverse should have much more information."
Following the agreement, he arrived at the gathering point.
Daniel swept his gaze across the area.
Everyone was present.
"My lord."
Camille bowed in greeting.
"Boss Faustus."
James and Mosi looked somewhat solemn.
"Lord Faustus, you’ve finally arrived."
Dustin’s expression was solemn, his gaze steady.
"Everyone is here. We can begin."
Daniel nodded and sat down in the center.
Dustin was the first to speak.
"The upper ranks of the Order Faction have already thoroughly investigated the situation."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
As expected, the local forces of the Chaosverse still had a natural advantage!
Everyone’s gaze fell on Dustin at once.
"Right now, the Chaosverse is firmly confined by three layers of shackles."
Dustin said, "The first layer: no advancement. No living being can cross the threshold of their current Rank!"
"The second layer: no crossing. We are trapped in our respective galaxies and can no longer return home!"
"The third layer: no energy absorption. This means that every bit of Strength within our bodies is being consumed. Use a little, and you lose a little."
Hiss—!
The powerhouses felt as though a basin of ice water had been poured over their heads.
The situation was far more serious than they had imagined.
Unable to advance meant that all demi-sages would forever be trapped at demi-sage rank, like birds imprisoned in cages.
Unable to cross galaxies meant they could not return. Their homelands were now unreachable.
Unable to absorb energy meant that every spell cast and every battle fought from this moment onward would burn away their own foundation.
Aside from Daniel, deep despair surged in everyone’s heart.
"The existence behind this upheaval is an Eternal Sage."
Dustin continued explaining, "An Eternal Sage has descended into the current space-time and is carrying out a major scheme."
Eternal Sage!
Above Oracle-grade was Eternal Sage, an existence that could walk through the Time River and dance upon the threads of fate!
Daniel could not help but recall the supreme-grade existence he had summoned during the battle against World Zone No. 1213.
Although that existence had never shown himself, he had personally said that he was an Eternal Sage!
He had also said that if Daniel wanted to meet him, he would need to unseal the Chronoverse Prologue Codex!
Perhaps there would still be a chance to meet him then.
But now, if Daniel could not break through to Divine-grade, he would be unable to obtain the final mission reward.
And that reward was precisely the final two elemental cores of Thunder and Metal, the last keys needed to unseal that codex.
At this moment, the situation had fallen into an absurd deadlock.
It was like a dragon-slaying warrior who needed to slay a dragon in order to obtain dragonscale armor, but without the dragonscale armor, he could not slay the dragon.
This was the current deathtrap!
"According to legend, Eternal Sages can freely travel between the past and future, leap beyond the Time River, and even create a universe out of nothing."
James’s tone was filled with helplessness.
"If such an existence personally designs a scheme against the Chaosverse, then before He achieves His goal, we may only be able to wait."
"That’s right."
Dustin also lowered his shoulders in dejection.
"My Chaos Humans only managed to establish ourselves in the Chaosverse by relying on a T8 Oracle-grade Forefather, barely stepping into the ranks of quasi-first-rate forces in the Endless Starsea."
"And an Eternal Sage can swiftly cultivate the most powerful and massive forces. To such an existence, destroying a universe is no more than raising a hand."
"Destroying the universe should not go that far."
Camille shook her head.
"There are too many living beings in the Chaosverse. Destroying the universe would draw an unimaginably enormous amount of karma. An Eternal Sage should not go that far."

"But we will still be affected by this storm. It will be an influence powerful enough to change the future. When an existence like that lightly places a chess piece, for insignificant beings like us, it becomes a mountain we cannot move."
Everyone voiced their own opinions, yet Daniel alone did not speak.
As if by tacit understanding, everyone turned their gazes toward him.
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth. His voice was not loud, but it was exceptionally clear.
"For now, ignore our current predicament."
"The galaxies have already been sealed off. The Astral Realm can be considered an independent galaxy, which means we cannot leave the Astral Realm."
"And at this moment, the Astral Realm has gathered a group of the most elite powerhouses in the entire Endless Starsea. Among them are demi-sage ranks, sages, and even Oracle-grade beings."
His eyes flashed as he analyzed the situation piece by piece.
"Below Oracle-grade, we have nothing to fear. But if some Oracle-grade beings go mad and start slaughtering at will, how should we deal with them?"
"What does Boss Faustus mean?"
James looked at him in confusion.
"We must ensure our own safety."
Daniel looked around at everyone.
"Do you not think our current situation is extremely dangerous?"

chapters.title: Chapter 363 -363-The Madly Plundering Player Army
paragraphs: Hmm!?
The powerhouses frowned tightly.
"The entire Chaosverse has been locked down, and everyone is panicking. This can very easily shatter a powerhouse’s Mental State!"
"Who can guarantee that there isn’t, or won’t be in the future, an Oracle-grade being in the Astral Realm who goes mad and starts a massacre?"
No one could guarantee that.
"So,"
the light in Daniel’s eyes grew brighter and brighter,
"we must first prepare an escape route. If things remain calm and there isn’t much slaughter, that would naturally be best."

"But if an Oracle-grade truly goes mad, we’ll hide in the depths of the planes within the Astral Realm. With the suppression of the Astral Realm’s own rules, those Oracle-grade beings won’t be able to enter before the time limit arrives. No matter what, staying alive is the most important thing."
After hearing this, James nodded.
"Excellent, Boss. I didn’t expect you to understand the path of survival so deeply too!"
"Lord Faustus is absolutely right."
Dustin agreed.
"The Chaosverse will definitely fall into great chaos. Avoiding danger is never wrong."
"Sigh!"
James deliberately spoke in a relaxed tone.
"It’s not that big of a deal! Isn’t it just that we temporarily can’t advance?"
"That Eternal Sage can’t possibly keep the Chaosverse locked for hundreds, thousands, or even millions of years, right?"
"As long as we endure it, won’t we be able to advance as usual by then?"
Aside from Daniel, the other powerhouses could only reveal bitter smiles when they heard this.
Millions of years?
That would already be another era.
There were countless universes standing throughout the Endless Starsea. Who would stop and wait for their batch of demi-sage ranks?
The demi-sages of the Chaosverse could not advance, but the powerhouses of other universes had no such restriction.
"No matter what, I have to try."
Daniel’s gaze burned like a torch.
He did not believe he would be trapped here to death.
So what if it was the method of an Eternal Sage?
Let alone an Eternal Sage, so what if fate itself or the universe will descended!?
"If my final fate is to bow my head... then I’ll cut off that head and resist to the very end."
His voice was like a hammer striking an anvil.
"External changes are beyond my control, but I am ruled by myself!"
Daniel’s true body was trapped in the Chaosverse, unable to move an inch.
But he still had a puppet clone.
Under the meticulous arrangements of Daniel’s puppet clone, the army formed by players and NPCs spread through the starsea like a pack of wolves, madly occupying one small world after another.
This frenzied action continued for a full ten years.
Tens of thousands of small worlds were conquered by the legions under Daniel’s command, occupying nearly ninety-nine percent of the entire Visca Galaxy!
The Oracle World.
"Kill—!"
Hans had now also advanced to demi-sage.
Behind him was an army formed by countless players, a vast black mass like a tide pouring over a dam.
Tens of millions of players slaughtered the living beings of the Oracle World plane in madness.
"Why are you people invading our world for no reason?!"
A peak demi-sage rank powerhouse had eyes as red as blood.
"Kill!"
Hans was too lazy to answer. He led the many players and cut down that demi-sage together with all his followers.
A long while later, Hans stood amid corpses scattered across the ground and said coldly,
"Guild Master Faustus needs us. Even if we have to make enemies of the entire Endless Starsea, we absolutely cannot retreat."
"Exactly. Along the way, the Guild Master has given far too much for us."
"Now, it is time for us to contribute a little Strength to him."
In other planes,
top player powerhouses such as Son of the Firmament, Crimson Soul, and Sunborn each led vast armies, madly occupying one small world after another.
Every time they conquered a place, they would seize all gains by force, then hand them over to Faustus’s puppet clone.
"Guild Master Faustus is currently trapped in the Chaosverse and desperately needs resources."
A player wiped the blood from his forehead and spoke in a low voice.
"What we can do may not be much."
Another tied up a storage pouch, his gaze firm.
"But we still have to do our part and earn more resources for the Guild Master. Even if it is only one piece of ore or one stalk of spirit grass, it is still our sincerity."
Everything that had happened in the Chaosverse spread through the Endless Starfield like wildfire.
Such an earth-shaking event had not appeared for countless eras.
After savage and frantic dissemination, almost everyone knew of it.
Faustus was facing the critical point of advancement within the Chaosverse.
But now, he had been trapped by a Strength from a higher dimension and could not take that final step.
The players all knew about this as well.
There was only one thought in their hearts:
Faustus had treated them well!
Now that the Guild Master needed resources, they would go all out and deliver everything they could plunder into his hands.
Even if they had to cross mountains of blades and seas of fire, they would not hesitate.
Moreover, Daniel’s puppet clone was absolutely not someone just anyone could underestimate.

Although the puppet clone’s Rank limit had been locked and it could not step into Divine-grade, its combat power was no different from the true body’s. It was still so powerful that it chilled the heart.
It could still tear apart any prey that dared approach Earth!
Golden Holy Mountain headquarters.
Chanelle was summoned by the T8 Oracle-grade Noxis.
Bang—!
Noxis slammed his palm heavily onto the table before him, shaking the scrolls on the tabletop until they rustled.
Those scrolls were letters sent by various forces, piled up like a small mountain.
Chanelle glanced at the pile of scrolls and already understood most of the situation.
"Chanelle."
Noxis’s brows were like two iron chains twisted together.
"You should control that madman Faustus! What exactly is he doing?"
"The small worlds of the Visca Galaxy are almost all being ruined by him alone!"
Noxis’s voice was like rolling thunder.
"If he were only occupying territory, even if I had objections, I would not say much!"
"But look at him. He has emptied all the resources of every small world. He is practically one step away from scraping three layers off the ground itself!"
"What is he doing? This is simply like a swarm of locusts passing through, leaving not a blade of grass behind!"

"In Stellar’s name, he has crushed the ecological balance of those worlds to pieces! In the future, how many eras and how much cost will it take to restore them to their original state? Have you calculated that heavy debt for him?"
Noxis’s voice was icy.
"Furthermore, Faustus has ignored our Golden Holy Mountain’s inquiry letters. How do you explain that? In his eyes, is the dignity of the Golden Holy Mountain not worth mentioning?"
The more he spoke, the angrier he became, his knuckles cracking as he clenched them.

"If not for your sake, I would absolutely demote him—demote him until he would not even be worthy of a nominal member’s seat! Has he forgotten who granted him the qualification to stand in the starsea when he was still weak?"
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Chanelle’s mouth.
Within that smile was composure, as well as a trace of indescribable understanding.
"Leader, do you truly think that because Faustus is trapped in the Chaosverse, he is destined to sink forever and will never rise again?"
"Hmm!?"

sentences.text: Hmm!?
The powerhouses frowned tightly.
"The entire Chaosverse has been locked down, and everyone is panicking.
This can very easily shatter a powerhouse’s Mental State!"
"Who can guarantee that there isn’t, or won’t be in the future, an Oracle-grade being in the Astral Realm who goes mad and starts a massacre?"
No one could guarantee that.
"So,"
the light in Daniel’s eyes grew brighter and brighter,
"we must first prepare an escape route.
If things remain calm and there isn’t much slaughter, that would naturally be best."
"But if an Oracle-grade truly goes mad, we’ll hide in the depths of the planes within the Astral Realm.
With the suppression of the Astral Realm’s own rules, those Oracle-grade beings won’t be able to enter before the time limit arrives.
No matter what, staying alive is the most important thing."
After hearing this, James nodded.
"Excellent, Boss.
I didn’t expect you to understand the path of survival so deeply too!"
"Lord Faustus is absolutely right."
Dustin agreed.
"The Chaosverse will definitely fall into great chaos.
Avoiding danger is never wrong."

"It’s not that big of a deal!
Isn’t it just that we temporarily can’t advance?"

chapters.title: Chapter 364 -364-True Poison and Despair
paragraphs: Chanelle spoke unhurriedly.

"We once promised him in the name of the Golden Holy Mountain that from that moment onward, the Visca Galaxy would be his territory. As long as he had the ability to hold it in his palm, what would it matter even if he occupied the entire galaxy?"
"As for excessive plundering that damages the vitality and balance of those worlds, that is indeed somewhat improper."
Chanelle paused for a moment.

"However, Faustus is currently facing an unprecedented crisis. He needs a massive amount of resources to exchange for Origin Crystals in order to maintain his survival. I hope you can understand the hardship behind this."
"As for demoting him..."
Chanelle raised her brows slightly.
"I do have a suggestion."
"Oh?"

"How about this? I will make a few more trips to the Origin Universe and gather more Origin Crystals. We can moderately raise the points required for exchange, thereby compensating the Golden Holy Mountain for its losses. What do you think?"
"After all, the largest customer for Origin Crystals right now is still Faustus. Consider it as Faustus contributing a modest effort to the Golden Holy Mountain in another way."
Chanelle’s proposal was watertight, like a soft blade that left Noxis’s anger with nowhere to land.
Daniel needed resources.
Because no energy could be absorbed within the Chaosverse, but Origin Crystals contained pure energy that could be absorbed.
And Origin Crystals were a specialty product of the special universe known as the Origin Universe.
Only Oracle-grade beings were qualified to set foot there.
Therefore, Daniel could only obtain Origin Crystals through the Golden Holy Mountain’s exchange channel.
This was his only path.
After hearing this, most of Noxis’s anger faded.
He let out a long sigh, filled with deep helplessness.
"Your care for Faustus has truly reached the point of meticulous concern. Even the most loving elder treating their most cherished junior might not go this far."
"Since you are so certain of his future, then we will do as you say."
Chanelle merely nodded lightly, unconcerned, and said nothing more.
"The Endless Starsea has always been this cruel and real."
Chanelle sighed silently in her heart.
"Faustus, what I can do for you is ultimately limited..."
"The rest of the road depends entirely on your own Fortune Points and the edge of your sword."
The Chaosverse.
The tenth year after the Chaosverse was sealed.
The entire Chaosverse had fallen into unprecedented chaos.
The Order Faction and Chaos Faction no longer slaughtered each other, because both great factions had already fallen into enormous internal turmoil.
Internal upheaval was far more bone-piercing than external war.
Moreover, under this hellish situation...
What meaning was there in fighting over territory?
What use was there in plundering mountains of wealth?

Supreme-grade powerhouses could no longer climb upward. Demi-sages were nailed outside the threshold. Divine-grade powerhouses could not move an inch. Even Oracle-grade beings were like birds in cages!
Everything had turned into empty dust.
And what was even more suffocating than this was the chess player hidden behind the curtain!
An Eternal Sage, a supreme-grade existence standing above the Time River.
Not a single living being in the entire Chaosverse could resist such mighty power.
Even those Forefathers who lurked behind the great forces and had lived through countless eras were like startled birds, not daring to voice even half a complaint.
When that Eternal Sage led His army to tear open the firmament and descend into this place, the life and death of every living being in the Chaosverse would hang upon a single thought from Him.
Perhaps it would only take one sentence spilling from His lips.
Perhaps it would only take one contemptuous glance from the corner of His eye.
And so, despair seeped silently into the hearts of every living being like a plague, corroding their will and devouring their reason.
The Chaosverse had been chaotic before, but at least there had been the two reins of the Order Faction and Chaos Faction, chains that restrained the raging beast.
But now, the chains had snapped, the reins had burned away, and everything had fallen into an even more chaotic, even more frenzied abyss.
Nineteen years ago,
in an unknown galaxy, thousands of supreme-grade powerhouses could no longer endure the torment in their hearts and launched an unprecedented massacre.
Eighteen years ago,
hundreds of demi-sages captured all living beings within a galaxy and imprisoned them in an arena, forcing them to slaughter one another purely for amusement.
Fourteen years ago,
a Divine-grade powerhouse raised his butcher’s blade in the endless void and destroyed countless living beings in his plane one after another...
Five years ago,
within the Astral Realm, an Oracle-grade being suffered a collapse of the heart.
Once, he had been a prodigy of extraordinary talent, a rising star of hope within a great force.
But one day, he suddenly went mad.
For powerhouses who had climbed to the peak, even long stretches of time and loneliness were ultimately nothing more than a string of numbers.
The true reason he fell into madness was...
Despair!
He began frantically killing every living being within his sight.
Every time he killed one, he released a crazed sound that was half-laughter, half-sobbing, like a mournful elegy.
"Damn it... I can never advance to T4 Oracle-grade again!"
"My Sacred Tribulation will eventually descend... but now I cannot advance... death is only a matter of time... hehehe..."
When there was no hope of moving forward, the despair carried by time became deadly poison!
"Why should I be the only one trapped in the abyss of despair while all of you enjoy peace..."
"Die with me... hehe... fall into eternal darkness with me... hahahaha..."
That Oracle-grade slaughtered countless powerhouses, and in the end, he was personally killed by one of his closest friends.
It was said that those two Oracle-grade beings had been brothers with extremely deep affection.
And all of this had happened within only a short dozen years after the Chaosverse was locked down.
If even more time passed...
The consequences would be unimaginable.
If one could not absorb energy from heaven and earth, one could not advance.
The bodies of living beings would gradually wither, like flowers that had lost their spring water, slowly wilting beneath the blazing sun.
If one could not advance in Rank, then even those mighty powerhouses who once shook the world would eventually have a day when they turned into yellow soil.
Moreover, the tribulations of Oracle-grade beings were the coldest judgments between heaven and earth.
Once the time arrived, the tribulation would descend as promised.
Those Oracle-grade beings who could not accumulate strength and could not advance would ultimately be reduced to ashes beneath those tribulations, without even bones left behind.
The saddest part was that no one knew when the shackles placed upon the Chaosverse would finally be undone.
The Astral Realm.
Faustus walked between heaven and earth, passing through one plane after another that was both familiar and unfamiliar.
Many years of bitter cultivation had still failed to bring him the dawn of advancement.
He wanted to come out and walk around, to brush away the gloom in his heart.
He arrived at a certain plane and unexpectedly encountered many old acquaintances there.
"Faustus?!"
Harris raised his eyes and looked at him, complicated emotions interweaving in his gaze.
"Wasn’t he meditating this whole time?"
Udi murmured to himself, his voice carrying a trace of daze.
"In the current Astral Realm, he is probably the only one still attempting to advance."
Igor sighed softly, and an inexplicable sense of admiration rose in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 -365-The Eaglet in the Painting
paragraphs: Daniel saw that these former opponents and fellow travelers had all gathered together.
Around them were piles of wine and food. There was even a group of graceful attendants in flowing robes, dancing lightly to the faint sound of string music.
"What a comfortable scene."
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth as he spoke.
"You all seem to be living quite well."
When Harris and the others heard this, their expressions immediately became awkward.
Even they themselves could not tell whether that awkwardness came from Daniel’s seemingly casual words, or from the deep shame they felt toward their own decadent behavior.
As top existences among peak demi-sage ranks, the word "advancement" had long since been carved into their bones and fused into their blood.
Yet now, they indulged in wine and pleasure all day long, wasting their years and throwing their ambition to pursue the peak far behind them.
There seemed to be a trace of mockery in Daniel’s words.
However, they all understood that what he said was not wrong.
"What difference does it make?"
Udi gritted his teeth.
"Right now, the Chaosverse’s path of advancement has already been sealed shut. What else can we do? We might as well drink the flames in this cup!"
"We have already touched our own ceiling. We are only missing that final step."
Harris raised his wine cup, and the amber liquor inside swayed gently.
"No one can take another step forward. Even you, Faustus, are no exception."
"Exactly."
Cold Star, Igor, and Silas all nodded.
"We only need to quietly wait for the day the seal is undone. When that time comes, we will naturally be able to keep moving forward and continue climbing."
Daniel nodded.
He silently turned and left, his back gradually stretching longer in the faint light.
Only a group of same-generation powerhouses with complicated hearts remained behind.
Daniel continued walking forward.
In a quiet plane, he saw Vincent.
Vincent was painting!
What he painted was the current state of the Chaosverse.
There were crazed powerhouses slaughtering freely in the starry sky, blood flowing like rivers.
There were powerhouses nearing the end of their lifespans, leaping into the void in despair and turning into silent dust.

There were also those powerhouses who had been rejected from the path of advancement, indulging in wine and pleasure all day, living in drunken dreams and burying their former ambitions between cups and goblets.
Vincent’s painting seemed to fish those tragic moments out from the long river of time, forever freezing them upon the canvas.
"Your painting is very moving."
Only after Vincent laid down the final stroke did Daniel speak softly.
"This is also part of my advancement."
Vincent raised his head, his smile gentle and calm.
"Painting is my cultivation. It tempers my Mental State and allows me to comprehend the true essence of the Laws."
A light suddenly appeared in Daniel’s eyes.
"You really are extraordinary."
"So are you."
Vincent smiled.
"You have always persisted in yourself and never given up."
"I am merely walking my own path."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth lifted slightly.
Vincent suddenly said, "I once painted a picture for you."
"Oh?"
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
"Take a look."
Vincent took out a scroll and handed it to Daniel.
"This painting is called The Eaglet. I give it to you."
Daniel took the scroll and slowly unfolded it.
A vivid scene immediately entered his eyes.
Within the painting, an eaglet that had just broken out of its shell looked young and fragile.
It poked its head out from the shattered shell in confusion, and its first glance was toward the boundless sky.
Then, it began to try.
It flapped its tiny, fleshy wings and clumsily fluttered.
The first time, it fell heavily to the ground.
The hundredth time, it barely flew half a meter high before falling again, covered in wounds.
Yet its head remained raised, stubbornly facing that vast firmament.
There was not the slightest retreat in its eyes.
Only yearning for the sky.
Only desire for flight.
It continued flapping its wings.
A thousand times.
Ten thousand times.
Hundreds of thousands, millions of attempts...
The eaglet’s dream was to fly into that sky, to touch the clouds, to feel the freedom of the wind.
It fell again and again, yet climbed back up again and again.
It was a war.
And the protagonist of that war was itself.
Its enemy was named fate.
Every fall was merely the horn of its next charge.
Its constantly flapping wings were a silent challenge issued against fate.
Its proudly raised head was the most complete contempt toward fate.
The eaglet had always been losing.
But it had never surrendered.
Losing did not mean defeat.
Giving up...
That was the true fall, the true submission beneath the feet of fate.
The eaglet was incomparably fragile, and fate was so immensely powerful.
Fate needed only a tiny joke to find a thousand ways to reduce that eaglet to ashes.
Yet the eaglet still fought.
It fought against fate, until death without rest!
"This painting..."
Daniel slowly rolled up the scroll, his voice calm yet filled with deep emotion.
"Is very interesting."
"Right? I think so too."
Vincent smiled.
"Then, will you continue attempting to advance?"
"Of course."
Daniel’s answer did not contain the slightest hesitation.
"What if there is still no result?"
"Is the result truly that important?"
Daniel suddenly smiled.
"Isn’t maintaining an unyielding fighting spirit itself more precious than the result?"
Vincent froze, as though a bolt of lightning had split apart the fog in his heart.
Was the result important?
Without question.
But maintaining one’s fighting spirit was even more important than obtaining the result!
"Is it truly misfortune to have no light?"
"The true misfortune is having eyes that long for light yet refuse to open... It is clearly being able to burn, yet willingly extinguishing the flame within one’s heart!"
Vincent understood.
So Faustus was also cultivating.
Just like him.
Vincent walked the path of the painting heart, while Faustus cultivated fighting spirit and persistence!
"So that’s how it is. Faustus’s Rank is indeed high."
There was envy in Vincent’s heart, but even more than that, there was reverence from the depths of his soul.
This was the true path of a powerhouse.
What was a powerhouse?
One who strengthened themselves without end and never bowed their head!

"It is hard to imagine what kind of difficulty could possibly trap a powerhouse like Faustus, someone with endless fighting spirit. Given enough time, he will surely become one of the greatest existences in the Endless Starsea!"
Vincent sighed silently in his heart.
"Faced with a desperate situation, some living beings willingly fall into decadence. Some surrender easily. Some blame heaven and earth, searching everywhere for excuses..."
"But there are very few like Faustus. Even while trapped in despair, he instead treats that despair as a whetstone, using it to temper his Mental State and forge his soul."
"When the day comes that the shackles shatter... Faustus will surely soar into the heavens, unstoppable."
Vincent’s eyes gradually brightened.
"Just like the eaglet in the painting."
"Even if the eaglet falls countless times, when the day comes that its wings are fully grown, it will fly higher than any of its kind—"
"Faster! Stronger!"
"Through countless failures, it trained powerful muscles and bones. Through wounds covering its entire body, it gained tenacious endurance. Beneath endless defeat, it sharpened an unbreakable heart."

"Faustus is exactly like that. Even in the face of this predicament and desperate situation where he cannot advance, he is constantly tempering his will. One day, the bitter winter will pass, and the shackles will collapse."
"When that time comes... Faustus will rise like a star into the sky, shining with boundless light, unstoppable by anyone."

Around them were piles of wine and food.
There was even a group of graceful attendants in flowing robes, dancing lightly to the faint sound of string music.
"What a comfortable scene."
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth as he spoke.
"You all seem to be living quite well."

"We have already touched our own ceiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 -366-Trying Again, A New Change
paragraphs: Seeing that Vincent had gained quite a lot of insight, Daniel could not help but secretly approve.
Vincent’s talent was indeed extraordinarily rare in this world.
At that moment, Daniel suddenly said, "If possible, I would like to ask you to paint another picture."
Vincent blinked. "What kind of painting?"
"A story about a hero and a dragon."
A trace of light flashed through Daniel’s eyes.

"I once heard someone tell a story. The princess had passed away, yet the young man was still burning. Even if only a faint spark remained, he would ignite it again and again, never allowing it to go out..."
"What deeper meaning does this painting have?"
Vincent asked.
"Consider it a gift for the younger generation of my homeland."
Daniel smiled.
"A legacy about fighting spirit."
Right now, he was using this opportunity to temper his Mental State.
He hoped that before the players of Earth comprehended their own paths, they would be able to possess an indestructible fighting spirit!
This was an extremely pure and resilient path. If it could become a legacy of Earth, that would be quite good as well.
Daniel had only truly comprehended unyielding fighting spirit after studying those eight ancient stone tablets.
This was only one form of Mental State. It could not be directly transformed into concrete combat power.
However, in the future, when advancing to Oracle-grade and facing life-and-death tribulations, it could provide crucial assistance.
Daniel felt that paintings might allow the players to accept and comprehend it more easily, helping them quickly understand the true meaning contained within.
This was a legacy he had carefully prepared for the players of Earth.
Perhaps the players could not use it yet, but there was nothing wrong with laying the groundwork in advance.
Vincent agreed to Daniel’s request, and they arranged a time for Daniel to collect the painting.
Daniel then bid farewell and returned to the plane where he usually stayed.
"My lord."
Camille was wiping the longsword in her hand.
When a swordsman wiped their sword, what they wiped away was not rust and dust from the blade, but the stray thoughts deep within their own soul.
A swordsman’s heart was clear as a mirror, bright and flawless.
This was the supreme-grade state pursued by swordsmen.
"Brother."
Mosi’s voice was still cold, but compared to before, it was much gentler.
He quietly appeared beside Daniel from the void.
"James still hasn’t awakened?"
Daniel asked with a smile.
"Yes."
Mosi responded briefly.
James was different from ordinary people. Sleeping for a long time without waking had actually become his normal state.
However, Daniel knew that James was also cultivating. As for what exactly he was cultivating, there was no way to know.
"I’m going to continue advancing as well."
Daniel arrived at a hidden place.
He opened the sage rank template and continued attempting to merge his Divine Domain with the foundation of the sage rank.
Amid rumbling sounds, however, the Divine Domain and sage rank still could not fuse no matter what.
Outside the Chaosverse.
Hundreds of massive Starships densely filled the void beyond the Chaosverse barrier, like a silent army of steel.
The gazes of all the powerhouses gathered upon the existence standing at the bow of the flagship.
That powerhouse stood straight and strong, his long hair whipping in the starwind.
Synros looked toward the Chaosverse and spoke coldly.
"Wait."
The powerhouses under his command obeyed without question, even lowering their breathing to the faintest degree.
An unusual light flickered in Synros’s eyes as he muttered inwardly.
"Kelly, I have arrived as promised."
The Other Shore.
"It is time."
A gleam flashed through the eyes of the little girl who was the incarnation of the world will. She turned to look at Kelly.
"Sister, I have to go."
"Alright."
Kelly’s gaze was calm and distant.
Kelly had long since seen countless fragments within the Time River and knew the direction of the future.
At this moment, the most critical point had arrived.
The little girl looked toward Daniel, a trace of determination flashing through her eyes.
The next moment, she transformed into a beam of white light and scattered into the void.
At the same time,
Daniel’s sage rank template suddenly surged with a strange fluctuation!
"What is going on?"
He saw the gray lotus at the very center of the sage rank template trembling slightly, as though it had sensed some unknown Strength.
It was impossible to tell whether that trembling came from excited joy or deep fear.
At that moment, a white radiance appeared out of nowhere and silently descended before him.
"This is..."
Daniel’s pupils shrank slightly.
After all these years, the sage rank template had never shown any abnormal movement.
But why had such a change appeared today?
Could it be...
A sign that the shackles of the Chaosverse were about to loosen?
Daniel could not understand it.
But no matter what, this change did not seem like an omen of misfortune.
"That aura... seems to be the power of a world will, vast as a star river and rich as chaos."
Daniel’s heart stirred.
"Where did this Strength come from? Could it be the world will of the Astral Realm?"
"Other than this newborn world, what other place could nurture such pure world will?"

"But why would the world will of the Astral Realm favor me? Moreover, shouldn’t a world will be under the control of the universe will? How could it possibly break free from the shackles of the universe will?"
A world will did possess its own thoughts, but it could only slowly move along the path preset by the universe will, eventually becoming the rule guardian of that world.
Though it had a spirit, it could not escape.
Therefore, the world called it "the prisoner of the universe will."
Yet at this moment, this vast power of the world will clearly seemed like a prisoner breaking its chains, shattering its cage, and surging out.
"My sage rank originally accumulated ten trillion points of divine energy, but now the world will has infused me with at least tens of quadrillions more!"
Rumble...
Daniel looked toward his sage rank template.
Under the blessing of that incomparably vast world will power, the sage rank template underwent a heaven-shaking transformation.
That gray lotus suddenly expanded.
The lotus pond that had originally been no larger than a pond now transformed into an ocean!
The boundary of the sage rank continuously extended and expanded outward, as though there were no end.
The sage rank was growing infinitely!
Daniel secretly estimated that the current range of his sage rank was at least a hundred times that of an ordinary sage!
It was simply absurd!
"I’ll try fusing again."
A flash of inspiration appeared in Daniel’s mind. He once again activated his Divine Domain, allowing it to merge with the foundation of the sage rank.
Boom!
Rumble!
This time, the momentum of the fusion was countless times greater than before.
The rumbling sound rolled across the sky like thunder, and shockwaves spread in every direction like a tsunami.
The powerhouses of the Astral Realm were all startled by the continuous thunderous roars.
They had heard the sounds produced by Daniel’s advancement attempts before, but never had there been anything so shocking.
In these long and dull years, even a yawn that lasted one instant longer than usual could be considered an interesting event worth remembering.
Let alone an abnormal commotion like this!
Whoosh, whoosh—!
Countless powerhouses flew into the air, their gazes turning toward Daniel’s location.
The rumbling continued, wave after wave.
Those demi-sages, many Divine-grade powerhouses, and even the Oracle-grade beings all stared in Daniel’s direction.
"Faustus..."
Vera fiercely bit into the spirit fruit in her hand. While chewing, she mumbled indistinctly,
"Do your best."
"Will... a miracle descend?"
Jason quietly looked toward Daniel’s direction.
"Myriad-Star Cosmos... Faustus..."
A group of Oracle-grade beings looked into the distance with hope in their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 -367-A Rainbow Falling from the Sky
paragraphs: "Hmm? What is going on?"
Camille stopped wiping his longsword and focused his senses on the fluctuations coming from Daniel.
Mosi walked out from the void, his face carrying a trace of surprise.
"What is happening?"
James felt the tremors surging through heaven and earth.
"Wait... could Big Brother Faustus have caused this heaven-shaking commotion?"
"No... is he about to advance?"
A thought flashed through his mind, but it was quickly extinguished by reason.
"No, breaking free from the shackles of the universe can’t possibly be that easy. Even T9 Oracle-grade beings are helpless against it."
Daniel also sensed that something was wrong.
The sudden emergence of that world will power gave rise to an indescribable premonition in his heart.
But now, the arrow was already on the string and had to be released!
He immediately poured in all his strength, pushing the fusion of his Divine Domain and sage rank forward!
The Other Shore.
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
Flames ignited around Kelly.
Seven-colored flames intertwined and coiled together, like a rainbow stretching across the sky.
Kelly looked toward Daniel’s location, her gaze filled with resolve.
"Kelly... you were right."
"Even if I were allowed to choose countless times... I would still make the same choice."
"Even though I have already discovered that you deceived me. The one truly undergoing the tribulation... is me."
"Kelly, you are the tribulation I must face!"
Kelly recalled the fragments she had seen in the Time River, together with the revelation from the spirit of the world will, and her heart had now completely understood everything.
"So I was once that powerful—the Rank Kelly possesses is the Rank I once touched, a Strength capable of suppressing Eternal Sages!"
"But I still have one final trial left... Egoless Judgment."
"Kelly wants me to disappear, but she can only make me willingly walk toward the end. And in this world, there is only one person who can make me willingly go to my death."
"So Kelly laid down a deathtrap. The Chaosverse is the universe Kelly personally created in the current space-time."
"All of this is aimed at Faustus. Faustus is the bait on the hook. I am the fish. And the angler... is Kelly!"
The radiance around Kelly grew increasingly intense, dazzling like a burning star!
She flew out of the Other Shore like a flaming arrow, falling straight toward Daniel’s location.
Within the Time River.
Kelly stood with her hands behind her back, quietly watching Kelly’s movements.
"It is time to begin."
That eternal coldness of hers finally showed a trace of fluctuation.
With a wave of her hand, a ray of light instantly descended upon the Chaosverse.
That ray of light chased after the rainbow Kelly had transformed into.
The Astral Realm.
Daniel was fully focused.
Under his control, his Divine Domain struck that invisible barrier again and again.
That faint obstruction seemed farther away than the distance between universes, visible yet unreachable.
"Am I going to fail again this time?"
Daniel’s expression showed no ripple.
The many powerhouses watching from afar also sank into disappointment.
Daniel’s side seemed to have already fallen silent.
"We got our hopes up for nothing. It’s another failure."
"We were thinking too much... to actually believe Faustus could break through the shackles set by a supreme-grade existence."
"Exactly. How could any powerhouse break free from the shackles of the universe? Even T9 Oracle-grade beings are helpless. How could Faustus possibly do it?"
"Sigh..."
Countless powerhouses were preparing to turn and leave.
But at that moment, someone suddenly shouted.
"Look! A rainbow—!"
Whoosh, whoosh—!
Many powerhouses raised their heads and looked into the distance.
They saw a rainbow that seemed to be burning, flying toward Daniel’s location.
Every living being in the Astral Realm personally saw that brilliant rainbow!
"Why would a rainbow suddenly appear? Is it an anomaly caused by Faustus’s advancement?"
"No. Look carefully. That isn’t a simple rainbow."
A sage narrowed his eyes.
"That should be the manifestation of some kind of energy."
"That’s right. Something inside it seems to be burning."
"Burning? Could it be another powerhouse who has chosen to end their own life?"
"No. That rainbow is filled with vitality and surging Strength. It is definitely not the destruction of one who has fallen!"
"Look closely. Its target is very clear—it is heading straight for Faustus."
"What is that?"
Daniel saw it as well.
He saw a rainbow fly over from nowhere and directly sink into his sage rank.
To outsiders, that rainbow was dazzling and magnificent.
But in Daniel’s eyes, it stirred an inexplicable tremor in his heart.
It was as though, many years ago, in a valley, there had been a rainbow held in Kelly’s palm.
He slowly raised his wrist.
There was a knotted cord tied around it, its color exactly the same as the rainbow before him.
"Kelly..."
Daniel softly spoke that name.
Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted.
He shot into the sky, his voice carrying trembling disbelief.
"It’s burning. Kelly’s aura is wrapped inside it!"
"It’s Kelly!"
Stormy waves surged in Daniel’s heart.
He used all his strength to cut off the connection between his Divine Domain and sage rank.
"If her life burns out like this, she will die. She will completely vanish from this world, without even dust remaining!"
He did not understand why Kelly had appeared here.
He did not understand why she had made such a choice.
He did not understand why she had turned herself into a burning rainbow.
Daniel only knew one thing.
If that rainbow continued burning, Kelly would be reduced to ashes before his eyes, without even leaving behind a farewell.
So he desperately tried to stop everything.
Yet what horrified him was—
He could not withdraw his Divine Domain and sage rank template!
They seemed to have been firmly locked in place by an irresistible Strength, no longer obeying his will.
What shook his heart even more was that his Divine Domain and sage rank were slowly merging, seeping into one another like two rivers reunited after a long separation, flowing into the same ocean.
"This is... the sign of impending advancement!"
Daniel’s heart roared, as though a thunderbolt had exploded deep within his soul.
"Kelly... she wants to help me fuse my Divine Domain and sage rank!"
"She is using her own life to push open that shackle for me!"
Outside the Chaosverse.
Synros stood like a statue, staring all this time toward that sealed universe.
Suddenly, a strange streak of light was reflected in his eyes.
It was like a falling meteor, tearing through the eternal darkness and vanishing in an instant.
"I found you—Kelly!"
A cold gleam burst from Synros’s eyes, and killing intent surged from his body like a tide.

"Originally, finding you in this vast starsea would have been like searching for a speck of dust in a desert. But from the moment I saw through your arrangement, I knew—you would never escape my palm."
Synros took a deep breath.
Then, his figure silently merged into the void, like a drop of ink falling into water.

Mosi walked out from the void, his face carrying a trace of surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 -368-The Schemes of Kelly and Synros
paragraphs: Beside the Time River.
Kelly suddenly turned around.
The instant she turned, a figure had silently appeared before her.
It was a supreme powerhouse with the strength of an Eternal Sage.
His long hair scattered freely through the void, and his eyes shone like stars, as though they had gathered the brilliance of the entire starry sky within them.
"Synros!"
Kelly’s brows furrowed tightly, her voice carrying a trace of coldness.
"Kelly!"
Synros responded coldly, his gaze sharp as a blade.
"How did you find me?"
Kelly asked in a low voice.
A cold smile appeared at the corner of Synros’s mouth as he slowly spoke.

"You are Kelly’s Egoless Judgment. The meaning of your existence is to lead Kelly toward self-annihilation. However, in this world, the only person who can make Kelly willingly go to her death is my main body."
"So you personally created the Chaosverse in this space-time, using the Astral Realm as bait to lure my main body into the trap."
"My main body is your bait. You arranged for a great Oracle-grade to hunt him down, then made Kelly sacrifice herself for him. Am I right?"
Kelly nodded lightly.
"As expected of an Eternal Sage with Starbeast bloodline. Once you step into the realm of eternity, you become invincible among those of the same tier..."
Synros raised his head proudly.
"But you never imagined that in order to draw you out, I would not hesitate to use my main body as a chess piece as well."
"I personally sealed the Chaosverse. Even my main body cannot break free from this shackle!"
When Kelly heard this, she suddenly smiled.
It was the first smile she had revealed in who knew how many eras.
"I had already predicted every step you would take."
Kelly smiled.
"That is why I taught Kelly a supreme-grade Sacred Art. Her current Rank is still low, so she can only burn herself to cleave open the road to the peak for Faustus."
"Her death has long been destined."
"No!"
Synros snorted in disdain.
"All of your backup plans are within my calculations."
"Do you think my Eternal Sacred Artifact can only lock down the Chaosverse with three layers? No—I can lock it down with five!"
Kelly raised her brows.
"The fourth layer... is life and death, isn’t it?"
"So what you mean is, Kelly’s disappearance is not the true end. She will be taken into your Eternal secret treasure and can be resurrected at any time?"
"Then what is the fifth layer?"
Kelly shouted sharply.
"The fifth layer is, of course..."
The corner of Synros’s mouth lifted slightly.
"To lock you down, Kelly."
"If you do not act, I will never be able to catch you. And after catching you, only by defeating you can I help Kelly survive that life-and-death tribulation."
"There is no other way. You are far too powerful!"
"Only by completely sealing the universe you personally created do I have a fifty percent chance of killing you!"
Kelly suddenly smiled again.
"What are you laughing at?"
Synros asked with a frown.
"I am laughing because the two of you are truly interesting."
Kelly sneered.
"Kelly is willing to burn herself out to save your main body."
"And you came to this current space-time under orders from your main body, yet you are here to save Kelly."
"Are the two of you... offering each other the deepest confession of love?"
"Absurd!"
Kelly sneered coldly.
"Do you think Egoless Judgment is so easy to overcome? Isn’t your main body also struggling against his own tribulation at some distant node of space-time?"
"You want to shake my Mental State? Naive!"
A dense killing intent suddenly erupted from Synros’s eyes. His figure abruptly transformed into a streak of pitch-black light and shot toward Kelly.
"Die!"
"You want to hold me back to buy time for your main body in the current space-time, don’t you?"
Kelly also charged forward without backing down.
"Then let us see whether you have the strength!"
Outside the Chaosverse.
The moment Synros left, the Chitin Royal Court and the other two great forces received his order.
"All living beings of the Chaosverse—kill without mercy!"
"Kill—!"
Several T9 Oracle-grade beings roared, driving their Starships like a torrent as they tore through the barrier of the Chaosverse and surged inside.
At the same time,
within the Astral Realm.
Daniel’s Divine Domain and sage rank were slowly merging.
At this speed, they would eventually fuse completely.
When that happened, Daniel would successfully advance to Divine-grade.
Beyond that threshold lay an entirely new world.
Once he advanced, he would directly become peak Divine-grade!
Daniel’s advancement phenomenon attracted the attention of countless powerhouses.
First came the vast ocean-like power of the world will, then the burning rainbow Kelly had transformed into.
Anomalies appeared one after another at Daniel’s location, as though the entire Astral Realm were playing a silent hymn for him.
In the hearts of many powerhouses, a faint trace of expectation began to emerge.
"Faustus... is about to advance?"
"Doesn’t that mean the lockdown on the Chaosverse has been broken?"
"If Faustus can advance, then can we also..."
Just as everyone was whispering among themselves—
Rumble!
A sound like muffled thunder exploded, rolling out from the depths of the void.
The plane where Daniel was located trembled violently.
The outer planes of the Astral Realm, along with the central plane, also began trembling together.
At this moment, Daniel’s location seemed to have become the axis of the entire Astral Realm, with all things paying homage to him.
"It is almost done."
Daniel stared at the two realms merging before him.
The black-and-white eyes within his Divine Domain had now transformed into two intertwined streams of black and white air, like two giant dragons slowly sinking into that gray lotus.
Nourished by them, the lotus grew increasingly massive. Its petals trembled slightly, faintly showing signs of blooming.
Boom!
Rumble—rumble—
The Divine Domain and sage rank continued colliding, releasing deafening roars.
The Divine Domain and sage rank gradually overlapped. The outline belonging to the Divine Domain became fainter and fainter, like candlelight slowly extinguishing before dawn.
And at the moment the Divine Domain completely dissipated—
the gray lotus at the very center of the sage rank fully bloomed!
Gray light instantly erupted outward, dazzling like the rising sun, as though the light of the entire plane had been dyed in that deep gray.
"I’ve advanced—!"
Daniel faintly sensed waves of vast energy suddenly surging out from within his sage rank, violently washing over his body.
That energy seeped into every cell and every thread of his soul, transforming his flesh and soul from the deepest level, while sealing pure and flawless Strength inside his body like buried treasure.
However, Daniel’s body was far too special.
It was like an ocean that had been dry for countless ages. Even with endless energy pouring in, it could not be filled in a short time.
The gray light madly spread outward, expanding until it finally enveloped the seven outer planes of the Astral Realm.
Under the erosion of that gray light, the seven planes began to slowly dissolve, being assimilated into torrents of gray energy.
That energy split into two streams.
One surged like a rushing river, pouring straight into Daniel’s body.
The other flowed into his sage rank, becoming nourishment for its continued growth!
