chapters.title: Chapter 369 -369-The Storm That Devoured the Entire Astral Realm
paragraphs: Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Countless powerhouses were startled by this apocalyptic scene and rushed into the sky from their respective planes.
Harris and the others hovered in the void with blank expressions, their pupils reflecting that overwhelming gray.
"This is... the phenomenon of a sage rank opening!"
"A powerhouse has advanced!"
"It’s Faustus—!"
Harris’s lips trembled slightly.
What kind of joke was this?
The Chaosverse had been firmly sealed by invisible shackles. No one could advance. Even T9 Oracle-grade beings were helpless!
How could Faustus possibly break through a barrier that even great Oracle-grade beings could not shake?!
"Faustus... he actually advanced?!"
Silas and the others were full of shock, their voices carrying a near-collapsing tremor.
"Was I... wrong?"
Udi’s face was filled with bitterness and unwillingness, as though someone had snatched away the fruit of fate’s gift from his hand.
In another plane.
Vincent raised his head and stared as the plane he was in was slowly devoured by gray light.
The plane was dissolving, swallowed by that all-encompassing gray radiance.
He waved his hand and put away his scattered painting tools, then shot into the sky.
"The phenomenon of a sage rank opening!"
"According to ancient records, when a supreme sage rank is born, it must devour a massive amount of energy—just like a star greedily absorbing everything in the nebula at the moment of its birth."
"A supreme sage rank!"
Vincent’s heart shook violently, his pupils reflecting that sky-covering gray light.
"It’s Faustus advancing! He has finally stepped through the gate of Divine-grade!"

Vincent looked toward Faustus’s direction from afar, only to discover that the entire outer region of the Astral Realm had been shrouded by massive gray clouds, blotting out the sky and sun like the descent of doomsday.
"A supreme sage rank... truly unimaginable!"
Vincent drew in a cold breath.
"Gray is the original color of chaos. The Law contained within his sage rank should be one of the strongest kinds."
Vera appeared beside Vincent. Her petite face was filled with shock, and she had even forgotten to bite into the spirit fruit in her hands.
"The Laws of the Endless Starsea are as numerous as stars. Although all paths ultimately lead to the same destination, there are still differences in strength and level."
Vera’s eyes lit up.
"Gray is the Origin color of the Reincarnation Law, and reincarnation is among the strongest tier of Laws in the Endless Starsea!"
Vincent nodded. Then, as though suddenly remembering something, his expression changed drastically.
"Something’s wrong. The entire Astral Realm is about to be swallowed by Faustus!"
"The Astral Realm... is finished."
Vera looked at the collapsing world before her and was stunned as well.

In the vision of countless powerhouses, gray clouds blotted out the sky and sun. Not only had they spread across the outer regions of the Astral Realm, they were also surging toward the depths of the core plane.
At this moment, Daniel’s heart was as still as water.
His supreme sage rank continuously devoured the outer regions of the Astral Realm. While strengthening its own foundation, it also tempered his body.
At a certain moment,
the gray radiance spread to the very center of the Astral Realm.
The core plane dissolved silently like ice and snow meeting blazing flames.
"The supreme sage rank... is going to devour the entire Astral Realm completely?!"
James and Mosi’s eyes were filled with shock.
This was far too insane!
What kind of sage rank needed to devour such a massive amount of energy?
This was clearly an appetite only an Oracle-grade sage rank should possess!
Whoosh—!
The entire core plane was absorbed completely by Daniel’s sage rank.
Surges of energy came rushing in, instantly filling the long-dried void within Daniel’s body, while causing his sage rank to suddenly expand by dozens of times!
At this moment, Daniel’s sage rank was already as vast as a small world!
Absurd.
Utterly absurd to the extreme!
After the supreme sage rank devoured the entire Astral Realm, it suddenly spat out specks of light from within, like a well-fed giant letting out a satisfied burp.
Then, the radiance instantly withdrew inward, and heaven and earth returned to calm.
Daniel gazed over.
The nearly tangible domain of the supreme sage rank was like an independent small world.
The entire world had transformed into an enormous lotus sea, filled with countless blooming Gray Lotuses.
At the very center was a fully bloomed Gray Lotus, its petals layered upon one another as light flowed across them.
Buzz—!
The aura on Faustus’s body surged like a torrent breaking free from its shackles, rising uncontrollably.
Divine-grade low-grade, mid-grade, high-grade...
It climbed all the way upward, advancing like a hot knife through butter!
"Something’s wrong... The Astral Realm is about to be destroyed!"
The Divine-grade powerhouses stared at this scene in horror.
They had crossed the starsea from their respective homeland universes for the sake of plundering resources in this newborn world.
But because the Chaosverse had been sealed shut by invisible shackles, the Astral Realm had been unable to nurture top-tier Holy Relics, and they had gained nothing from this trip.
Who could have expected that now, the entire Astral Realm would be devoured by Faustus’s supreme sage rank?
Their beautiful dream was completely ruined.
To be fair, Faustus could not truly be blamed for this.
Even if the seal on the Chaosverse was undone in the future, the Astral Realm’s hundred-year limit would already have reached its end, and this place would naturally transform into a new galaxy.
In other words, their opportunity had been destined to become an empty dream from the very beginning.
But that did not stop the jealousy and envy surging within their hearts.
The Astral Realm was the essence of an entire galaxy!
Faustus’s supreme sage rank had devoured the entire Astral Realm. This was no different from taking the essence of an entire galaxy for himself.
How absurd was that?
"A supreme sage rank... can actually be plundered."
A poisonous thought quietly emerged in the heart of a Divine-grade powerhouse.
"If his sage rank can be seized, whether used to strengthen my own sage rank or forge a Divine-grade secret treasure, it would be a top-tier harvest."
"If such a supreme sage rank were forged into a secret treasure, it would definitely reach the level of a Primordial Supreme Treasure!"
Another Divine-grade powerhouse’s eyes flickered with ill intent.
"If we can take this sage rank for ourselves, then this trip would not be considered wasted."
Some Divine-grade powerhouses no longer concealed the greed in their eyes.
"Who says there are no opportunities here? Faustus himself is our opportunity!"
A sage rank could be robbed.
Like armor stripped from the weak by the strong.
Like spoils of war hung in the hall of the victor.
However, at this moment, the supreme sage rank had not yet completely stabilized.
The many sages could only temporarily suppress the greed in their hearts, like a pack of hungry wolves lurking in the darkness, waiting for the moment their prey revealed a flaw.
At this time, Faustus’s aura was still continuing to rise.
Peak Divine-grade...
Divine Radiant Grade...
Divine Sovereign Grade!
His aura charged all the way to the threshold of Divine Sovereign Grade before finally slowing down.
Yet even more energy remained accumulated, becoming the foundation of his strength, quietly awaiting the day it would erupt in the future.
At the same time, an icy prompt sounded beside Faustus’s ears.
[Ding! You have stepped into Divine-grade and successfully completed the special mission!]
[Prompt: You have obtained the Thunder elemental core and the Metal elemental core! You have obtained the Divine-grade achievement reward—Exclusive Secret Realm!]
As Daniel listened to the prompt beside his ears, his heart clenched hard.
The final two elemental cores—
he had finally obtained them!
Not only that, he had also obtained an Exclusive Secret Realm!
Without the slightest hesitation, Daniel directly took out that long-sealed secret codex—
the Chronoverse Prologue Codex!

sentences.text: Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Countless powerhouses were startled by this apocalyptic scene and rushed into the sky from their respective planes.
Harris and the others hovered in the void with blank expressions, their pupils reflecting that overwhelming gray.
"This is... the phenomenon of a sage rank opening!"
"A powerhouse has advanced!"
"It’s Faustus—!"
Harris’s lips trembled slightly.
What kind of joke was this?
The Chaosverse had been firmly sealed by invisible shackles.
No one could advance.
Even T9 Oracle-grade beings were helpless!
How could Faustus possibly break through a barrier that even great Oracle-grade beings could not shake?!
"Faustus... he actually advanced?!"
Silas and the others were full of shock, their voices carrying a near-collapsing tremor.
"Was I... wrong?"
Udi’s face was filled with bitterness and unwillingness, as though someone had snatched away the fruit of fate’s gift from his hand.
In another plane.
Vincent raised his head and stared as the plane he was in was slowly devoured by gray light.
The plane was dissolving, swallowed by that all-encompassing gray radiance.
He waved his hand and put away his scattered painting tools, then shot into the sky.
"The phenomenon of a sage rank opening!"
"According to ancient records, when a supreme sage rank is born, it must devour a massive amount of energy—just like a star greedily absorbing everything in the nebula at the moment of its birth."
"A supreme sage rank!"
Vincent’s heart shook violently, his pupils reflecting that sky-covering gray light.
"It’s Faustus advancing!
He has finally stepped through the gate of Divine-grade!"

Vincent looked toward Faustus’s direction from afar, only to discover that the entire outer region of the Astral Realm had been shrouded by massive gray clouds, blotting out the sky and sun like the descent of doomsday.
"A supreme sage rank... truly unimaginable!"
Vincent drew in a cold breath.
"Gray is the original color of chaos.
The Law contained within his sage rank should be one of the strongest kinds."
Vera appeared beside Vincent.
Her petite face was filled with shock, and she had even forgotten to bite into the spirit fruit in her hands.
"The Laws of the Endless Starsea are as numerous as stars.
Although all paths ultimately lead to the same destination, there are still differences in strength and level."
Vera’s eyes lit up.
"Gray is the Origin color of the Reincarnation Law, and reincarnation is among the strongest tier of Laws in the Endless Starsea!"
Vincent nodded.
Then, as though suddenly remembering something, his expression changed drastically.
"Something’s wrong.
The entire Astral Realm is about to be swallowed by Faustus!"
"The Astral Realm... is finished."
Vera looked at the collapsing world before her and was stunned as well.
In the vision of countless powerhouses, gray clouds blotted out the sky and sun.
Not only had they spread across the outer regions of the Astral Realm, they were also surging toward the depths of the core plane.
At this moment, Daniel’s heart was as still as water.
His supreme sage rank continuously devoured the outer regions of the Astral Realm.
While strengthening its own foundation, it also tempered his body.
At a certain moment,
the gray radiance spread to the very center of the Astral Realm.
The core plane dissolved silently like ice and snow meeting blazing flames.
"The supreme sage rank... is going to devour the entire Astral Realm completely?!"
James and Mosi’s eyes were filled with shock.
This was far too insane!
What kind of sage rank needed to devour such a massive amount of energy?
This was clearly an appetite only an Oracle-grade sage rank should possess!
Whoosh—!
The entire core plane was absorbed completely by Daniel’s sage rank.
Surges of energy came rushing in, instantly filling the long-dried void within Daniel’s body, while causing his sage rank to suddenly expand by dozens of times!
At this moment, Daniel’s sage rank was already as vast as a small world!
Absurd.
Utterly absurd to the extreme!
After the supreme sage rank devoured the entire Astral Realm, it suddenly spat out specks of light from within, like a well-fed giant letting out a satisfied burp.
Then, the radiance instantly withdrew inward, and heaven and earth returned to calm.
Daniel gazed over.
The nearly tangible domain of the supreme sage rank was like an independent small world.
The entire world had transformed into an enormous lotus sea, filled with countless blooming Gray Lotuses.
At the very center was a fully bloomed Gray Lotus, its petals layered upon one another as light flowed across them.
Buzz—!
The aura on Faustus’s body surged like a torrent breaking free from its shackles, rising uncontrollably.
Divine-grade low-grade, mid-grade, high-grade...
It climbed all the way upward, advancing like a hot knife through butter!
"Something’s wrong...
The Astral Realm is about to be destroyed!"
The Divine-grade powerhouses stared at this scene in horror.
They had crossed the starsea from their respective homeland universes for the sake of plundering resources in this newborn world.
But because the Chaosverse had been sealed shut by invisible shackles, the Astral Realm had been unable to nurture top-tier Holy Relics, and they had gained nothing from this trip.
Who could have expected that now, the entire Astral Realm would be devoured by Faustus’s supreme sage rank?
Their beautiful dream was completely ruined.
To be fair, Faustus could not truly be blamed for this.
Even if the seal on the Chaosverse was undone in the future, the Astral Realm’s hundred-year limit would already have reached its end, and this place would naturally transform into a new galaxy.
In other words, their opportunity had been destined to become an empty dream from the very beginning.
But that did not stop the jealousy and envy surging within their hearts.
The Astral Realm was the essence of an entire galaxy!
Faustus’s supreme sage rank had devoured the entire Astral Realm.
This was no different from taking the essence of an entire galaxy for himself.
How absurd was that?
"A supreme sage rank... can actually be plundered."
A poisonous thought quietly emerged in the heart of a Divine-grade powerhouse.
"If his sage rank can be seized, whether used to strengthen my own sage rank or forge a Divine-grade secret treasure, it would be a top-tier harvest."
"If such a supreme sage rank were forged into a secret treasure, it would definitely reach the level of a Primordial Supreme Treasure!"
Another Divine-grade powerhouse’s eyes flickered with ill intent.
"If we can take this sage rank for ourselves, then this trip would not be considered wasted."
Some Divine-grade powerhouses no longer concealed the greed in their eyes.
"Who says there are no opportunities here?
Faustus himself is our opportunity!"
A sage rank could be robbed.
Like armor stripped from the weak by the strong.
Like spoils of war hung in the hall of the victor.
However, at this moment, the supreme sage rank had not yet completely stabilized.
The many sages could only temporarily suppress the greed in their hearts, like a pack of hungry wolves lurking in the darkness, waiting for the moment their prey revealed a flaw.
At this time, Faustus’s aura was still continuing to rise.
Peak Divine-grade...
Divine Radiant Grade...
Divine Sovereign Grade!
His aura charged all the way to the threshold of Divine Sovereign Grade before finally slowing down.
Yet even more energy remained accumulated, becoming the foundation of his strength, quietly awaiting the day it would erupt in the future.
At the same time, an icy prompt sounded beside Faustus’s ears.
[Ding!
You have stepped into Divine-grade and successfully completed the special mission!]
[Prompt: You have obtained the Thunder elemental core and the Metal elemental core!
You have obtained the Divine-grade achievement reward—Exclusive Secret Realm!]
As Daniel listened to the prompt beside his ears, his heart clenched hard.
The final two elemental cores—
he had finally obtained them!
Not only that, he had also obtained an Exclusive Secret Realm!
Without the slightest hesitation, Daniel directly took out that long-sealed secret codex—
the Chronoverse Prologue Codex!

chapters.title: Chapter 370 -370-Absolute Space-Time Domain
paragraphs: [Prompt: You are using ten elemental cores to unseal the Chronoverse Prologue Codex.]
[Ding! You have successfully unsealed the Chronoverse Prologue Codex! The information within the codex has been refreshed. Please check it carefully.]
Daniel cast his gaze toward the codex in his hand.
Before it was unsealed, the codex had been dim and lightless, like an ordinary object.
But now, gray radiance slowly flowed across its surface, as though countless stars were being born and extinguished within it.
[Chronoverse Prologue Codex (Special Item)]
Exclusive: Faustus
Special: Elementary codex of the Space-Time Law

Remark: The holder of this codex can sense the location of a [Universe Fragment] once they approach it. Each fragment obtained will randomly grant a space-time blessing, or raise a space-time Law already mastered to a higher level.
Effect: After use, randomly obtain an elementary ability of the [Space-Time Law].
Description: What this codex records is a supreme-grade Law of the space-time lineage. It belongs to the category of a great universe-level Holy Relic.

Legend says that the great universe will possesses fifty Origin Laws. Of them, forty-nine move unseen within the operation of all things, while only one has quietly vanished, impossible for anyone to find.

This codex records the forty-nine space-time Sacred Arts that have appeared in the world, and the one in your hand is precisely one of them. The remaining forty-eight are scattered across the Endless Starsea in the form of [Universe Fragments]. You must gather all forty-eight fragments one by one before you can glimpse the complete face of the Space-Time Law.
It is said that if one can assemble a complete codex of the universe will, one will obtain [supreme-grade power that leads directly to the end of the great universe will].
Introduction: This is a codex personally written by an ancient legendary ruler of the great universe. He scattered this codex throughout the starsea...
Daniel’s gaze lingered on the lines of text for a long time.
"So the Chronoverse Prologue Codex is actually an item at the great universe level."
"This codex contains a total of forty-nine parts. If they can all be gathered, one can obtain mighty power that leads directly to the end of the great universe will!"
"And right now, I can randomly study one space-time Law from it."
Daniel did not hesitate at all and immediately chose to study it.
[Prompt: You have studied the Chronoverse Prologue Codex! You have obtained the elementary space-time Law Sacred Art—Absolute Space-Time Domain!]
[Ding! You have learned the elementary space-time Law Sacred Art Absolute Space-Time Domain!]
[Absolute Space-Time Domain]
Special: Rare. Cannot be boosted.
Type: Space-Time Law
Effect: After casting, an [Absolute Space-Time Domain] will form within the range covered by your sage rank. The caster may freely control the past and future within the current space-time domain.
Remark: This Sacred Art consumes an enormous amount of energy. The longer the past and future are controlled, and the wider the range, the greater the consumption.

Description: The Space-Time Law stands above all Laws. Once you master any space-time Law Sacred Art, your resistance to other space-time Law Sacred Arts will greatly increase. All Laws are governed by the Space-Time Law, and the Space-Time Law reigns supreme.
(Current Space-Time Law grade: low-grade. Upper limit: Can dominate all Laws at transcendent grade and below.)
(Can be upgraded by collecting Universe Fragments.)
Introduction: Within your own sage rank, you are the ruler—the beginning and end of time exist within a single thought of yours.
"What a domineering Sacred Art."
After reading the Sacred Art’s introduction, Daniel was deeply shaken.
"To freely control the past and future... As expected of the Space-Time Law!"

"Although the range is limited to the area covered by my sage rank, my sage rank is already no smaller than a small world. Although the consumption is enormous, as my strength grows, this Sacred Art will only become stronger the more I use it!"
Daniel tried casting Absolute Space-Time Domain once.
Buzz—
The space-time around him began to slowly flow, like river water gently stirred by an invisible hand.
All kinds of strange scenes appeared around him. He saw his sage rank trembling slightly, releasing thick gray Law power from within.
"Inconceivable!"
Daniel immediately withdrew the Sacred Art, restoring everything to its original state.
"So that’s how it is..."
Daniel pondered for a moment.
"I can control the current space-time for about one minute."

"I can make the current space-time return to one minute in the past, or leap one minute into the future. Within this one-minute domain, the Space-Time Law will stand above all other Laws at transcendent grade and below."
A brilliant light suddenly lit up in Daniel’s eyes.
Law power was not that easy to study.
Ordinary peak Divine-grade powerhouses had only just touched the threshold of Laws.
Even astonishing talents like Dustin and Vincent had only mastered low-grade Laws.
Within the Law system of the Endless Starsea, Divine Radiant Grade powerhouses could comprehend and master mid-grade Laws.

Divine Sovereign Grade could master one high-grade Law. Divine Lord Grade could control multiple high-grade Laws. As for Divine Descendant, that was already an existence that had touched the threshold of transcendent Laws, capable of mastering one or even multiple transcendent Laws!
And Daniel had directly stepped onto the threshold of Divine Sovereign Grade the moment he advanced.
This was already a height countless powerhouses could not reach even after exhausting their entire lives.
"Moreover, I also created two greater Sacred Arts myself."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth lifted slightly, confidence shining in his eyes.
"And my supreme sage rank itself is a greater Sacred Art containing an ultimate Law!"
"The current me has already reached an entirely new height!"
"Right, there is also that Exclusive Secret Realm."
Daniel remembered that when he completed the advancement mission and obtained the elemental cores, he had also received an achievement reward—
an Exclusive Secret Realm.
[Exclusive Secret Realm (Special · Rare)]
Exclusive: Faustus
Type: Secret Realm
Grade: Rare
Effect: After use, obtain a [Secret Realm] that belongs exclusively to you.
Special: This secret realm must be personally entered and conquered. The current upper limit of the beings within the secret realm is [Tier 1 Oracle-grade].

Description: A secret realm is an independent world that only Oracle-grade beings have the ability to open. Powerful Oracle-grade beings can create planes even broader and more magnificent than great worlds.

The current secret realm is comparable to a world opened by a great Oracle-grade being—broader than an ordinary great world, richer in resources, and home to stronger living beings. Oracle-grade beings are entrenched within it.
Suggestion: Open this secret realm after your own strength reaches Oracle-grade, in order to obtain ownership and full authority over it.
Introduction: An Exclusive Secret Realm containing exclusive advancement treasure lands, top-tier Holy Relics, rare resources, and many powerful living beings...
After Daniel finished reading, his brows furrowed slightly.
"This Exclusive Secret Realm... is a bit troublesome!"
"The strongest beings inside actually reach Oracle-grade!"
Daniel did not know whether to laugh or cry.
"Although with my current strength, I don’t need to fear too much, I’m still not arrogant enough to actively provoke an Oracle-grade being."
"However, a powerhouse at the level of Tier 1 Oracle-grade probably can’t do much to me either."

"But the more that is the case, the more it proves that this secret realm is extraordinary. A secret realm capable of nurturing Oracle-grade powerhouses... just how top-tier must the resources inside be?"
Daniel pondered for a moment, his gaze distant.

"For an ordinary Oracle-grade being to open a secret realm, who knows how much painstaking effort, how many Holy Relics, and how much energy must be invested before they can create a world with a complete ecosystem capable of nurturing Oracle-grade powerhouses?"
"And I directly received a secret realm that only a great Oracle-grade being could open."
"This is a total win!"

chapters.title: Chapter 371 -371-Counting the Gains, Invincible Divine Sovereign
paragraphs: Daniel pondered silently.
He would explore that secret realm once his strength was sufficient in the future.
For now, the timing was not mature yet. He could not act rashly.
At present, he had crossed the heavenly chasm from demi-sage all the way into Divine-grade, directly reaching peak Divine-grade.
After that, he advanced like a hot knife through butter, breaking through layer after layer of barriers in one go and stepping into the realm of Divine Sovereign!
He had crossed so many Ranks, and his rise had been so fast, yet the timing was deeply puzzling.
Even Daniel himself felt profound confusion and unease toward this sudden advancement.
"I vaguely feel... as though I have been swept into a carefully woven net of fate."
A cold light flickered in Daniel’s eyes.
"There are too many events I cannot see through, yet are connected to me, silently surging beneath the surface."
"For example, why did the spirit of the Astral Realm’s will turn its gaze toward me of all people? Why did it place such a heaven-shaking gift into my palm?"
"And what about Kelly? Why did she appear in the Astral Realm? How was she able to see through the critical moment of my advancement and extend her hand at exactly the right time?"
"Kelly burned herself out... Has she now completely dissipated between the stars, or is she silently watching all of this from some corner beyond my reach?"
Daniel felt as though an invisible giant hand was reaching out from the void, plucking the strings of his fate.
That feeling...
Made even the depths of his soul tremble.
But it was not fear.
It was anger!
Daniel snorted coldly.
"No matter who the chess player behind the curtain is, and no matter how far-reaching his scheme may be, I will make him pay the price!"
"It seems... aside from me, the shackles of the Chaosverse are still firmly locked, without the slightest sign of loosening."
"So my advancement was definitely not an accident, nor was it a coincidence. It is just that behind this inevitability, there are too many undercurrents I know nothing about."
Daniel did his best to calm his mind.
"Right now, I still do not have the strength to face an existence like that. I should respond to changes with stillness for now and first count the gains I obtained in the Astral Realm."
Since entering the Astral Realm, Daniel had killed large numbers of quasi-Divine-grade powerhouses and plundered countless Holy Relics within the Astral Realm.
However, with the consumption required to construct his sage rank and complete his advancement, those Holy Relics and the gains from his kills had all turned into fuel.
Still, he had kept the absolute best ones.
"There is also the Basin of Greed."
Daniel thought to himself.

This treasure was Primordial Law Grade. It could forcibly store all Divine-grade secret treasures below Primordial Law Grade, and it also had a chance to advance one treasure within it by one grade, with the upper limit not exceeding the Basin of Greed’s own grade.
"The Voidbound Grail advanced because of this, leaping from Primordial Grade to Primordial Law Grade."
Daniel pondered.
"The Primordial Law Grade Holy Grail obtained two powerful new traits."
[Space-Time Anchor Point]: Immune to the influence of lower-grade space-time Laws. Anchors the user within the current space-time, like a boulder standing in a raging current.
[Law Devouring]: Can devour all lower-grade Laws of the enemy, resist mid-grade Laws, and weaken high-grade Laws.

"In terms of secret treasures, I also have the Primordial Law Grade Chrono Temple, which can use the flow of time to assist advancement. Right now, it is mainly being used by my Starbeast clone, Synros."
"There is also the Primordial Law Grade Imperial Bow Ark, a supreme tool for traveling through the starsea."
"In addition, I still have two secret treasure embryos."
"One is that black stone tablet. This stone tablet can be forged into a Divine-grade secret treasure, and it should at least be at the level of a Sacred Artisan Treasure."
"The other secret treasure embryo is the Star Relic I obtained while traveling through the starsea. If carefully forged, it should also reach the level of a Sacred Artisan Treasure."
"These two top-tier secret treasure embryos can wait until I return to the Golden Holy Mountain. I will find a great Oracle-grade to help forge them then."
"For now, the ones I use most frequently are still the Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed."
Daniel then began taking inventory of his Sacred Arts.
"Right now, I basically have no need for Crusader’s Physique anymore. Among those of the same Rank, I’m afraid no one can force me to reveal that trump card."
"The ones I use most now are still Immortal Icon, Titan Body, and Celestial Grasp. These three greater Sacred Arts are invincible in battle!"
"In addition, I created two greater Sacred Arts myself."
"One is True Sight, a greater Sacred Art that assists advancement and allows me to observe the Laws of all things."
"The other is Star Dome Shattering, an all-purpose greater Sacred Art that I have not truly used yet."
"Then there is the newly obtained space-time Law greater Sacred Art—Absolute Space-Time Domain."
Daniel silently thought to himself.
"I do not have many Sacred Arts, but every single one is extremely rare!"
"In total, I have four combat-type greater Sacred Arts. As for my sage rank..."
Daniel looked toward the supreme sage rank before him, which he had yet to withdraw.
"After undergoing several enhancements and devouring events, my supreme sage rank is already over a thousand times broader than the sage rank of an ordinary sage!"
Daniel’s tone carried a trace of shock that was hard to conceal.

"Right now, its territory is comparable to a complete small world. Moreover, what I have mastered is one of the strongest Laws in the Endless Starsea—the Reincarnation Law. Its grade has already touched the threshold of ultimate."

"The ultimate-grade Reincarnation Law has granted me a terrifying Strength: I can freely move back and forth between the past and future, through every imperceptible instant, stacking the sage rank power of those moments layer upon layer onto myself. This one ability alone can raise the might of my sage rank by more than a hundred times out of thin air!"
The peak of Laws was called infinity.
Above ultimate was infinite!
That was practically the ceiling Laws could reach. One step further would be the end of the great universe will.
"So when it comes to true combat power, the Strength I can erupt with far exceeds what a Divine Sovereign Grade being should possess."
"As for my current Rank..."
Daniel understood the divisions of Divine-grade within the Endless Starsea extremely well.
This path split into two branches: the conventional path and the unconventional path.
The conventional path was the broad road taken by the greatest number of people—
after reaching peak Divine-grade, they would directly undergo tribulation and become Oracle-grade.
Back during his trip to the God Realm, why had those Godkin powerhouses not possessed unconventional Ranks such as Divine Radiant and Divine Sovereign?
It was precisely because they had chosen this shortcut, skipping the long process of polishing their foundations.
Meanwhile, the unconventional path was a dangerous road covered in thorns, walked by very few.
From Divine Radiant, to Divine Sovereign, to Divine Lord, then to Divine Descendant, only then would one knock upon the gate of Oracle-grade.
Every step on this path required tempering through thousands of refinements. Every layer required a profound comprehension of the Laws.
By the time one stepped onto the staircase of Oracle-grade, one could instantly become a tyrant among those of the same Rank, fearless before the storms of the first three tribulations!
Very few people walked this path.
It was extremely difficult to complete.
But once completed, one would become a peerless existence capable of fighting ten enemies alone and suppressing an entire region!
And now, the path Daniel walked was precisely this road filled with thorns—
yet also the road leading toward the supreme-grade peak!

sentences.text: Daniel pondered silently.
He would explore that secret realm once his strength was sufficient in the future.
For now, the timing was not mature yet.
He could not act rashly.
At present, he had crossed the heavenly chasm from demi-sage all the way into Divine-grade, directly reaching peak Divine-grade.
After that, he advanced like a hot knife through butter, breaking through layer after layer of barriers in one go and stepping into the realm of Divine Sovereign!
He had crossed so many Ranks, and his rise had been so fast, yet the timing was deeply puzzling.
Even Daniel himself felt profound confusion and unease toward this sudden advancement.
"I vaguely feel... as though I have been swept into a carefully woven net of fate."
A cold light flickered in Daniel’s eyes.
"There are too many events I cannot see through, yet are connected to me, silently surging beneath the surface."
"For example, why did the spirit of the Astral Realm’s will turn its gaze toward me of all people?
Why did it place such a heaven-shaking gift into my palm?"
"And what about Kelly?
Why did she appear in the Astral Realm?
How was she able to see through the critical moment of my advancement and extend her hand at exactly the right time?"
"Kelly burned herself out...
Has she now completely dissipated between the stars, or is she silently watching all of this from some corner beyond my reach?"
Daniel felt as though an invisible giant hand was reaching out from the void, plucking the strings of his fate.
That feeling...
Made even the depths of his soul tremble.
But it was not fear.
It was anger!
Daniel snorted coldly.
"No matter who the chess player behind the curtain is, and no matter how far-reaching his scheme may be, I will make him pay the price!"
"It seems... aside from me, the shackles of the Chaosverse are still firmly locked, without the slightest sign of loosening."
"So my advancement was definitely not an accident, nor was it a coincidence.
It is just that behind this inevitability, there are too many undercurrents I know nothing about."
Daniel did his best to calm his mind.
"Right now, I still do not have the strength to face an existence like that.
I should respond to changes with stillness for now and first count the gains I obtained in the Astral Realm."
Since entering the Astral Realm, Daniel had killed large numbers of quasi-Divine-grade powerhouses and plundered countless Holy Relics within the Astral Realm.
However, with the consumption required to construct his sage rank and complete his advancement, those Holy Relics and the gains from his kills had all turned into fuel.
Still, he had kept the absolute best ones.
"There is also the Basin of Greed."
Daniel thought to himself.
This treasure was Primordial Law Grade.

It could forcibly store all Divine-grade secret treasures below Primordial Law Grade, and it also had a chance to advance one treasure within it by one grade, with the upper limit not exceeding the Basin of Greed’s own grade.
"The Voidbound Grail advanced because of this, leaping from Primordial Grade to Primordial Law Grade."
Daniel pondered.
"The Primordial Law Grade Holy Grail obtained two powerful new traits."
[Space-Time Anchor Point]: Immune to the influence of lower-grade space-time Laws.
Anchors the user within the current space-time, like a boulder standing in a raging current.
[Law Devouring]: Can devour all lower-grade Laws of the enemy, resist mid-grade Laws, and weaken high-grade Laws.
"In terms of secret treasures, I also have the Primordial Law Grade Chrono Temple, which can use the flow of time to assist advancement.
Right now, it is mainly being used by my Starbeast clone, Synros."
"There is also the Primordial Law Grade Imperial Bow Ark, a supreme tool for traveling through the starsea."
"In addition, I still have two secret treasure embryos."
"One is that black stone tablet.
This stone tablet can be forged into a Divine-grade secret treasure, and it should at least be at the level of a Sacred Artisan Treasure."
"The other secret treasure embryo is the Star Relic I obtained while traveling through the starsea.
If carefully forged, it should also reach the level of a Sacred Artisan Treasure."
"These two top-tier secret treasure embryos can wait until I return to the Golden Holy Mountain.
I will find a great Oracle-grade to help forge them then."
"For now, the ones I use most frequently are still the Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed."
Daniel then began taking inventory of his Sacred Arts.
"Right now, I basically have no need for Crusader’s Physique anymore.
Among those of the same Rank, I’m afraid no one can force me to reveal that trump card."
"The ones I use most now are still Immortal Icon, Titan Body, and Celestial Grasp.
These three greater Sacred Arts are invincible in battle!"
"In addition, I created two greater Sacred Arts myself."
"One is True Sight, a greater Sacred Art that assists advancement and allows me to observe the Laws of all things."
"The other is Star Dome Shattering, an all-purpose greater Sacred Art that I have not truly used yet."
"Then there is the newly obtained space-time Law greater Sacred Art—Absolute Space-Time Domain."
Daniel silently thought to himself.
"I do not have many Sacred Arts, but every single one is extremely rare!"
"In total, I have four combat-type greater Sacred Arts.
As for my sage rank..."
Daniel looked toward the supreme sage rank before him, which he had yet to withdraw.
"After undergoing several enhancements and devouring events, my supreme sage rank is already over a thousand times broader than the sage rank of an ordinary sage!"
Daniel’s tone carried a trace of shock that was hard to conceal.
"Right now, its territory is comparable to a complete small world.
Moreover, what I have mastered is one of the strongest Laws in the Endless Starsea—the Reincarnation Law.
Its grade has already touched the threshold of ultimate."

"The ultimate-grade Reincarnation Law has granted me a terrifying Strength: I can freely move back and forth between the past and future, through every imperceptible instant, stacking the sage rank power of those moments layer upon layer onto myself.
This one ability alone can raise the might of my sage rank by more than a hundred times out of thin air!"
The peak of Laws was called infinity.
Above ultimate was infinite!
That was practically the ceiling Laws could reach.
One step further would be the end of the great universe will.
"So when it comes to true combat power, the Strength I can erupt with far exceeds what a Divine Sovereign Grade being should possess."
"As for my current Rank..."
Daniel understood the divisions of Divine-grade within the Endless Starsea extremely well.
This path split into two branches: the conventional path and the unconventional path.
The conventional path was the broad road taken by the greatest number of people—
after reaching peak Divine-grade, they would directly undergo tribulation and become Oracle-grade.
Back during his trip to the God Realm, why had those Godkin powerhouses not possessed unconventional Ranks such as Divine Radiant and Divine Sovereign?
It was precisely because they had chosen this shortcut, skipping the long process of polishing their foundations.
Meanwhile, the unconventional path was a dangerous road covered in thorns, walked by very few.
From Divine Radiant, to Divine Sovereign, to Divine Lord, then to Divine Descendant, only then would one knock upon the gate of Oracle-grade.
Every step on this path required tempering through thousands of refinements.
Every layer required a profound comprehension of the Laws.
By the time one stepped onto the staircase of Oracle-grade, one could instantly become a tyrant among those of the same Rank, fearless before the storms of the first three tribulations!
Very few people walked this path.
It was extremely difficult to complete.
But once completed, one would become a peerless existence capable of fighting ten enemies alone and suppressing an entire region!
And now, the path Daniel walked was precisely this road filled with thorns—
yet also the road leading toward the supreme-grade peak!

chapters.title: Chapter 372 -372-You Want an Explanation? With Just You?
paragraphs: "As for level..."
Before advancing to Divine-grade, Daniel’s level had stopped at Level 599.
Now, it was time to move forward.
[Prompt: You have consumed the accumulation in your Exp pool. Your level has increased to Level 600.]
[Prompt: You have consumed the accumulation in your Exp pool. Your current level has increased to Level 700!]
[Prompt: You have consumed the accumulation in your Exp pool. Your current level has increased to Level 999!]
[Ding! You must advance to Oracle-grade before you can continue leveling up.]
His level had temporarily reached a bottleneck.
Daniel began adding the attribute points obtained from leveling up, causing his strength to rise slightly once again.
At that moment, a new system prompt suddenly sounded beside his ears.
[Ding! You have triggered a special mission.]
[Prompt: A new mission has been added to your mission panel. Please check the details in the mission panel.]
Daniel opened the mission panel.
[Chaos Starfire] (Special Mission)
Type: Special
Mission Introduction: This mission is a branch mission under the main storyline of the Chaosverse—[Chaos Starfire].
Mission Objectives:
Occupy a complete galaxy within the Chaosverse.
Raise the strength of ten million players to [demi-sage] Rank.
Mission Description:

The birth of the Chaosverse is entangled with your fate in a way that cannot be severed. You must seize the chaotic opportunity created by the invasion of foreign-universe forces into the Chaosverse, occupy a galaxy within the Chaosverse, and forge it into your foundation.
Your final mission is to conquer the entire Chaosverse, or burn it completely to ashes. No matter which path you choose, it will bring immeasurable [gifts] to your future.

Note: Kelly has not truly disappeared. She is currently sleeping in a special form within an Eternal Divine-grade secret treasure known as the [Bell of Fate]. In your future journey, corresponding guidance will appear, leading you step by step to conquer this secret treasure until you awaken her from her long dream.
Mission Reward: Clue to a [Universe Fragment]...
After reading the mission introduction, Daniel slowly let out a breath.
Kelly was not dead!
She was only temporarily trapped inside that Eternal Divine-grade secret treasure.
Moreover, the follow-up mission would involve how to conquer that secret treasure and rescue Kelly from her slumber.
"This mission’s objectives and rewards are not simple. It also provides quite a lot of information."
Daniel felt as though a massive stone had finally fallen from his heart.
He then examined the mission itself and discovered that these objectives were actually not that difficult.
Occupying a galaxy was, in a sense, simple.
Right now, the Chaosverse had been locked down by the Laws. The number of powerhouses in each starfield was extremely limited, and their Strength was far weaker than before.
This gave Daniel an opportunity to exploit.
As for cultivating players, that was something he had been doing all along.
Raising ten million players to demi-sage Rank seemed extremely challenging, but with the chaos currently sweeping through the Chaosverse, it might not be impossible to attempt.
"The mission reward... is quite tempting."
A Universe Fragment!
Although it was only a clue and not the fragment itself, it still represented hope.

"If I can obtain this fragment, perhaps I can raise my space-time Law Sacred Art from low-grade to mid-grade. That would be perfect. Or if I can comprehend another new space-time Law Sacred Art, that would also be a huge gain."
As Daniel thought this, he casually withdrew his supreme sage rank.
At that moment—
Boom!
A figure fell violently from the depths of the sky, smashing heavily beside Daniel and stirring up a ring of airwaves.
Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted.
It was Dustin!
Dustin spat out a mouthful of blood in a miserable state, his voice urgent and hoarse.
"Faustus, run!"
"Divine-grade powerhouses and Oracle-grade beings have already set their sights on you. They want to plunder your sage rank!"
"What?!"
Two streams of dense killing intent burst from the depths of Daniel’s pupils.
"Plunder me?!"
Daniel smiled.
It was the cold smile of a hunter when prey dared to provoke him.
The Chaosverse had been sealed by supreme Laws. The Astral Realm had become a closed world of its own, and all powerhouses were trapped inside it.
Every starfield had become a natural slaughterhouse.
Once war ignited, the defeated would have no path but death. There would not even be a direction in which to flee.
At this moment, above the ruins of the Astral Realm, Daniel had become the only powerhouse in the entire Chaosverse who had successfully broken through the shackles and advanced.
He had forged the legendary supreme sage rank, but because of that, countless greedy eyes had locked onto him, as though he had already become fish on the chopping board.
Dustin had risked death to come and deliver this warning.
"Hurry and think of a way to leave! They want your sage rank!"
"They will never let you go!"
At that moment—
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh...
Streaks of light tore through the air from all directions. One powerful figure after another surrounded this stretch of void so tightly that not even water could pass through.
The leading figures had auras as deep as abysses, like undercurrents in an ancient starsea. Among them were quite a few existences above peak Divine-grade.
Meanwhile, the slightly weaker Divine-grade powerhouses consciously kept their distance from this group, hanging far behind in the shadows, cunning light flickering in their eyes.
They were watching, waiting for the right moment, like a pack of jackals that had caught the scent of blood, waiting for a chance to seize scraps from the chaotic battle.
These Divine-grade powerhouses had originally gathered here for the resources of the Astral Realm.
But the sudden upheaval in the Chaosverse had left them with nothing from this trip.
And now, the Astral Realm had been completely devoured by Daniel’s sage rank.
Their emotions were incredibly complicated, both envious and jealous.
They envied Daniel’s supreme sage rank and were jealous that he had actually broken free from the shackles even T9 Oracle-grade beings could not shake.
In their eyes, Daniel himself had already become an opportunity within reach.
"Faustus!"
A Divine Descendant Grade powerhouse stepped forward, a cold smile on his lips.
"You devoured the Astral Realm and destroyed everyone’s opportunities. Today, you must give us an explanation!"
"Exactly!"
A Divine Lord Grade powerhouse immediately echoed him, a sinister light flashing in his eyes.
"And why is it that none of us can advance, yet you can? Could it be... that you have some unspeakable relationship with the existence behind the scenes?"
"Faustus, I am also a living being from the Myriad-Star Cosmos."
Another powerhouse named Wanlike spoke.
"Strictly speaking, we can be considered fellow countrymen. If you do not clearly explain your relationship with that existence behind the scenes, don’t blame us for showing no mercy!"
"Why are you the only one who can advance, while we can only remain trapped here?"
"Also, now that all of us are trapped in this damned Chaosverse, do you have a way back? Or perhaps—you can go speak to that existence behind the scenes and ask Him to give us a way out?"
This group of powerhouses spoke righteous and dignified words.
But the greed in their eyes was like the ghostly light of starving wolves in the darkness.
Daniel’s gaze swept over the group before him one by one like the edge of a blade.
He slowly spoke.
"You want an explanation from me?"
"With just you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 373 -373-Hypocritical Faces, Come at Me Together
paragraphs: Boom—!
Daniel’s words instantly enraged everyone.
"Faustus, you are far too arrogant!"
"I’ve long heard of Faustus’s overbearing reputation. Only now do I realize those rumors were not exaggerated at all. In fact, they were far too understated!"
"Heh. Do you think that just because you crossed the threshold of sage rank and luckily forged a supreme sage rank, you can now run rampant through the starsea without restraint?"
"Ignorant young wolf, the road beneath your feet has yet to even touch the threshold of true powerhouses!"
"In that case, let us show you properly what true Strength is!"
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
The Divine-grade powerhouses unfolded their sage ranks one after another, spreading out like Stellar bodies suddenly rising into the sky, vast and overwhelming.
Among them, the sage ranks of the Divine Descendant Grade beings were the most terrifying!
The instant they unfolded, the lower-grade sage ranks around them were like fireflies before the bright moon, immediately forced to retreat.
Present here were several Divine Descendants and several Divine Lord Grade powerhouses. The largest number, however, were peak Divine-grade existences.
Behind them, even more powerhouses were watching hungrily.
"Faustus... is in trouble."
Jason frowned tightly, his gaze flickering.
He disdained joining a group attack, but he also did not leave. He was secretly waiting for an opportunity.
The innate devouring instinct of the starry beastfolk made him covet Daniel’s supreme sage rank as well.
If there was a chance, he would not mind profiting from the chaos.
Daniel coldly watched their display of force, as though he were looking at a group of clowns jumping around.
"You all leave this place first."
He secretly transmitted his voice to James and the others, a savage smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
"In a moment, I don’t want you to be captured by them."
"Understood. Staying here will only drag you down, my lord. Please be careful."
Camille carried Dustin on his back and, together with James and Mosi, decisively hid deep within the void.
The next moment—
"Chaotic Reincarnation—!"
Daniel abruptly unfolded his sage rank.
Rumble—!
The supreme sage rank, comparable to a small world, suddenly descended. Gray light covered heaven and earth, like nightfall overturning the sky, instantly shrouding this vast stretch of void.
At the core of the supreme sage rank was a blooming Gray Lotus, and beneath the lotus was a boundless sea of lotuses.
Gray Lotuses bloomed layer upon layer, and the ultimate-grade Reincarnation Law slowly flowed within them, like the silent turning of the wheel of fate.
Boom!
Under the devouring pressure of the supreme sage rank, the sage ranks of the opposing Divine-grade powerhouses instantly withered and were compressed to the limit.
Even sage ranks at the same Divine Sovereign Grade had no choice but to shrink their range.
Only Divine Descendant Grade sage ranks could barely resist it a little.
However, the key was this:
The vastness of the Chaotic Reincarnation sage rank was more than a hundred times greater than theirs!
What a terrifying range!
At this moment, the entire scene erupted in uproar.
"What kind of joke is this... How can there be such a vast sage rank?"
"A range comparable to a small world... Is this really a sage rank, and not the projection of some Oracle-grade sacred kingdom?"

"The vastness of this sage rank is already astonishing, but even more exaggerated is that domineering pressure... I am a powerhouse who has stepped into Divine Sovereign, so why does my sage rank tremble the moment it touches the edge of his, as though it is facing some indescribable ruler?"
A supreme sage rank.
Supreme and strongest!
It was like an ancient king stepping through shattered space-time. All things bowed, and the Laws lowered their heads.
Before it, ordinary sage ranks could only crawl and tremble!
"I swear in the name of the stars... I must have this sage rank!"
A Divine Descendant’s eyes burned with greedy flames.
"Even if I must make an enemy of the entire starsea, I will seize it into my palm!"
"The finest of the finest! Could it be... this is the supreme sage rank that only exists in ancient inscriptions?"
"If I can obtain this sage rank, even when facing the tribulation of Oracle-grade, I would have an eighty percent chance of shattering heavenly punishment and standing above the clouds!"
The aura on Daniel’s body was like a silent volcano, rising all the way to the peak of Divine Sovereign Grade before slowly settling.
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, carrying a trace of contempt.
His gaze slowly swept over everyone before him.
"This saves me the trouble of finding you one by one. Come at me together!"
"Let me see just how much weight you so-called powerhouses truly carry."
At that moment, he raised his hand and released the Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed.
The Holy Grail hung high in the sky, silently looking down like a star.
The Basin of Greed hovered on the other side, ready at any moment to devour every enemy that came.
"Are you seeking death?!"
The veins on a Divine Lord’s face bulged.
"We are not coveting your sage rank. We only want to investigate your connection with the existence behind the scenes!"
"If you continue acting so outrageously, don’t blame us for showing no mercy!"
Daniel raised a brow and had to admire the other party’s thick skin.
No, this could no longer be called thick skin.
This was practically a city wall as heavy as the starsea!
Their blades were already drawn, yet they were still weaving fig leaves for themselves, using "investigating the truth" as an excuse to carry out the act of seizing his sage rank.
Truly hypocritical to the extreme!
Daniel was disgusted to the limit, his gaze sharp as a blade.
"Enough nonsense, you pack of trash."
"If you have the ability, then use your strength to make me speak."
"Idiot!"
The Divine Lord Grade powerhouse’s expression instantly became ugly to the extreme. With an angry shout, he waved his hand, and a sword-shaped Divine-grade secret treasure tore through the air.
Sword shadows spread like wildfire sweeping across the plains, transforming into billions of sharp longswords in the blink of an eye!
Countless Primordial Grade sword lights blotted out the sky and covered the earth, like a curtain woven from sharp blades,遮蔽ing the starlight and swallowing the firmament.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Billions of sword lights poured toward Daniel like a storm.
Immediately afterward, hundreds of Divine-grade secret treasures of all shapes and forms emerged at the same time.
The other Divine-grade powerhouses had made their move.
They drove their respective secret treasures to erupt with terrifying might, like a flock of starving raptors pouncing on prey.
In an instant, the sky above the ruins of the Astral Realm had turned into a slaughter field of blood and fire.
On one side was Daniel, in the Divine Sovereign realm.
On the other were many veteran Divine-grade powerhouses, among them no lack of peak experts at Divine Radiant, Divine Sovereign, Divine Lord, and Divine Descendant Grade.
And in the shadows of the void even farther away, Oracle-grade beings were secretly watching, no one knowing what calculations they were making.
Facing this overwhelming siege, Daniel’s expression did not change at all.
He was like a solitary peak standing at the center of a storm. No matter how violently the waves struck the shore, he remained unmoved.
With a wave of his hand, a幽 light flew out to meet the secret treasures filling the sky.
"Basin of Greed—!"

The Basin of Greed suddenly spat out dazzling seven-colored light. Any Divine-grade secret treasure below Primordial Law Grade that was illuminated by that radiance instantly seemed to have its lifeline seized. Its power vanished completely, and it could only be forcibly sucked into the basin in unwillingness.
When the Astral Realm had first opened, only quasi-Divine-grade powerhouses had experienced Daniel’s terror.
Those Divine-grade powerhouses had naturally not had the privilege of enjoying that treatment.
And now, as they personally watched the secret treasures that had accompanied them for many years being forcibly taken away by the Basin of Greed, the pain in their hearts was almost suffocating.
Among Divine-grade powerhouses, how many could own Primordial Law Grade secret treasures?
They were as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns.
Only a very small number of top Divine-grade powerhouses possessed such foundations.
The moment Daniel’s Basin of Greed appeared, it took ninety-nine percent of the secret treasures into his possession.
"Gods above! That is my secret treasure—!"
The Divine-grade powerhouses were in so much heartache that they nearly went mad.
"Faustus, return my secret treasure!"
"How does Faustus have such a heaven-defying treasure..."
The Divine-grade powerhouses no longer dared to use their secret treasures lightly.
Losing even one treasure of such value was enough to cause heart-wrenching pain. Who would dare continue taking them out?
Faustus’s basin was simply the nemesis of secret treasures.
No matter how many came, it swallowed them all, without spitting out even a single bone!

sentences.text: Boom—!
Daniel’s words instantly enraged everyone.
"Faustus, you are far too arrogant!"
"I’ve long heard of Faustus’s overbearing reputation.
Only now do I realize those rumors were not exaggerated at all.
In fact, they were far too understated!"
"Heh.
Do you think that just because you crossed the threshold of sage rank and luckily forged a supreme sage rank, you can now run rampant through the starsea without restraint?"
"Ignorant young wolf, the road beneath your feet has yet to even touch the threshold of true powerhouses!"
"In that case, let us show you properly what true Strength is!"
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
The Divine-grade powerhouses unfolded their sage ranks one after another, spreading out like Stellar bodies suddenly rising into the sky, vast and overwhelming.
Among them, the sage ranks of the Divine Descendant Grade beings were the most terrifying!
The instant they unfolded, the lower-grade sage ranks around them were like fireflies before the bright moon, immediately forced to retreat.
Present here were several Divine Descendants and several Divine Lord Grade powerhouses.
The largest number, however, were peak Divine-grade existences.
Behind them, even more powerhouses were watching hungrily.
"Faustus... is in trouble."
Jason frowned tightly, his gaze flickering.
He disdained joining a group attack, but he also did not leave.
He was secretly waiting for an opportunity.
The innate devouring instinct of the starry beastfolk made him covet Daniel’s supreme sage rank as well.
If there was a chance, he would not mind profiting from the chaos.
Daniel coldly watched their display of force, as though he were looking at a group of clowns jumping around.
"You all leave this place first."
He secretly transmitted his voice to James and the others, a savage smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
"In a moment, I don’t want you to be captured by them."
"Understood.
Staying here will only drag you down, my lord.
Please be careful."
Camille carried Dustin on his back and, together with James and Mosi, decisively hid deep within the void.
The next moment—
"Chaotic Reincarnation—!"
Daniel abruptly unfolded his sage rank.
Rumble—!
The supreme sage rank, comparable to a small world, suddenly descended.
Gray light covered heaven and earth, like nightfall overturning the sky, instantly shrouding this vast stretch of void.
At the core of the supreme sage rank was a blooming Gray Lotus, and beneath the lotus was a boundless sea of lotuses.
Gray Lotuses bloomed layer upon layer, and the ultimate-grade Reincarnation Law slowly flowed within them, like the silent turning of the wheel of fate.
Boom!
Under the devouring pressure of the supreme sage rank, the sage ranks of the opposing Divine-grade powerhouses instantly withered and were compressed to the limit.
Even sage ranks at the same Divine Sovereign Grade had no choice but to shrink their range.
Only Divine Descendant Grade sage ranks could barely resist it a little.
However, the key was this:
The vastness of the Chaotic Reincarnation sage rank was more than a hundred times greater than theirs!
What a terrifying range!
At this moment, the entire scene erupted in uproar.
"What kind of joke is this...
How can there be such a vast sage rank?"
"A range comparable to a small world...
Is this really a sage rank, and not the projection of some Oracle-grade sacred kingdom?"
"The vastness of this sage rank is already astonishing, but even more exaggerated is that domineering pressure...
I am a powerhouse who has stepped into Divine Sovereign, so why does my sage rank tremble the moment it touches the edge of his, as though it is facing some indescribable ruler?"
A supreme sage rank.
Supreme and strongest!
It was like an ancient king stepping through shattered space-time.
All things bowed, and the Laws lowered their heads.
Before it, ordinary sage ranks could only crawl and tremble!
"I swear in the name of the stars...
I must have this sage rank!"
A Divine Descendant’s eyes burned with greedy flames.
"Even if I must make an enemy of the entire starsea, I will seize it into my palm!"
"The finest of the finest!
Could it be... this is the supreme sage rank that only exists in ancient inscriptions?"
"If I can obtain this sage rank, even when facing the tribulation of Oracle-grade, I would have an eighty percent chance of shattering heavenly punishment and standing above the clouds!"
The aura on Daniel’s body was like a silent volcano, rising all the way to the peak of Divine Sovereign Grade before slowly settling.
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, carrying a trace of contempt.
His gaze slowly swept over everyone before him.
"This saves me the trouble of finding you one by one.
Come at me together!"
"Let me see just how much weight you so-called powerhouses truly carry."
At that moment, he raised his hand and released the Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed.
The Holy Grail hung high in the sky, silently looking down like a star.
The Basin of Greed hovered on the other side, ready at any moment to devour every enemy that came.
"Are you seeking death?!"
The veins on a Divine Lord’s face bulged.
"We are not coveting your sage rank.
We only want to investigate your connection with the existence behind the scenes!"
"If you continue acting so outrageously, don’t blame us for showing no mercy!"
Daniel raised a brow and had to admire the other party’s thick skin.
No, this could no longer be called thick skin.
This was practically a city wall as heavy as the starsea!
Their blades were already drawn, yet they were still weaving fig leaves for themselves, using "investigating the truth" as an excuse to carry out the act of seizing his sage rank.
Truly hypocritical to the extreme!
Daniel was disgusted to the limit, his gaze sharp as a blade.
"Enough nonsense, you pack of trash."
"If you have the ability, then use your strength to make me speak."
"Idiot!"
The Divine Lord Grade powerhouse’s expression instantly became ugly to the extreme.
With an angry shout, he waved his hand, and a sword-shaped Divine-grade secret treasure tore through the air.
Sword shadows spread like wildfire sweeping across the plains, transforming into billions of sharp longswords in the blink of an eye!
Countless Primordial Grade sword lights blotted out the sky and covered the earth, like a curtain woven from sharp blades,遮蔽ing the starlight and swallowing the firmament.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Billions of sword lights poured toward Daniel like a storm.
Immediately afterward, hundreds of Divine-grade secret treasures of all shapes and forms emerged at the same time.
The other Divine-grade powerhouses had made their move.
They drove their respective secret treasures to erupt with terrifying might, like a flock of starving raptors pouncing on prey.
In an instant, the sky above the ruins of the Astral Realm had turned into a slaughter field of blood and fire.
On one side was Daniel, in the Divine Sovereign realm.
On the other were many veteran Divine-grade powerhouses, among them no lack of peak experts at Divine Radiant, Divine Sovereign, Divine Lord, and Divine Descendant Grade.
And in the shadows of the void even farther away, Oracle-grade beings were secretly watching, no one knowing what calculations they were making.
Facing this overwhelming siege, Daniel’s expression did not change at all.
He was like a solitary peak standing at the center of a storm.
No matter how violently the waves struck the shore, he remained unmoved.
With a wave of his hand, a幽 light flew out to meet the secret treasures filling the sky.
"Basin of Greed—!"
The Basin of Greed suddenly spat out dazzling seven-colored light.
Any Divine-grade secret treasure below Primordial Law Grade that was illuminated by that radiance instantly seemed to have its lifeline seized.
Its power vanished completely, and it could only be forcibly sucked into the basin in unwillingness.
When the Astral Realm had first opened, only quasi-Divine-grade powerhouses had experienced Daniel’s terror.
Those Divine-grade powerhouses had naturally not had the privilege of enjoying that treatment.
And now, as they personally watched the secret treasures that had accompanied them for many years being forcibly taken away by the Basin of Greed, the pain in their hearts was almost suffocating.
Among Divine-grade powerhouses, how many could own Primordial Law Grade secret treasures?
They were as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns.
Only a very small number of top Divine-grade powerhouses possessed such foundations.
The moment Daniel’s Basin of Greed appeared, it took ninety-nine percent of the secret treasures into his possession.
"Gods above!
That is my secret treasure—!"
The Divine-grade powerhouses were in so much heartache that they nearly went mad.
"Faustus, return my secret treasure!"
"How does Faustus have such a heaven-defying treasure..."
The Divine-grade powerhouses no longer dared to use their secret treasures lightly.
Losing even one treasure of such value was enough to cause heart-wrenching pain.
Who would dare continue taking them out?
Faustus’s basin was simply the nemesis of secret treasures.
No matter how many came, it swallowed them all, without spitting out even a single bone!

chapters.title: Chapter 374 -374-Sending a Divine Descendant Flying with One Palm
paragraphs: Daniel looked at the mountain of gains piled inside the Basin of Greed, feeling extremely satisfied.
"Faustus, return my sacred scepter!"
A Divine-grade powerhouse, enraged beyond control, directly unleashed a Sacred Art and charged toward him.
"Kill him!"
The other Divine-grade powerhouses also roared and rushed at Daniel.
"Radiance of Stars and Moon!"
"Boundless Sea of Fire!"
"Frozen World of All Things!"
Many Sacred Arts gathered into a torrent, enough to crush an entire world into dust!
Yet Daniel’s expression did not change at all.
"Voidbound Grail!"
The Holy Grail suddenly trembled, and ripples spread through the void like the tolling of an ancient bell.
Invisible Law ripples quickly enveloped every powerhouse present.
After its advancement, the might of the Voidbound Grail had increased greatly!
Even peak Divine-grade powerhouses could not withstand its continuous weakening. The might of their sage ranks was greatly reduced, and the powerhouses themselves became weak and powerless.
A sharp light suddenly lit up in Daniel’s eyes.
The more dangerous the situation, the more excited he became.
He could feel the blood in his body burning. Every inch of his skin longed for the baptism of battle.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Daniel fully activated the Reincarnation Law.
His figure suddenly blurred, like a reflection in water wrinkled by the wind.
In that one-billionth of a second, he went into the past and stacked the sage rank power of that tiny instant from the past entirely onto his current sage rank.
Then, in that same instant, he went into the future and also stacked the supreme sage rank power of that tiny instant from the future onto himself.
In just a single moment, Daniel completed the stacking of sage rank power from both the past and the future.
At this moment, the Strength contained within his sage rank was far, far greater than before!
Boom—!
Relying solely on his supreme sage rank, Daniel directly shattered part of the Sacred Arts unleashed by the Divine-grade powerhouses.

At this moment, aside from powerhouses above Divine Lord Grade, the sage ranks of all the other Divine-grade powerhouses were on the verge of collapse, at risk of overturning and crumbling at any moment.
"So this is the Strength of a supreme sage rank..."
Daniel sighed inwardly.
Merely the aura leaking from his sage rank was enough to completely crush powerhouses below Divine Sovereign Grade.
The sage ranks of the Divine Lord Grade and above powerhouses were as stable as boulders, but they were still greatly suppressed and could not unleash their full strength.
"A supreme sage rank... truly terrifying."
Some powerhouses were shocked inwardly. This was the first time in their lives they had ever seen such a terrifying sage rank. They had never even heard of such a thing before.
"Faustus has only just advanced to Divine-grade, yet he has already reached Divine Sovereign Grade. With his sage rank alone, he can contend against Divine Lords..."
These Divine-grade powerhouses had lived for endless years, but they had never seen such a terrifying existence before.
"Star Dome Shattering!"
Daniel unleashed a Sacred Art, and the phantom of the entire Astral Realm immediately appeared behind him.
This Sacred Art had been created within the Astral Realm in the first place, and he had also devoured the entire Astral Realm. That phantom was the miniature reflection of the Astral Realm itself.
The most terrifying aspect of this Sacred Art was that it could be attached to any other Sacred Art, like tempering and sharpening a sword!
"Celestial Grasp!"
The phantom of the Astral Realm behind Daniel transformed into majestic energy and poured into this greater Sacred Art.
At the same time, endless Strength from his sage rank was also infused into it, causing this palm to contain world-destroying might.
Sacred Arts could naturally rise along with the caster’s strength.
Daniel’s current combat power had skyrocketed, and Celestial Grasp was now far more terrifying than before.
That giant palm expanded to a million meters wide, pressing down upon countless powerhouses like a star.
Facing such terrifying pressure, the faces of the powerhouses below Divine Lord Grade instantly turned pale as paper.
"Atone for your greed!"
Daniel’s voice was like thunder.
The giant palm came crashing down, as though the sky had collapsed and the stars had fallen to the earth!
Rumble—!
Countless Divine-grade powerhouses had both their Divine Souls and bodies destroyed beneath this giant palm, turning into blood mist and scattered remains across the sky.
[Prompt: You have killed 531 Divine-grade powerhouses... Ding! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×23.2 billion cubic units!]
The might of a single palm was terrifying beyond compare!
Only a few Divine Lord Grade powerhouses narrowly escaped with their lives, while the Divine Descendant Grade powerhouses were directly sent flying by this palm strike.
Divine Descendants were already infinitely close to the threshold of Oracle-grade and possessed some of the abilities of Oracle-grade beings, so they could still barely resist.
But the hearts of those Divine Lord Grade powerhouses were filled with unwillingness and grievance.
They were clearly a Rank above him, yet in this battle, they were firmly suppressed by a junior who had only recently entered Divine-grade, without the slightest ability to fight back.
Even if such an absurd thing were told to others, who would dare believe it?
Daniel had only unleashed one Sacred Art, yet he had instantly killed Divine Sovereigns of the same Rank, wounded Divine Lords, and even sent Divine Descendants flying with one palm.
This man’s terror was beyond description.
"With the sage rank power of one tiny instant from both the past and future stacked onto myself, in terms of sage rank intensity, I am not inferior to a Divine Descendant in the slightest."
"On top of that, with the all-purpose greater Sacred Art Star Dome Shattering serving as the blade’s edge, the two combined can naturally erupt with Strength far beyond my own Rank."
Daniel understood this clearly. He knew his own combat power extremely well.
The scene of Daniel suppressing this group of sages was completely seen by a group of Oracle-grade beings hidden in the dark.
This time, when the Astral Realm opened, many Oracle-grade beings had also crossed the starsea in search of opportunities.
The special Laws of the Astral Realm determined that Oracle-grade beings had to wait until the seventieth year after this world was born before they could step into it.
For powerhouses below Divine-grade, the opportunities lay in the chaotic and undivided Laws, the newly born secret treasure embryos, and the many Holy Relics.
What Oracle-grade beings sought, however, was the world will itself.
They wanted to directly absorb Law fragments compatible with themselves. That was a higher level of Strength.
However, when Daniel constructed his supreme sage rank, he devoured the entire Astral Realm.
The opportunities pursued by the Oracle-grade beings had also vanished like smoke.
But the eyesight of Oracle-grade beings was incomparably sharp. Long before Daniel’s supreme sage rank had fully taken shape, they had already seen the clues.
Daniel’s sage rank was the top of the top.
It was the legendary supreme sage rank!
A supreme sage rank itself was a walking treasure.
If they could seize it for themselves, it would also be a heaven-shaking opportunity.
Although Oracle-grade beings were powerful, not every single one of them was wealthy enough to dominate a region.
On the contrary, Oracle-grade resources were the tightest.

Because nine layers of tribulation hung above their heads, no matter how many resources they obtained, they would invest them without hesitation into accumulating their foundations, all to prepare for those life-and-death tribulations whose outcome was uncertain.
Because of that, they thirsted for Daniel’s supreme sage rank like starving beasts!
A supreme sage rank could absolutely be seized and claimed as their own.
It was just that Oracle-grade beings still cared somewhat about face.
They secretly instigated Divine-grade powerhouses connected to them to go test Daniel, while they hid in the shadows and watched.
However, after seeing Daniel’s exaggerated combat power, the Oracle-grade beings could not help feeling surprised.
"This human brat’s strength is far more troublesome than we expected."
One Oracle-grade frowned tightly.
There were far more than one or two Oracle-grade beings who had set their sights on Daniel.
This was also why they had not made a move for so long.
They restrained one another. None of them wanted to be the first to stand out and become the target of everyone else.

"Faustus truly deserves to be called the strongest demi-sage of the Myriad-Star Cosmos. After advancing, he has actually become this terrifying. I fear it will not be long before he can stand undefeated beneath Oracle-grade."
One Oracle-grade sighed inwardly, his tone carrying a trace of complicated wariness.
There were also Oracle-grade beings with even deeper thoughts.
Although Faustus was strong, he was ultimately only a junior.
The truly troublesome ones were those other Oracle-grade beings who were also watching hungrily.
When beasts fought over food, the most dangerous thing was not the prey, but the starving beasts standing beside them.
"Let’s wait a little longer. If those sages cannot deal with him, then we will make a move."
Many Oracle-grade beings shared the same thought.
They were only waiting for the right chance to act.
