chapters.title: Chapter 375 -375-A Walking Calamity, Annihilating Divine Lords
paragraphs: Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Those injured Divine Lord Grade powerhouses did not retreat.
Instead, humiliation and rage burned their eyes red!
They swallowed sacred medicine, forcefully suppressed their wounds, and charged back with furious roars.
"Faustus, you actually dared to attack us!"
"I’d like to see just how much trouble a brat fresh out of the cradle can stir up!"
"Enough nonsense. Take him down first!"
Those Divine Lord Grade powerhouses no longer dared to casually use their Divine-grade secret treasures.
Faustus’s Basin of Greed was far too ridiculous. Any secret treasure below Primordial Law Grade was no different from a sheep walking into a tiger’s mouth.
In their eyes, using secret treasures was no different from handing him gifts.
And they were not delivery servants.
Divine Lord Grade powerhouses could cross the Chaos star sea by relying on themselves. Naturally, they were no ordinary figures.
On the path of Laws, they had already mastered several Laws. Some had even touched the threshold of high-grade Laws!
Daniel, however, did not care at all.
"Come again!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Ninety-nine clones stepped out from the void, and every single one unfolded a sage rank at the same time.
"Every one of my clones possesses ninety percent of my original body’s strength."
As Daniel’s voice fell, ninety-nine supreme sage ranks had already spread through the void like Stellar bodies.
A single supreme sage rank was already enough to make one’s heart tremble.
Ninety-nine unfolding at the same time...
That sight was enough to make any opponent feel despair from the depths of their soul.
Boom!
Rumble!
"You arrogant bastard!"
A Divine Lord Grade powerhouse swung his weapon, carrying tremendous force as he slashed toward Daniel.
"Fight!"
Another Divine Lord powerhouse activated a Sacred Art, and lights of every color surged over like a torrent.
Battles between Divine-grade powerhouses were unimaginably fast.
In the blink of an eye, those lethal attacks had already reached Daniel.
Daniel did not even blink.
He did not move in the slightest.
Facing the siege of several Divine Lord powerhouses, he did not even raise a single finger.
"Absolute Space-Time Domain!"
Daniel unfolded the newly mastered space-time Law Sacred Art without hesitation.
The space around him trembled slightly, like a stone thrown into a still pond.
Everything within space-time began to undergo irreversible changes.
Those Sacred Arts and weapons that were about to strike him had clearly arrived like thunder one second ago, yet in the next second, they returned to the origin point before they had been launched.
Absolute Space-Time Domain!
Daniel controlled one minute of space-time around himself, whether past or future.
As long as he wished, he could remain unharmed, undying, and undefeated.
This space-time Law Sacred Art could be called unsolvable!
"What kind of joke is this?"
The Divine Lord Grade powerhouses were instantly stunned.
Their consciousness did not change along with the flow of space-time, but everything happening around them gave rise to a strange sense of dislocation.
It was like clearly drinking a cup of wine, only for the cup to inexplicably become full again.
It was like clearly smashing a cup to pieces, only for the fragments to return intact into their hands.
This bizarre scene was like falling into a dream from which they could not wake.
"Wait, this seems to be... space-time Law!"
A Divine Lord Grade powerhouse’s voice trembled, carrying irrepressible fear.
"What? Faustus actually mastered space-time Law!"
"What kind of joke is this? He has only just advanced to Divine-grade, yet he already mastered a supreme-grade Law? Doesn’t that mean he is already standing in an undefeated position?"
Space-time Law stood high above the sea of Laws.
Even the lowest-grade space-time Law could suppress all other Laws below transcendent.
Although space-time Law could not directly dominate transcendent Laws, Divine Lord Grade powerhouses had not yet touched the threshold of transcendent either!
That kind of Strength was something only Divine Descendants were qualified to touch.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Daniel looked at the powerhouses before him, his gaze like he was looking at prisoners waiting for execution.
The ninety-nine clones activated their sage rank Laws at the same time, crossing the boundary between past and future to borrow sage rank power from themselves at different points in time.
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
Ninety-nine giant palms blotted out the sky and covered the earth. Every palm contained terrifying Strength.
Within their palms, the power of star rivers surged, as though stars were revolving in the center of each hand.
After being enhanced by two greater Sacred Arts stacked together, each palm was enough to completely shatter a small world!
Rumble—!
The Divine Lord Grade powerhouses’ eyes nearly split apart, but they could only grit their teeth and face the attack.
Facing the overwhelming giant palms, they exhausted everything and burned their sacred souls.
However, under the continuous suppression of the Voidbound Grail, they could only use ninety percent of their Strength.
That ten percent difference became the line between life and death at this moment!
Boom!
The first palm descended, and the sage ranks of many Divine Lord powerhouses cracked. They were heavily injured and smashed to the ground.
Rumble!
The second palm slammed down, and the Origins of the Divine Lord Grade powerhouses shattered. Their sacred souls shook.
"Faustus... is simply a walking calamity. He is even more terrifying than those ancient star-devouring beasts in legends..."
"The Strength on his body is absurdly powerful. This is not Strength a body of flesh and blood should possess at all!"
"He is simply a monster that crawled out of the abyss!"
Seeing that the Divine Lord Grade powerhouses were all using their methods to flee, the corner of Daniel’s lips slowly pulled into a cold arc.
"Now you know to run?"
"Too late!"
Buzz—!
The Voidbound Grail suddenly erupted with power. Invisible space-time force surged out like a tide, closing and locking down the entire battlefield inch by inch.
Those Divine Lord Grade powerhouses looked around in panic, only to discover invisible barriers rising in the void in every direction, like an unseen prison trapping them firmly in the center.
"Damn it—it’s a space-time lockdown!"
The expression of one Divine Lord Grade powerhouse changed drastically, fear seeping into his voice.

"How laughable... I am a Divine Lord. Even in the vast starfields, I am a figure who can stir up storms. Countless powerhouses serve under me, and endless living beings depend on my breath... Yet now, I have been forced into a dead end by a junior who has only just entered Divine-grade!"
Another Divine Lord powerhouse gritted his teeth and growled, his voice filled with unwillingness.
"Faustus! I am also a member of the Golden Holy Mountain. If you kill me, you will be making an enemy of the Golden Holy Mountain!"
Daniel’s gaze remained calm.
"Die peacefully."
"Bury your pride together with you in these ruins."
Rumble—!
Layers of giant palms crashed down.
Those heavily injured Divine Lord Grade powerhouses fell on the spot, turning into dust scattered through the starry sky.
At the same time, cold system prompts sounded beside Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have killed 8 Divine Lord Grade powerhouses!]
[Ding! You have obtained 18 Primordial Grade Divine-grade secret treasures! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×22.1 billion cubic units!]
"Hiss—!"
The Divine Descendants who had just flown back to the battlefield happened to witness this scene, and all of them were stunned.
What kind of joke was this?
Faustus had actually cleanly killed so many Divine Lord Grade powerhouses at the same time?
Even they themselves would not dare say they could complete this kind of slaughter so efficiently.
"Faustus... is indeed somewhat beyond expectations."
In the hearts of the Divine Descendants, Daniel’s threat level was immediately raised to the same level as their own.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 -376-A Failed Scheme That Backfires
paragraphs: "We cannot underestimate him anymore!"
Divine Descendants had at least mastered one or more transcendent Laws and could freely travel through the Chaos star sea. They were completely incomparable to Divine Lord Grade powerhouses.
The top Divine Descendants could even wrestle with Oracle-grade beings.
"Die, Faustus!"
Five Divine Descendant Grade powerhouses attacked at the same time with perfect tacit understanding.
Their Sacred Arts were already incredibly close to the essence of Laws.
Every Sacred Art was a destructive strike at the Law level.
Daniel knew very well that Absolute Space-Time Domain could not affect transcendent Laws, so he decisively stopped using it.
He commanded his ninety-nine clones to surge toward the five Divine Descendants like a tide.
"Devour them!"
As Daniel’s strength rose, the karmic backlash he could endure also became stronger.
This meant that his current Law of Causality could already shake enemies far stronger than himself.
At the same time, his supreme sage rank also opened its devouring maw.
That vast sage rank was like a hungry giant whale, greedily gnawing away at the sage rank power of those Divine Descendant powerhouses.
The attacks of the Divine Descendants had already arrived.
Their attacks were incomparably sharp, heavily injuring many of the clones.
However, every injury suffered by a clone would backlash onto the attacker several times over.
And this was far from over.
"Explode!"
Daniel’s ten fingers moved constantly, like he was plucking the endless threads of causality in the void.

He entangled the causal threads of the five Divine Descendants before him with the fate threads of those Oracle-grade beings hidden in the dark, forcefully twisting the nature of causality and turning it into deadly consequences!
Boom!
Rumble!
Explosions rang out without end, like the collapse of the heavens.

Daniel’s clones self-destructed one after another. The world-destroying force of karmic backlash poured back like an invisible tide, instantly swallowing the Divine Descendant powerhouses, who were already in poor condition.
They finally experienced the taste Daniel’s past enemies had once tasted.
That helplessness of watching themselves being crushed by fate with their own eyes!
Pfft!
Pfft, pfft...!
The five Divine Descendant powerhouses spat blood at the same time, like crimson flowers blooming in the void.
They could clearly feel that their once incomparably stable sage ranks, the foundations they had polished over countless years, had now developed fine spiderweb-like cracks.
Their sage rank Origins had been injured.
Who knew how many eras of recuperation it would take for them to heal again?
They had come to seize Daniel’s supreme sage rank.
Yet now, not only had they gained nothing, they had suffered losses so severe that they were coughing blood.
In contrast, Daniel’s expression remained calm, as though he had merely brushed away a few specks of dust just now.
"Damn it... I wanted to skin the prey, but instead, I broke my own claws."
That Divine Descendant powerhouse was filled with regret, bitterness surging endlessly in his heart.
"Retreat! Faustus is not someone we can easily take down!"
One Divine Descendant had already begun thinking of retreat.
There was only one supreme sage rank, after all. They were afraid of losing everything.
Moreover, Faustus’s methods had made them feel a deep chill!
That fear rising from the depths of their souls was even harder to endure than the cracks in their sage ranks.
"Faustus... you are ruthless!"
Those five Divine Descendants were not fools.
Daniel was far too hard a bone to chew. Whoever bit him would break their own teeth.
What was more, behind them were Oracle-grade beings circling like vultures.
If they continued this battle, they would only be courting death.
"We cannot afford to lose. If you Oracle-grade beings want Faustus’s sage rank, then handle it yourselves!"
Seeing the Divine Descendants decisively choose to flee, Daniel snorted coldly.
His gaze crossed over their fleeing figures and looked into the deeper void.
"Oracle-grade..."
There was no fear in Daniel’s heart.
Between his fingers, he held a small sword.
It was the protective item left to him by the T7 Oracle-grade Chanelle, containing the power of that existence’s full-strength strike.
"If you are not afraid of death, then come."
Daniel looked into the depths of the void, his gaze burning like a torch.
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
At the same time,
auras belonging to Oracle-grade beings ignited like ghostly flames in the dark night, cold and heavy.
Oracle-grade!
"Hunters?"
Daniel let out a low snort through his nose, his gaze sweeping across the void.
In the Endless Starsea, no Oracle-grade being was kind.
Otherwise, they could not have survived in that cruel abyss of the starsea.
Oracle-grade was a high position that could only be climbed to by stepping over countless corpses.
Daniel gripped that small sword tightly.
The killing move Chanelle had given him could only be used once.
Although it was a consumable item, the strike sealed within it was enough to completely shatter a great world!
And among the Oracle-grade beings gathered before him, the strongest was only T6.
The gap between each Rank of Oracle-grade was like a heavenly chasm.
If a T6 Oracle-grade were struck head-on by this small sword, they would also have to pay an extremely miserable price!
Above the ruins of the Astral Realm,
Oracle-grade auras flickered in and out of the void, like shadows beneath the surface of water, yet not a single Oracle-grade truly appeared.
Daniel remained alert at all times.

Through the Ivahpin Scroll, he continuously exchanged the Origin Crystals he had plundered for Golden Holy Mountain points, preparing at any moment to purchase one-time-use destructive consumables like the small sword.
He knew very clearly:
Absolute Space-Time Domain was currently only low-grade and could not affect Law power above transcendent.
And the full-strength strike of a T7 Oracle-grade was completely above transcendent Laws.
Therefore, he could not exploit a loophole through Absolute Space-Time Domain and infinitely copy the small sword.
Only after he collected more Universe Fragments in the future and raised Absolute Space-Time Domain to a higher grade would he be able to achieve that level.

"As long as I complete the Chaos Starfire mission, I can obtain information about a Universe Fragment. And my Chronoverse Prologue Codex can sense the location of fragments, so obtaining the fragment is almost inevitable."
"At that time, I can either comprehend a new space-time Sacred Art or have the chance to push Absolute Space-Time Domain to a higher level."
"The reward from this system mission is undoubtedly extremely practical."
Because the small sword could not be infinitely copied, Daniel had to prepare more trump cards.
As long as he had points, he could exchange for anything in the treasure vault of the Golden Holy Mountain.
There was no need to worry about lacking powerful trump cards.
"Faustus comes from the Golden Holy Mountain of the Myriad-Star Cosmos. I wonder what the Golden Holy Mountain’s Oracle-grade beings are planning?"
An Oracle-grade secretly communicated with the others.
"This time, only one T6 Oracle-grade from the Golden Holy Mountain came to the Astral Realm, along with several lower-tier companions."
"Their attitude is difficult to determine. If Faustus is willing to pay the price and issue a points mission, those Oracle-grade beings from the Golden Holy Mountain may very well stand on his side."
"Then are we supposed to just watch helplessly as he sits on a supreme sage rank?"
"No rush. Let those lower-tier Oracle-grade beings test him first."
"Agreed. Everyone contributes some resources and chooses a lower-tier Oracle-grade to try his luck. Let us see what Faustus’s true backing really is."
Every Oracle-grade was an old fox of the starsea.
Otherwise, they would never have lived this long.
They were unwilling to take risks themselves, so they pooled together a sum of resources and handed it to a lone Oracle-grade.
Lone Oracle-grade beings referred to wanderers without any faction or background.
This type of Oracle-grade had always believed in the law of the jungle. Each of them was ruthless and cruel, willing to use any means necessary to achieve their goals!
Very soon, the Tier 3 Oracle-grade Jervash gladly accepted this task!

chapters.title: Chapter 377 -377-The Might of a T7 Oracle-grade, the Mysterious Black Coffin (Part 1)
paragraphs: "Faustus..."
A vicious gleam flashed across Jervash’s eyes.
He hailed from the Astral Corsairs, burdened by karma as deep as an abyss. No major faction dared take him in.
To shelter him meant inheriting the endless backlash of his karmic ties.
Although a T3 Oracle-grade powerhouse was formidable, great powers had no shortage of such experts, nor were they willing to pay such a steep price for one.
"As long as the payment is sufficient, everything is negotiable."
"So let me see just how capable this Faustus really is."
Jervash raised a hand, mobilizing the power of laws without using a single Divine-grade treasure.
Faustus’ notorious treasure had already become famous throughout the star sea.
No one wished to throw their precious treasures into that greedy basin for nothing.
Instead, Jervash directly unleashed a Sacred Art.
A dazzling pillar of light shot toward Daniel like a falling star.
A strike from a T3 Oracle-grade was far beyond imagination.
Whoosh!
Countless threads of causality suddenly appeared before Daniel’s eyes.
They formed a natural web of protection woven by the Law of Causality itself.
Among those innumerable threads, one shone with exceptional brilliance—
Radiant as the blazing sun.
Without hesitation, Daniel activated Crusader’s Physique, converting all of his energy into vitality.
At the same time, every defensive measure he possessed came into play.
Layer upon layer of Divine-grade treasures surrounded him.
"Go!"
Holding the tiny sword between two fingers, Daniel flicked it forward.
The little sword left his fingertips and instantly transformed into an ocean of boundless sword light.
It surged forth along that brilliant thread of causality.
Wherever the sword light passed, space itself was torn apart like silk, exposing the endless darkness beyond.
It was the sovereign of all swords.
Everything bowed before it.
Clang!
The sword instantly split Jervash’s law-infused beam in two, like a blazing blade cleaving through ice.
Without losing any momentum, it continued toward Jervash himself with the determination to sever all existence.
"T7 Oracle-grade power... N-No!"
Jervash’s pupils contracted violently.
At that instant, he clearly felt both his Divine Soul and body being completely locked down.
It was as though a colossal dragon’s claw had seized his very fate.
Escape was impossible.
"It’s over..."
"How could I have been so stupid?"
"Those high-grade Oracle-grades all refused to move, yet I let such a tiny reward blind me..."
Endless regret flooded his heart.
He had thought this would be an easy assignment.
Instead, it had become a death sentence.
"What a pity..."
With bitterness, Jervash slowly closed his eyes.
Had Faustus not mastered the Law of Causality, he might still have possessed the slightest chance of survival.
But that thread of causality had already sealed his destiny.
No matter how he dodged...
He could never escape this judgment.
The overwhelming sword light descended.
Like the blade of divine judgment, it instantly reduced Jervash to dust.
T3 Oracle-grade Jervash... had fallen.
[Ding! You have killed T3 Oracle-grade Jervash.]
[Ding! Obtained Origin Crystal ×12.1 billion...]
"Hm?"
Listening to the system notification, Daniel raised an eyebrow.
"You actually dared?"
"I thought you had some life-saving trump card."
"But Chancellor Oracle-grade’s single strike really erased you completely?"
"What a disappointment."
Daniel felt slightly regretful.
That sword strike had obliterated not only the Oracle-grade himself, but every treasure and resource he carried.
Nothing remained as spoils.
Still...
Over twelve billion Origin Crystals were a respectable gain.
A single protective sword from Chanelle cost roughly ten billion Golden Holy Mountain contribution points.
Converting twelve billion Origin Crystals into contribution points would easily exceed that amount.
In other words—
He had essentially earned another protective sword for free, with profit left over.
Unfortunately...
Such trump cards were exceedingly scarce even within Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury.
Otherwise...
Daniel truly might have considered pulling off something much bigger.
A wave of commotion swept through the hidden Oracle-grades.
So Faustus really had another trump card.
A protective sword left behind by a T7 Oracle-grade.
Even a T3 Oracle-grade had not survived a single exchange before being annihilated.
"This Faustus is incredibly troublesome."
"One trump card after another."
"His depths are impossible to measure."
"The number of Divine-grade treasures he possesses rivals that of ordinary Oracle-grades."
"And he simultaneously controls the Laws of Time, Causality, and Reincarnation."
"Such monstrous talent is almost unimaginable."
"Not to mention his own combat strength."
"With only Divine Sovereign cultivation, he has already suppressed countless Divine-grade experts with ease."
"If he survives today’s events..."
"His future achievements will be beyond measure."
"Fortunately we never made our move."
"A full-powered strike from a T7 Oracle-grade would cost even us dearly."
At that moment, several Oracle-grades from Golden Holy Mountain projected their voices throughout the void.
"Everyone."
"We have just received an urgent transmission from Golden Holy Mountain."
"Chaosverse is about to undergo an earth-shattering upheaval."
"Furthermore..."
"Faustus is one of Golden Holy Mountain’s core prodigies, nurtured with every resource at our disposal."
"Anyone who attacks him from this point onward will become an enemy of Golden Holy Mountain."
"And Golden Holy Mountain fears no such hostility."
"We have received direct orders."
"During the Chaosverse campaign, Faustus’ safety must be guaranteed."
The Oracle-grades of the other factions fell into thoughtful silence.
"A great upheaval in Chaosverse?"
"So... after being sealed for so long, it is finally beginning."
"Golden Holy Mountain has a T8 Oracle-grade overseeing everything."
"We do not fear them."
"But Faustus’ future truly defies estimation."
"Making him a mortal enemy now would be extremely unwise."
"Forget it."
"It’s hardly worth gambling an entire faction’s future over a single sage rank."
Since Faustus still possessed unknown trump cards...
Who could guarantee there weren’t even more?
Besides, Golden Holy Mountain had already issued its warning.
Continuing the conflict would only end badly.
Fortunately...
Everyone had acted indirectly.
No one had personally established direct karma with Faustus.
Things were not beyond repair.
Yet one question lingered in every mind.
Just what was this so-called great upheaval?
An uneasiness quietly spread among all present.
After all...
A scheme personally orchestrated by a supreme-grade sage could never be something trivial.
Endless Starsea
Deep within an ancient starry secret realm stood an age-old statue.
No one knew what material it had been carved from.
It depicted a towering warrior.
The statue looked so lifelike that it resembled not an inanimate sculpture...
But a living being slumbering through endless ages.
As though it might open its eyes at any moment.
Now...
An indescribable power was slowly awakening within it.
Like an ancient volcano preparing to erupt after countless epochs.
Finally—
The statue trembled.
As though awakening from an endless dream.
Vitality poured from every corner of the statue like an inexhaustible spring.
Countless laws intertwined and evolved around it, radiating brilliant divine light.
The stone shell covering the statue peeled away layer by layer.
A burly man carrying a Black Coffin upon his back and wearing a hood revealed his true form.
His eyes snapped open.
Galaxies revolved within his pupils.
They were unfathomably deep.
An incomparable aura spread from his body.
It was the aura of one standing on the threshold of Eternity—
Above T9...
Yet still below the Eternal Sage.
A being who had already touched the very edge of the supreme-grade realm.
"Hm?"
"Someone... has used my token."
"The purpose... the seal upon Chaosverse?"
He gazed toward the distant direction of Chaosverse.
Then casually extended a hand.
Whoosh!
The Black Coffin behind him shot into the sky, transforming into a streak of pitch-black light that tore across the Endless Starsea...
Flying straight toward Chaosverse.

sentences.text: "Faustus..."
A vicious gleam flashed across Jervash’s eyes.
He hailed from the Astral Corsairs, burdened by karma as deep as an abyss.
No major faction dared take him in.
To shelter him meant inheriting the endless backlash of his karmic ties.
Although a T3 Oracle-grade powerhouse was formidable, great powers had no shortage of such experts, nor were they willing to pay such a steep price for one.
"As long as the payment is sufficient, everything is negotiable."
"So let me see just how capable this Faustus really is."
Jervash raised a hand, mobilizing the power of laws without using a single Divine-grade treasure.
Faustus’ notorious treasure had already become famous throughout the star sea.
No one wished to throw their precious treasures into that greedy basin for nothing.
Instead, Jervash directly unleashed a Sacred Art.
A dazzling pillar of light shot toward Daniel like a falling star.
A strike from a T3 Oracle-grade was far beyond imagination.
Whoosh!
Countless threads of causality suddenly appeared before Daniel’s eyes.
They formed a natural web of protection woven by the Law of Causality itself.
Among those innumerable threads, one shone with exceptional brilliance—
Radiant as the blazing sun.
Without hesitation, Daniel activated Crusader’s Physique, converting all of his energy into vitality.
At the same time, every defensive measure he possessed came into play.
Layer upon layer of Divine-grade treasures surrounded him.
"Go!"

The little sword left his fingertips and instantly transformed into an ocean of boundless sword light.
It surged forth along that brilliant thread of causality.
Wherever the sword light passed, space itself was torn apart like silk, exposing the endless darkness beyond.
It was the sovereign of all swords.
Everything bowed before it.
Clang!
The sword instantly split Jervash’s law-infused beam in two, like a blazing blade cleaving through ice.
Without losing any momentum, it continued toward Jervash himself with the determination to sever all existence.

N-No!"
Jervash’s pupils contracted violently.

It was as though a colossal dragon’s claw had seized his very fate.
Escape was impossible.
"It’s over..."
"How could I have been so stupid?"
"Those high-grade Oracle-grades all refused to move, yet I let such a tiny reward blind me..."
Endless regret flooded his heart.

Instead, it had become a death sentence.
"What a pity..."
With bitterness, Jervash slowly closed his eyes.

But that thread of causality had already sealed his destiny.
No matter how he dodged...
He could never escape this judgment.
The overwhelming sword light descended.
Like the blade of divine judgment, it instantly reduced Jervash to dust.
T3 Oracle-grade Jervash... had fallen.

You have killed T3 Oracle-grade Jervash.]

Obtained Origin Crystal ×12.1 billion...]

Nothing remained as spoils.

In other words—
He had essentially earned another protective sword for free, with profit left over.

Such trump cards were exceedingly scarce even within Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury.
Otherwise...
Daniel truly might have considered pulling off something much bigger.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 -378-Using the Chaosverse as a Training Ground
paragraphs: "I cannot completely undo the shackles on the Chaosverse."
"But loosening them a little is worth a try."
Almost in an instant, the pitch-black Black Coffin appeared where the Bell of Destiny was located.
The Bell of Destiny was a supreme Eternal Sacred Artifact, and it was precisely this artifact that had locked down the fivefold essence of the Chaosverse.
The Black Coffin descended, whistling as it slammed into the Bell of Destiny.
Rumble—!
The instant the two collided,
the Black Coffin was violently blasted away. But that fierce impact also caused the Bell of Destiny to tremble violently, producing a clear ringing sound.
Boom—!
Ding-ling-ling...!
The Black Coffin did not retreat at all. It rammed forward again and again, each collision fiercer than the last.
The Bell of Destiny seemed to be angered. Amid its ringing, supreme mysteries surged out like tides, and invisible shockwaves crashed toward the Black Coffin like massive waves.
However, during this violent confrontation, the Bell of Destiny’s lock on the Chaosverse unknowingly loosened by a trace.
That Black Coffin was also an extremely powerful secret treasure. It could barely withstand the impact of the Bell of Destiny, standing firm within the raging current.
At the same time, changes within the Chaosverse began quietly taking root.
Above the ruins of the Astral Realm.
After hearing the words of the Golden Holy Mountain Oracle-grade, the Oracle-grade beings from the various major forces began contacting the powers behind them.
Before long, they had investigated the cause and effect of the matter.
"So that’s it... Someone used Lord Sorys’s token and asked him to take action."
One Oracle-grade suddenly understood, his voice carrying a trace of reverence.
"Lord Sorys is known as the strongest being beneath Eternal Sage. If he is the one shaking the shackles of the Chaosverse, then there is indeed hope."
A trace of expectation flashed through another Oracle-grade’s eyes.
"It probably won’t be long before we can set foot on the path home."
"The waters of the Chaosverse are far deeper than we imagined. If we can leave quickly, then we should leave quickly."
The Oracle-grade beings looked around, as though something in the void was watching them.
Soon, the Oracle-grade auras hidden in the shadows gradually withdrew.
Like the sea after the tide receded, the surface returned to calm.
"The Oracle-grade beings have all left."
Daniel raised his brows slightly, but did not investigate further.
He held a massive number of points in his hands, which was equivalent to holding countless trump cards. Mere low-tier Oracle-grade beings were not something he cared about.
The scene of him using that small sword to kill an Oracle-grade had fallen into the eyes of all the watching powerhouses like thunder exploding.
From suppressing the assembled sages, to sweeping through Divine Lords, to forcing Divine Descendants to withdraw, and finally to slaying an Oracle-grade with a single sword—
Daniel’s series of thunderous methods could only be described with one word:
Terrifying.

Those Divine-grade powerhouses who had originally intended to take advantage of the chaos now felt both shock and fear in their hearts. Yet they could not help feeling a faint trace of admiration as well.
"Faustus... is truly terrifying!"
Vincent looked from afar at that figure standing like a boulder.
He imagined himself in Daniel’s place and could not say that he would be able to display even half of Daniel’s momentum.
"Beyond human ability..."
Vincent murmured softly, his eyes filled with complicated emotions.
"Harris has always been suppressed by Faustus. It seems that was definitely no coincidence."
Jason’s gaze fell upon Daniel, and he did not hide his admiration at all.
"Faustus’s combat power is simply inconceivable. He only just entered Divine-grade, yet he directly reached Divine Sovereign Grade. This speed of crossing Ranks is simply unimaginable."
"What is even more precious is that this is genuine combat power, without the slightest trace of emptiness!"
"His Law Sacred Arts are also extremely unsolvable and unstoppable."
"And his Divine-grade secret treasures are also the finest of the finest, comparable to the hidden trump treasures of ordinary Oracle-grade beings."
"Whether in strength, Rank, Laws, or secret treasures, he can crush those of the same level, and even fight across two great stages. This fellow is truly unsolvable!"
Jason could not help sighing inwardly.
"Even if my bloodline power fully awakens, I may not necessarily be able to defeat him."
After Daniel’s advancement, he was completely unstoppable.
"Faustus!"
Harris stood beside Jason, his gaze burning.
"You have stepped onto that peak before us, but we will not forever fall behind you... Once we leave the Chaosverse, we will definitely catch up!"
At that moment,
an unfamiliar voice quietly entered Daniel’s ears.

"Faustus, news of your advancement has already been sent back to Golden Holy Mountain. Chanelle Oracle-grade has issued a mission ordering us to ensure your safety within the Chaosverse with all our strength."
Daniel raised his brows.
This was an Oracle-grade placed by Golden Holy Mountain in the Astral Realm.

What was interesting was that when he had been besieged by the various powerhouses earlier, these Oracle-grade beings had acted as though they were invisible, turning a blind eye as if they were merely passing spectators.
There had even been Divine-grade powerhouses from Golden Holy Mountain who had joined the siege, yet these Oracle-grade beings had not spoken to stop them.
Now that they saw him advancing with unstoppable momentum, they had taken the initiative to appear and speak.
"I can probably... guess why."
Daniel quickly understood the reason.
He had just advanced, yet had directly reached the Divine Sovereign realm, and had even forged the legendary supreme sage rank.
This terrifying aptitude alone was enough for Golden Holy Mountain to cultivate him with all its strength.
That was why they had issued a mission ordering the Golden Holy Mountain Oracle-grade beings in the Astral Realm to ensure his safety.
The Endless Starsea had always been realistic and cruel.
If it had been another powerhouse like Camille, Golden Holy Mountain would not have spared them a second glance. Those Oracle-grade beings might even have personally stepped in to rob him.
But Daniel was different!
His potential made Golden Holy Mountain willing to pour effort into supporting him at any cost.
Suddenly, that Oracle-grade voice sounded again.
"The Chaosverse is about to undergo a major upheaval. Although it will not be completely unsealed, the loosening of the seal is inevitable."

"Once the time is ripe, you must return to Golden Holy Mountain headquarters. At that time, your authority will be further increased. At the same time, you must also shoulder the duties expected of a Golden Holy Mountain member."
After the voice fell, there was no further message.
Daniel’s gaze flickered, his thoughts moving rapidly.
"The Chaosverse will undergo a major upheaval? Although it will not be unsealed, there may be a chance to escape?"
"Return to headquarters..."
He murmured softly.
"It is indeed time to go back."
"In the Chaos Starfire mission, the objective of cultivating ten million players to advance to demi-sage also happens to require a suitable battlefield."
The corner of his mouth slowly lifted.

"Using the Chaosverse as a training ground, tempering the players while conquering territory at the same time—this serves both purposes perfectly. And now, the small worlds of the Visca Galaxy are almost all in my hands."
His puppet clone had been continuously attacking small worlds without pause. Now, almost every small world within the entire Visca Galaxy had been brought under his control.
As for medium worlds, he still could not act rashly for the moment.
"If I move against medium worlds, even Golden Holy Mountain may not necessarily be able to protect me."
Daniel blinked.
"But the Chaosverse is different. The rules here are rough. The strong prey on the weak, and the victor reigns supreme."
Just as he was preparing to contact his companions—
Boom—!
A heaven-shaking explosion suddenly erupted, causing the entire void to tremble slightly!
Daniel immediately became alert. He instantly sensed that the surrounding cosmic energy had suddenly become active.
It was like a volcano that had slumbered for a thousand years abruptly awakening, boiling more intensely than ever before.
As expected!
The seal on the Chaosverse was being shaken.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 -379-Advancing to Divine-grade, Stepping into Divine Radiant
paragraphs: The Bell of Destiny and the Black Coffin continued their fierce battle in the void, like two colossal beasts tearing at each other.
Fragments of Law mysteries scattered in every direction. Even the aftershocks that leaked out were something great Oracle-grade beings would not dare touch lightly.
The origin of the Black Coffin was unknown. No one knew which ancient existence had left behind this Holy Relic.
Although it was firmly suppressed by the Bell of Destiny and repelled again and again, it remained like a silent, stubborn boulder, bitterly holding on.
The more it resisted, the more restless and violent the Bell of Destiny became.
The artifact spirit of this Eternal supreme treasure seemed naturally ferocious, as if it would not rest until it completely crushed the Black Coffin.
Meanwhile, the Black Coffin remained silent and resilient, like an old beast forced into a dead end, using its last strength to endure everything.
The more Law mysteries the Bell of Destiny poured out, the more the Strength it used to seal the Chaosverse was restrained.
It had to suppress an entire universe while also fighting the Black Coffin. Its Strength was split in two.
Because of this, the shackles on the Chaosverse began to loosen.
As time passed, the Bell of Destiny’s consumption grew increasingly severe, and the crack in the seal continued to expand.
However, the loosening process followed no pattern at all.
Sometimes a gap would open.
Sometimes it would lock shut again!
Boom—!
A muffled thunder-like explosion came from nowhere.
Daniel suddenly sensed that the surrounding cosmic energy had become active. Someone had taken action to shake the shackles of the Chaosverse.
Not only Daniel, but every powerhouse within the Chaosverse sensed that disturbance at the same instant.
"What’s going on? Can we absorb energy again?"
"Could it be that the shackles have been completely undone?"
"I don’t care! I can finally go home!"
James and the others did not need Daniel to notify them. They rushed over from the depths of the void.
They gathered beside Daniel, their eyes filled with surprise, suspicion, and hope.
"According to Golden Holy Mountain, a powerhouse has shaken the seal on the Chaosverse."
Daniel explained the situation in a few words.
"So that’s what happened..."
"In that case, whether it is advancement or returning to the Myriad-Star Cosmos, we finally have hope."
As Daniel spoke with them, he silently counted the gains from this trip.
His Origin Crystal income was extremely generous, totaling several tens of billions of cubic units.
Once exchanged into Golden Holy Mountain points, it would start at several tens of billions at least.
This trip had been an enormous profit!
Not to mention the secret treasures forcibly seized into the Basin of Greed.
[Ding! ...Detected that you sold materials to Doom Guild. Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×130!]
[Ding! ...Detected that you sold materials to Doom Guild. Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained Primordial Grade secret treasure ×65!]
[Ding! ...Detected that you sold materials to Doom Guild. Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×2!]
Listening to the prompts ringing beside his ears, Daniel raised the corner of his mouth in a faint smile.
This was the true opportunity!

Such a massive number of secret treasures would be an excellent choice whether used to enrich the treasury of the players’ combat academy, distributed to Camille and the others for self-defense, or directly exchanged for points.
Simply perfect!
At that moment—
Buzz—!
The cosmic energy suddenly froze!
The Strength that had been as active as boiling water just moments ago suddenly solidified like ice, as though an invisible giant hand had fiercely seized it and pressed it back into the shackles.
Sensing this sudden change, the powerhouses who had just been ecstatic were instantly dumbfounded.
"Damn it! That was way too fast!"
"No, we only just felt it loosen, and now it’s locked again..."
"What’s going on? Is this some kind of joke?"
The forces of the major universes throughout the Endless Starsea had now learned of what had happened in the Chaosverse.
Sorys, the T9 Oracle-grade known as the strongest being beneath Eternal Divine-grade, had made a move to shake the seal on the Chaosverse.
The countless powerhouses trapped here finally saw a glimmer of hope for returning home.
At the same time, a piece of news also began spreading through the many universal forces.
A demi-sage in the Astral Realm had actually forcibly carved open a gap, tearing through the seal and successfully advancing to Divine-grade.
Moreover, the moment he entered Divine-grade, he directly reached the Divine Sovereign realm and even forged what was suspected to be the legendary supreme sage rank!
That powerhouse was none other than Faustus from Golden Holy Mountain of the Myriad-Star Cosmos!
If that was already shocking news, then the battle record that followed was enough to stir up a superstorm across the entire starsea.
Faustus had single-handedly crushed the assembled sages, suppressed Divine Lords, repelled Divine Descendants, and even slain a T3 Oracle-grade with one sword!
Such achievements, such a monstrous prodigy—no matter what era he was placed in, he would be enough to overshadow his entire generation!
It could even be called unprecedented.
Faustus’s mighty name spread like wildfire to countless corners of the universes.
As the battle between the Bell of Destiny and the Black Coffin grew increasingly intense, the consumption of that Eternal supreme treasure also continued to worsen.
Although the Chaosverse’s seal still loosened and locked intermittently, the intervals of looseness became longer and longer.
The longest time lasted an entire day before the seal locked again.
That single day was enough to change the fate of countless powerhouses.
Within the ruins of the Astral Realm, many demi-sages seized this opportunity to forcefully advance.
They had traveled from afar for precisely this moment.
Their accumulation had long since been sufficient.
All they lacked was an opportunity to advance!
Boom—!
Rumble—!
Continuous explosions rang out one after another.
"They have advanced."
Daniel’s gaze flickered slightly.
James and the others also took advantage of the loosened seal to cross that threshold.
Whoosh—!
Dustin’s figure landed before him.
"Divine Radiant Grade..."
Daniel sensed the steady aura on Dustin’s body.
"Congratulations. You finally took this step."
"Compared to you, it is nothing worth mentioning."
Dustin shook his head, his smile carrying a trace of self-mockery.

He had the full support of the Chaos Humans behind him, had occupied the opportunities of the Astral Realm, and possessed a top-tier sage rank template himself. Entering Divine-grade and directly reaching Divine Radiant was already an extremely dazzling achievement.
Most demi-sages, even if they exhausted all their effort, would barely reach peak Divine-grade.
But the one standing before him was Daniel.
Dustin sighed and stopped thinking about it.
He knew that this man before him was never someone meant to be compared against.
Because Daniel himself was a heavenly chasm others could only look up to.
Daniel did not say much. He merely smiled and nodded.
Soon, James and the others also flew over. Every one of them carried the shining aura of peak Divine-grade, like Stellar radiance.
"Brother Faustus, sorry to keep you waiting."
James laughed loudly.
"Congratulations."
Daniel gave a brief reply, his gaze sweeping over everyone.
Camille arrived last, but the excitement on his face was the most intense.
After being shackled for so many years, he had finally taken that step today!
Now, another matter stood before them.
The return journey!
They had already discussed this when they came. Crossing the starsea aboard a Primordial Supreme Treasure would not be a problem.
But if they had still been demi-sages on the way back, the dangers of the Chaos star sea would have been enough to kill them.
Rather than travel under the watchful faces of the sages from Golden Holy Mountain, it was better to cross the star river by themselves.
Now that everyone had successfully advanced, the return journey was finally within reach.

sentences.text: The Bell of Destiny and the Black Coffin continued their fierce battle in the void, like two colossal beasts tearing at each other.
Fragments of Law mysteries scattered in every direction.
Even the aftershocks that leaked out were something great Oracle-grade beings would not dare touch lightly.
The origin of the Black Coffin was unknown.
No one knew which ancient existence had left behind this Holy Relic.
Although it was firmly suppressed by the Bell of Destiny and repelled again and again, it remained like a silent, stubborn boulder, bitterly holding on.
The more it resisted, the more restless and violent the Bell of Destiny became.
The artifact spirit of this Eternal supreme treasure seemed naturally ferocious, as if it would not rest until it completely crushed the Black Coffin.
Meanwhile, the Black Coffin remained silent and resilient, like an old beast forced into a dead end, using its last strength to endure everything.
The more Law mysteries the Bell of Destiny poured out, the more the Strength it used to seal the Chaosverse was restrained.
It had to suppress an entire universe while also fighting the Black Coffin.
Its Strength was split in two.
Because of this, the shackles on the Chaosverse began to loosen.
As time passed, the Bell of Destiny’s consumption grew increasingly severe, and the crack in the seal continued to expand.
However, the loosening process followed no pattern at all.
Sometimes a gap would open.
Sometimes it would lock shut again!

A muffled thunder-like explosion came from nowhere.
Daniel suddenly sensed that the surrounding cosmic energy had become active.
Someone had taken action to shake the shackles of the Chaosverse.

"What’s going on?
Can we absorb energy again?"
"Could it be that the shackles have been completely undone?"
"I don’t care!
I can finally go home!"
James and the others did not need Daniel to notify them.
They rushed over from the depths of the void.
They gathered beside Daniel, their eyes filled with surprise, suspicion, and hope.
"According to Golden Holy Mountain, a powerhouse has shaken the seal on the Chaosverse."
Daniel explained the situation in a few words.
"So that’s what happened..."
"In that case, whether it is advancement or returning to the Myriad-Star Cosmos, we finally have hope."

His Origin Crystal income was extremely generous, totaling several tens of billions of cubic units.
Once exchanged into Golden Holy Mountain points, it would start at several tens of billions at least.
This trip had been an enormous profit!
Not to mention the secret treasures forcibly seized into the Basin of Greed.

Millionfold Boost triggered!
Obtained Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×130!]
[Ding! ...Detected that you sold materials to Doom Guild.
Millionfold Boost triggered!
Obtained Primordial Grade secret treasure ×65!]
[Ding! ...Detected that you sold materials to Doom Guild.
Millionfold Boost triggered!
Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×2!]
Listening to the prompts ringing beside his ears, Daniel raised the corner of his mouth in a faint smile.
This was the true opportunity!

Such a massive number of secret treasures would be an excellent choice whether used to enrich the treasury of the players’ combat academy, distributed to Camille and the others for self-defense, or directly exchanged for points.
Simply perfect!

Buzz—!
The cosmic energy suddenly froze!

chapters.title: Chapter 380 -380-Returning to the Myriad-Star Cosmos
paragraphs: "Since everyone has successfully advanced, let us set off and return."
Daniel’s voice was calm and unhurried.
"It is indeed time to go back. Now we are qualified to formally join Golden Holy Mountain and obtain peak Divine-grade resource authority."
James’s tone carried a trace of elation and vindication.
Their previous registered-member status had ultimately relied on connections.
Now that they had properly stepped into peak Divine-grade, those authorities and resources would naturally become justified.
Daniel nodded.
He had always kept the next mission in mind, so he definitely had to make a trip back.

"As long as I complete the mission, I can obtain a clue to a Universe Fragment. At that time, Absolute Space-Time Domain may be able to advance further, or perhaps I can comprehend an entirely new space-time Law Sacred Art."
As he was thinking, a streak of light suddenly arrived.
Vincent landed before them, holding a scroll in his hand. Between his brows was a faint trace of joy.
"Divine Radiant Grade..."
Daniel’s gaze moved slightly as he sensed that powerful and clear aura on Vincent.
Vera, Vincent, and Dustin were all extraordinary talents far beyond their peers.
The moment they entered sage rank, they had already crossed peak Divine-grade and reached Divine Radiant!
In any era, they would be prodigies capable of dazzling the starsea.
Unfortunately, they had happened to encounter Daniel!
Before his brilliance, blazing like the sun, even stars could only become supporting lights.
"Lord Faustus, the painting you requested is complete."
Vincent’s tone was relaxed and sincere.
"Speaking of which, I must thank you for your guidance. If I had not gained some understanding of unyielding fighting spirit, I might not have been able to take this step."
As he spoke, he offered the scroll in his hand.
Daniel casually placed it into his personal space and smiled.
"This is karmic fate. You painted for me, so naturally you gained something from it as well."
"However, every living being has their own path to walk. No matter how good another’s path or method may be, it can only serve as reference. In the end, one must still walk their own road."
"Your paintings contain all things, embracing rivers and seas, storing the starsea within. This is already an exceedingly vast path."
This was indeed a profound and expansive path!
Daniel silently added this sentence in his heart.
Given time, Vincent’s achievements would definitely not be simple.
Daniel had always had a good impression of Vincent.
The Endless Starsea was indeed ruled by the law of the jungle, but that did not mean one had to kill everyone on sight.

If one blindly sank into slaughter, one could indeed obtain more resources and climb the staircase toward supreme-grade, but one would also lose too much of the warmth that a living being ought to possess.
Whether it was James, Dustin, or even former opponents who had once stood against him...
As long as the other party carried sincerity and goodwill in their heart, they were worth befriending.
The Endless Starsea should not contain only blades, blood, and shadows.
Daniel understood this better than anyone.
Whoosh—!
A starship flew out from a fissure in the Chaosverse, cutting through layers of mist.
It was a Primordial Law Grade starship. Even mixed among thousands upon thousands of Starships, it remained like a lone wolf moving through a flock of sheep, extraordinarily eye-catching.
Daniel stood quietly inside the cabin, gazing through the porthole at the densely packed Starships around him, his eyes carrying a trace of complexity.

The Chaosverse had descended completely into chaos. Countless powerhouses were madly fleeing during the intervals when the seal loosened, and some local forces had even begun migrating their entire races.
"This Chitin Universe that suddenly appeared... really has turned the Chaosverse upside down."
Daniel murmured softly.
"What was originally only a civil war within the Chaosverse has now evolved into an all-out war between two universes. It is truly chaotic—but the muddier the water, the easier it is to catch fish."
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly as he turned his gaze forward.
The Imperial Bow Ark split through the dark currents of the Chaos star sea and sped onward.
Inside the cabin, everyone cultivated in silence. Their foundations at peak Divine-grade still needed to be stabilized.
Along the way, Daniel issued a high-reward commission through the Ivahpin World:
Forge one Divine-grade secret treasure, with a reward as high as thirty billion points!
The moment the news was released, it immediately drew the attention of countless Oracle-grade beings.
Messages poured in without end as they recommended themselves.
Daniel’s requirements were simple:
He would provide the materials, and the forging target had to be at least a Sacred Artisan Treasure Grade Divine-grade secret treasure.
When he displayed those rare materials, most Oracle-grade beings silently withdrew.
That black stone tablet, the Star Relic embryo obtained from the Chaos star sea, plus a pile of supreme Holy Relics—
if the forging failed, the loss alone would exceed ten billion points!
In the end, only two or three Oracle-grade beings dared accept the commission.
Daniel decisively chose the one with the highest success rate and the most renowned Contribution Points.
A T7 Oracle-grade famous throughout the starsea for forging and potion-making.
"I need several years."
After inspecting the Holy Relics, that master immediately replied to him.
Daniel could not help laughing.
Several years...
In the Endless Starsea, this amount of time truly was not worth mentioning. Even a nap could last longer than that.
"Accepted."
He answered, then turned and left.
The speed of the Imperial Bow Ark was ultimately inferior to the Primordial Supreme Treasure Shield of Aegis. When traveling through the Chaos star sea, it also required greater caution.
Daniel proceeded unhurriedly, slowly advancing along a safe route.
During this month, James, Jesse, and Camille successively stepped into Divine Radiant.
Their foundations had already been deep and solid. After such accumulation, advancement was only natural.
However, if they wanted to advance another step upward, it would no longer be so simple.
One month later, a membrane-like barrier finally appeared ahead.
It was the boundary of the Myriad-Star Cosmos.
"Star Dome Shattering!"
Daniel raised his hand and activated the Sacred Art.
The phantom of the Astral Realm appeared around the Imperial Bow Ark, like an invisible suit of armor.
"Break for me!"
Boom—!
A fissure was forcibly torn open in the universe barrier. The Imperial Bow Ark turned into a streak of light and entered the starry sky of the Myriad-Star Cosmos.
Whoosh—!
Starlight illuminated the porthole, and Daniel narrowed his eyes slightly.
"The galaxy closest to the universe barrier is called the Black River Galaxy."
James’s voice sounded at just the right time, like that of an experienced guide.
"The largest plane is the Black River Realm, opened by a T5 Oracle-grade. It is more than ten times larger than an ordinary great world and is also the most prosperous trade hub in this galaxy."
Daniel looked out the window and indeed saw countless Starships coming and going, including ships from foreign universes, a clear sign of this place’s prosperity.
"It is said that the daily transaction volume of the Black River Realm exceeds one hundred million cubic units of Origin Crystal."
James added another sentence.
Daniel raised a brow.
Over one hundred million cubic units of Origin Crystal?
If that went through Millionfold Boost, that would be one hundred trillion cubic units!
If exchanged for Golden Holy Mountain points, wouldn’t that empty half the treasury?
Just as he was calculating this, a sudden change occurred.
The previously orderly Starship fleet suddenly fell into turmoil. Large numbers of Starships abruptly accelerated, desperately rushing toward the Black River Realm.
Even more turned around and fled, scattering in every direction like a school of startled fish.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
One Starship after another seemed to be chased by some invisible thing, brushing past the Imperial Bow Ark as they sped by.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 -381-Everlight Order
paragraphs: "What is going on?"
Camille’s voice suddenly rose.
"What happened? Why are they fleeing in such a panic?"
Daniel and James were equally confused, looking at each other in bewilderment.
At that moment, a Starship brushed past the Imperial Bow Ark.
An anxious face leaned out from the ship and shouted sharply at them.
"What are you still standing there for? The Everlight Order from the Sea of Ruin is about to attack!"
"Don’t head toward the Black River Realm. That is courting death!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Starships fled madly like startled meteors, dragging blazing tails behind them.
"Sea of Ruin... Everlight Order?"
Daniel raised his brows.
James’s expression also turned ugly.
"What! Everlight Order! That is one of the most vicious forces in the Endless Starsea, if not the most vicious! We need to leave at once!"
However—
Buzz, buzz, buzz!
An invisible Strength surged from nowhere, suddenly tightening like a spiderweb and pinning down the void within tens of millions of miles.
"Too late."
Daniel’s mouth twitched slightly.
"Another Airspace-Sealing Formation!"
James’s voice carried a trace of trembling.
Daniel, however, did not panic.
He piloted the Imperial Bow Ark and steadily headed toward the Black River Realm.
"My Voidbound Grail has the ability to break through sealed space-time. An ordinary Airspace-Sealing Formation like this cannot stop me—unless it is an extremely advanced method."
His tone was calm, reassuring his companions.
"Let’s enter the Black River plane first. Then tell me in detail exactly what kind of origin this Everlight Order has."
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark suddenly accelerated, like a sharp blade cutting through dark currents. It left the fleeing Starships far behind and steadily entered that incomparably prosperous plane.
The Black River plane.
The harbor was already packed densely with Starships, stretching as far as the eye could see.
Even now, endless Starships continued gathering from all directions, while others swiftly departed the harbor.
Fortunately, the harbor had been built with spatial-stacking magic formations. Only because of that could it accommodate this mountain-like sea of ships.
However, what filled those Starships was no longer the usual noise and prosperity, but a terror that sank deep into the bones.
"Everlight Order... It’s over. We’re finished."
On a neighboring Starship, a powerhouse stared blankly ahead, as if his soul had already been taken away.
"This is all over... Forget wealth. We may not even be able to keep our lives. If they catch us, even death will become a luxury..."
"Fortunately, this is only my clone. At worst, I’ll lose some resources. I definitely won’t fall into the Everlight Order’s hands!"
"Then what about me? I really have no way to escape now..."
James’s expression darkened.
Daniel, Camille, and Mosi all looked at him.
"The Everlight Order is entrenched deep within the Sea of Ruin. According to rumors, several Eternal Sages stand behind them."
"They have multiple great Oracle-grade beings under their command and can be called one of the most infamous and brutal forces in the Endless Starsea."
"Sea of Ruin..."
Daniel softly repeated the name.

He remembered that sea region. It was located in the deepest part of the Chaos star sea, and only Oracle-grade beings were qualified to set foot there. The Everlight Order’s lair was hidden within it.
"How brutal are they?"
Daniel asked.
"The Everlight Order lives by plundering and sustains itself through war."
James lowered his voice.
"Any target they set their eyes on will be stripped of all wealth, and countless lives will be destroyed."
"That just sounds like a larger group of pirates."
Camille said.
"There is still a difference."
James shook his head, his voice growing even heavier.

"They have no interest in beings below Divine-grade and slaughter them directly. Only powerhouses above Divine-grade have a path to survival... signing a fifty-thousand-year servant contract with them and becoming their slaves. Only after fifty thousand years can they regain freedom."
"What if they refuse to sign?"
Camille asked.
"Death."
James uttered only one word.
Daniel looked toward the harbor shrouded in panic.
"Isn’t there a Black River Sage behind the Black River plane? He is at least a T5 Oracle-grade. Is the Everlight Order not afraid of him?"
"The Black River Sage has already lived for tens of millions of years."
James spoke meaningfully.
"He has lived that long but still hasn’t been able to advance further... You should understand what that means."
Daniel fell silent.
The path of Oracle-grade was one heavenly step after another.
The longer one lived, the closer the blade known as the Holy Tribulation hung above their head.

And the Black River Sage was one of the most typical examples.
He had lived long enough and occupied enough resources, but the more that was true, the more it proved one thing:
He feared death!
"He fears the arrival of the Holy Tribulation. He has no confidence in surviving it."
"So, he does not have much time left."
Daniel said softly.
"What the Everlight Order is waiting for is precisely the moment when he is about to reach the end of his life!"
"This Everlight Order really is as greedy and cunning as hyenas."
Camille clenched his fists.
"The confidence to act tyrannically comes from strength."
James smiled bitterly.
"There is a reason they can run rampant through the Endless Starsea."
Daniel’s eyes suddenly lit up, as though he had thought of something interesting.
"There’s no hurry to leave. Let’s first... wait and see."
James froze.
"Brother Faustus, don’t tell me you’re thinking of..."
Daniel lowered his voice and explained his plan.
After James, Mosi, and Camille listened, they were first stunned, then overwhelmed by deep shock.
"Brother Faustus... you’re trying to snatch meat from the Everlight Order."
James murmured.
"My lord, the plan is good, but we must conceal our tracks."
"If word spreads, I’m afraid our reputation..."
Camille seemed somewhat worried.
"It’s fine."
Daniel waved his hand, his tone casual.
"When the time comes, whether there will even be any survivors is uncertain. Who could spread it?"
Hiss—!
All three of them drew in a sharp breath at the same time.
A moment later, a figure appeared above the harbor.
He was a powerhouse of the Black River plane. His voice spread far into the distance.
"Are there any Oracle-grade beings present? If you wish to obtain a chance of survival, please hurry to the Helly Society!"
"All Oracle-grade beings of this realm have already gathered within the Helly Society. It is the only Strength capable of resisting the Everlight Order!"
After saying this, he turned and left.
At the same time—
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several streaks of light shot into the sky from the harbor. Those auras all belonged to Oracle-grade beings.
However, most of them were only low-tier.
Daniel watched from afar without moving.
"The Helly Society still hasn’t given up."
James said in a low voice.
"That is the force personally established by the Black River Sage. But it’s useless. The Everlight Order has never failed."
"This bit of resistance Strength has definitely already been accounted for by the Everlight Order!"
As time passed, fewer and fewer Starships entered the harbor.
And despair, like a rising tide, swallowed this prosperous plane inch by inch.
On those Starships without Oracle-grade beings overseeing them, all living beings even began to wonder whether they had already been completely abandoned!

Camille’s voice suddenly rose.
"What happened?
Why are they fleeing in such a panic?"
Daniel and James were equally confused, looking at each other in bewilderment.
At that moment, a Starship brushed past the Imperial Bow Ark.
An anxious face leaned out from the ship and shouted sharply at them.
"What are you still standing there for?
The Everlight Order from the Sea of Ruin is about to attack!"
"Don’t head toward the Black River Realm.
That is courting death!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Starships fled madly like startled meteors, dragging blazing tails behind them.
"Sea of Ruin...
Everlight Order?"
Daniel raised his brows.
James’s expression also turned ugly.
"What!
Everlight Order!
That is one of the most vicious forces in the Endless Starsea, if not the most vicious!
We need to leave at once!"
However—
Buzz, buzz, buzz!
An invisible Strength surged from nowhere, suddenly tightening like a spiderweb and pinning down the void within tens of millions of miles.
"Too late."
Daniel’s mouth twitched slightly.
"Another Airspace-Sealing Formation!"
James’s voice carried a trace of trembling.
Daniel, however, did not panic.
He piloted the Imperial Bow Ark and steadily headed toward the Black River Realm.
"My Voidbound Grail has the ability to break through sealed space-time.
An ordinary Airspace-Sealing Formation like this cannot stop me—unless it is an extremely advanced method."
His tone was calm, reassuring his companions.
"Let’s enter the Black River plane first.
Then tell me in detail exactly what kind of origin this Everlight Order has."
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark suddenly accelerated, like a sharp blade cutting through dark currents.
It left the fleeing Starships far behind and steadily entered that incomparably prosperous plane.
The Black River plane.
The harbor was already packed densely with Starships, stretching as far as the eye could see.
Even now, endless Starships continued gathering from all directions, while others swiftly departed the harbor.
Fortunately, the harbor had been built with spatial-stacking magic formations.
Only because of that could it accommodate this mountain-like sea of ships.

It’s over.
We’re finished."

Forget wealth.
We may not even be able to keep our lives.
If they catch us, even death will become a luxury..."
"Fortunately, this is only my clone.

I definitely won’t fall into the Everlight Order’s hands!"
"Then what about me?
I really have no way to escape now..."
James’s expression darkened.
Daniel, Camille, and Mosi all looked at him.
"The Everlight Order is entrenched deep within the Sea of Ruin.
According to rumors, several Eternal Sages stand behind them."
"They have multiple great Oracle-grade beings under their command and can be called one of the most infamous and brutal forces in the Endless Starsea."
"Sea of Ruin..."
Daniel softly repeated the name.
He remembered that sea region.

The Everlight Order’s lair was hidden within it.
"How brutal are they?"
Daniel asked.
"The Everlight Order lives by plundering and sustains itself through war."
James lowered his voice.
"Any target they set their eyes on will be stripped of all wealth, and countless lives will be destroyed."
"That just sounds like a larger group of pirates."
Camille said.
"There is still a difference."
James shook his head, his voice growing even heavier.
"They have no interest in beings below Divine-grade and slaughter them directly.

Only after fifty thousand years can they regain freedom."
"What if they refuse to sign?"
Camille asked.
"Death."
James uttered only one word.

Is the Everlight Order not afraid of him?"

chapters.title: Chapter 382 -382-Many-Armed Tyrant
paragraphs: The Helly Society headquarters.
The Black River Sage wore a fitted battle outfit. His appearance was that of a young man in the prime of life, and he sat upon the high seat.

Before him stood dozens of Oracle-grade beings—some were his kin, some were his students, and even more were foreign Oracle-grade beings who had been stranded in the Black River plane and urgently summoned by him.
A heavy anger and helplessness pressed between the Black River Sage’s brows.
"Since I established the Helly Society and created the Black River Realm, more than a million years have passed!"
His voice was deep like a drum, resounding through the hall.

"I dare say I have handled matters fairly and acted uprightly. I have also done my part for the prosperity of the Myriad-Star Cosmos. Yet I never expected that today, we would be targeted by the Everlight Order. The Black River Realm is in imminent danger, and though I have sought aid from all sides, not one response has come!"
He let out a long sigh, filled with unconcealable desolation.
"Now, we can only stand on our own and save ourselves."
"We swear to live and die with Black River!"
The members of the Helly Society shouted in unison, their voices surging like a tide.
The other Oracle-grade beings who had been summoned remained silent.

They did not belong to the Helly Society. Some were merchants passing through, some had come to travel, and others had been stranded here for various reasons—yet now, they had been dragged into this undeserved disaster.
The strongest among them was only T3. Facing the shadow of the Everlight Order, they could only be forced to stand on the Black River Sage’s side.
After all, everyone knew that the Everlight Order had always stripped everything clean and never reasoned with anyone.
Suddenly, a deep voice came from the void of the Black River Realm, like muffled thunder surging up from the depths of the earth.
"Everlight Order—Many-Armed Tyrant has personally arrived!"
"Black River Sage, are you certain you wish to become enemies with my Everlight Order?"
That voice was not loud, but it was like a cold needle, accurately piercing the soul of every living being.
The Black River Sage’s expression became even uglier.
Many-Armed Tyrant!
A T5 Oracle-grade who had shaken the starsea with his fame a million years ago.
Back then, the Black River Sage had already been no match for him, yet today, he had personally come.
Even more terrifying was that the aura contained in that voice had clearly already stepped into T6!
A million years had passed. Many-Armed Tyrant had survived the fifth Holy Tribulation, while the Black River Sage was still trapped in the mire of T5, unable to free himself.
"Black River."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s voice was like the whisper of a venomous snake.

"I know you do not have much time left. You no longer have the strength to preserve the Helly Society. How about this? Let me preserve the continuation of your Helly Society. In exchange, hand over all the wealth and living beings of the Black River Realm to us."
He paused, then added,
"You should know the consequences of refusing the Everlight Order."
"I hope you can make a truly wise choice! Only then will you be worthy of the title Sage!"
The Black River Sage’s face had already darkened completely.
If he refused... the consequence would be the overthrow of the Helly Society, the slaughter of all its powerhouses, and the plundering of all its wealth.
He had no path of retreat.
"My end is indeed approaching."
He knew clearly in his heart that the treasures used to delay the arrival of the Holy Tribulation were already useless.
Within a hundred years, he had to face that tribulation directly—and he knew very well that he would certainly die!
There was no powerhouse in the Black River clan who could replace him. No junior who could shoulder this foundation.
The Helly Society was already a giant ship slowly sinking.
"Since the Everlight Order is willing to preserve the spark of my Helly Society..."
His eyes flickered, and a cold resolve arose in his heart.
"Then I shall abandon those living beings unrelated to me. As long as my clansmen remain, as long as the resources remain, one day, another T5 Oracle-grade can rise!"
That was right!
For the continuation of the clan, necessary concessions were inevitable!
This was the consideration of a true Sage—all for a longer future!
The Black River Sage raised his head. His gaze swept across the Oracle-grade beings who had been summoned before him, and he slowly spoke.
"Everyone... I am sorry. I have decided to abandon the Black River Realm."
Boom—!
The entire hall exploded into uproar.
Not only were the summoned Oracle-grade beings stunned, even the members and clansmen of the Helly Society could not believe it.
Just moments ago, he had spoken of resisting to the death.
Yet in the blink of an eye, he was abandoning the realm?
"Black River Sage, please reconsider!"
An Oracle-grade cried out in alarm.
"The Everlight Order is cruel and inhuman. Once we fall into their hands, we will be doomed beyond redemption!"

"That’s right! Doesn’t the Black River Realm still have defensive magic formations? As long as they are fully activated, even a T6 Oracle-grade would need to spend no small amount of time and effort to break through! We can absolutely hold out until reinforcements arrive!"
"Sage, you cannot abandon the Black River living beings just like this! Are the Contribution Points accumulated over millions of years to be destroyed overnight?"
Even the Black River clansmen refused to accept it.
"Forefather! How many resources does the Black River Realm bring to our clan every year? How can we hand it over to the Everlight Order for nothing?"
"Forefather, you are confused! Can the words of the Everlight Order be trusted? If they go back on their word, it will be too late for us to cry!"
"Forefather! We are not afraid of death! We would rather die standing than live kneeling. Let us fight!"
"Enough!"
The Black River Sage suddenly shouted.
He suppressed the emotions surging in his chest. His voice was hoarse, yet unquestionable.
"The Black River Realm was created by my own hand. To speak of abandoning it burns my heart like fire."
"But the Everlight Order’s blade is already before us. Throwing eggs against stone will only make everyone die with it."
"My decision is made and will not be changed. Send the order: gather all clansmen and retreat into the core region of the Helly Society!"
He gritted his teeth, and his voice lowered slightly.
"Activate the defensive grand formation... Buy those living beings some time and see whether they can seek out a sliver of reinforcement."
The Oracle-grade beings who had been summoned looked at him, their hearts sinking completely.
Outside the Black River Galaxy.
Several strangely shaped Starships slowly emerged from the shadows of the starsea.
They were warships forged from bones—glowing with a pale light, like battleships sailing out from the depths of a graveyard.
Every bone ship emitted a faint Oracle-grade aura. Those white bones were not ordinary bones, but the remains of Oracle-grade beings!
Forging Starships from Oracle-grade bones was itself a naked declaration.
The Everlight Order feared nothing, because they had already trampled the source of fear beneath their feet.
They were the Everlight Order!
The Everlight Order’s lair was entrenched in the Everlight Sea deep within the Sea of Ruin. They belonged to no universe, yet they could freely come and go throughout the Endless Starsea.
Because they were strong enough!
Several Eternal Sages stood behind them, and under their command were forests of T9 and T8 Oracle-grade beings.
In terms of battle power alone, they were not inferior to a complete universe.
The foundation of the Everlight Order was plunder—sustaining war through war, watering their roots with blood.
They never ceased harvesting wealth and life throughout the starsea, like an ancient giant beast entrenched in the Sea of Ruin, greedily devouring everything that passed by.

On one hand, they used this to cultivate their direct-line powerhouses. On the other, they recruited desperadoes and experts from all walks of life by any means necessary, taking those villains who wandered along the edge of the Laws into their ranks.
The hierarchy within the Order was strict, its rules like iron-forged chains binding every member firmly to their assigned position.
From the cannon fodder at the bottom to the Oracle-grade beings at the top, every link fit tightly together, like a war machine that had been running for countless epochs.
And now, this machine’s gaze had fallen upon that twilight-stage powerhouse in the Black River Galaxy!
