chapters.title: Chapter 383 -383-Ninety-Nine Heaven-Supporting Giants
paragraphs: At this moment, aboard one of the bone ships.
A T6 Oracle-grade crossed his arms, his gaze coldly fixed on the direction of the Black River Realm.
"A million years ago, the Black River Sage was already one of the most senior among T5 Oracle-grades."
"Hundreds of thousands of years later, I have already survived the fifth Holy Tribulation, yet he still remains where he was."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s tone was filled with contempt.
"Does such trash deserve to possess such vast wealth?"
"What is even more laughable is that despite sitting on so many resources, he cannot even cultivate a decent successor. After all these years, he has failed to raise even a single T6."
The T5 Oracle-grade beside him quickly echoed,
"That is only because you are merciful, my lord, and gave him a path to survival. That so-called defensive grand formation of his is no different from paper before us."
"Hmph."
Many-Armed Tyrant snorted coldly, and a cold arc rose at the corner of his mouth.

"The Primordial Law Grade Airspace-Sealing Formation has already been laid. Only a restriction-breaking secret treasure or Law of the same grade or higher can shake it. We will take at least eighty percent of the Black River Galaxy’s wealth."
"Hm? Has he activated the defensive grand formation?"
He looked into the distance. The Black River Realm was now covered in a layer of pale blue light, like a bubble.
Many-Armed Tyrant smiled, though there was no warmth in that smile.
"Fool. My Everlight Order has arrived, yet he still dares to stubbornly resist?"
At the harbor,
the Oracle-grade beings who had gone to the Helly Society returned.
What they brought back, however, was news that chilled the spine of every living being—
the Helly Society had decided to abandon the entire plane and seal itself away in defense.
In an instant, panic solidified into despair.
Yet Daniel’s eyes lit up amid this despair.
"Boss, this is practically fate’s blessing."
A sly smile rose at the corner of James’s mouth.
Seeing that expression, Camille and Mosi shuddered at the same time.
Daniel smiled and nodded.
"Now, the living beings trapped here have only one path left—forcefully breaking out."
He slowly said, "When the breakout begins, we only need to follow behind the Everlight Order and pick up the fruit they leave behind after the harvest."
"In any case, those living beings’ wealth and lives will sooner or later fall into the Everlight Order’s hands. In that case, they might as well benefit us first."
"What is even better is that most of the karma will fall on the Everlight Order..."
"And we only need to take."
Daniel blinked, his smile carrying a trace of delight.
"This is truly wonderful."
The Black River Realm.
The Astral Realm Guardian Grand Formation operated at full power, and the pale blue light membrane covered the entire plane like the final heartbeat of a dying giant beast.
Yet no living being felt reassured.
They all knew that thin membrane could not stop the storm about to arrive.
That was the Everlight Order!

If the Black River Sage were determined to defend to the death, then with a T5 Oracle-grade’s foundation and the protection of the grand formation, he could indeed make the Everlight Order chew on a hard bone.
But the Black River Sage had given up!
He had abandoned his own foundation and also abandoned the last sliver of hope for the countless living beings of the Black River Realm.
"Hurry! Contact our forces!"
"Are there any great Oracle-grades nearby? Request rescue immediately!"
Countless powerhouses frantically sent distress signals to the forces behind them.
"Honorable Oracle-grade lord! I am willing to offer all my wealth. I only beg you to save my life!"
Those living beings without backers were like drowning people, grabbing at every Oracle-grade who might serve as driftwood.
"Get lost! I can barely protect myself. I have no time to care whether you live or die!"
The Oracle-grade being being pestered waved his hand like he was driving away mosquitoes, his face full of impatience.
The Everlight Order did not care whether one was Oracle-grade or not!
As long as one was not a great Oracle-grade, they would rob them all the same.
Outside the Black River Realm,
the white-bone Starships slowly approached. The circling vultures had finally landed beside their dying prey.
The entire Black River Realm was wrapped in a pale blue barrier that appeared indestructible.
If a T5 Oracle-grade were overseeing the formation core, this barrier would indeed give them a headache.
But now, the defensive grand formation was merely an empty shell without anyone controlling it.
"Begin."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s tone was indifferent.
The powerhouses under his command took out formation-breaking secret treasures one after another, like a pack of wolves baring their fangs.
Boom—!
Boom, boom—!
Violent explosions rang out one after another. Firelight and fragments of Laws burst across the light membrane, like fireworks striking a glass dome.
Many-Armed Tyrant lightly lifted his eyelids, his gaze cold as ice.
"A dying struggle."
Inside the Black River Realm, the rumbling sounds rolled across the entire plane like thunder.
Every loud boom was like a giant hammer striking the chest of every living being. It was the sound of death’s footsteps, approaching step by step.
At the harbor, densely packed Starships were like arrows waiting to be fired, their bows pointed outward, energy engines growling low, waiting only for the moment the grand formation shattered.
"It can’t hold..."
"Only by charging out with everyone else can we fight for a sliver of survival!"
"That’s right. We still have some hope. We only need to run faster than the others."
"I have a secret treasure that can tear through the void. I can try to escape with it when the time comes..."
Daniel stood inside the Imperial Bow Ark, listening to the rumbling from afar. His voice entered the ears of his companions.
"Split up."
"I will take one route alone and hunt freely. The three of you work together and target the fat sheep."
"If you see my signal or encounter danger you cannot resist, retreat immediately."
James, Camille, and Mosi nodded at the same time.
The trembling of the realm’s guardian grand formation became increasingly violent. The ground buzzed beneath their feet.
"Soon."
James narrowed his eyes.
Rumble—!
An unprecedented explosion burst open, and the light membrane shattered into countless fragments of light.
"Charge!"
"Run!"
"Hurry!"
Countless Starships poured out from the harbor like a swarm of bees set ablaze.
Daniel, however, stood where he was, his gaze cold and sharp as a blade.
"Kill."
James, Camille, and Mosi turned into three streaks of light and rushed out of the ship.
"Cosmic Abyss!"
James unfolded his sage rank, and darkness as black as ink swallowed everything around it.
"Wall of Guardianship!"
Mosi’s sage rank was like an invisible fortress, squeezing every enemy who approached until they could barely move.
"Sword of Saint-Slaying!"
Behind Camille, the phantom of a giant sword appeared. Wherever its edge pointed, no one dared block it.
They quickly locked onto their targets—
those Divine-grade powerhouses with decent strength and rich wealth.
All three of them had already stepped into Divine Radiant. Working together, even a Divine Sovereign would have to avoid their edge.
As for Daniel, he was too lazy to choose carefully.
Ninety-nine clones surged out of the void like a tide.
"Titan Body, Immortal Icon!"
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
Ninety-nine heaven-supporting giants appeared at the same time, each with the phantom of the Astral Realm hovering behind them.
With every movement of their hands and feet, Starships shattered like paper, and powerhouses were crushed like ants.

A Divine Lord Grade powerhouse exhausted all his strength to barely avoid one palm, but the aftershock still sent him flying backward while coughing blood. The sound of bones cracking came from within his body.
"This... what exactly is going on with this guy? What is he doing?!"
His eyes were full of fear and confusion.
He had thought he was facing only an ordinary Divine Sovereign, but the might of that falling palm was something even a Divine Lord Grade could not withstand!
"I am a Divine Lord!"
He roared, trying to stabilize himself.
But before his voice could fade, one of Daniel’s clones had already blocked his path.
"Die."
The giant fist fell like a small planet descending from the sky.
"Wait! I am—"
Boom—!
His secret treasure shattered. His bones were crushed. His Origin collapsed. His sacred soul was annihilated.
That Divine Lord Grade powerhouse failed to even finish his final sentence.

A T6 Oracle-grade crossed his arms, his gaze coldly fixed on the direction of the Black River Realm.
"A million years ago, the Black River Sage was already one of the most senior among T5 Oracle-grades."
"Hundreds of thousands of years later, I have already survived the fifth Holy Tribulation, yet he still remains where he was."

the Oracle-grade beings who had gone to the Helly Society returned.

I can barely protect myself.
I have no time to care whether you live or die!"
The Oracle-grade being being pestered waved his hand like he was driving away mosquitoes, his face full of impatience.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 -384-Hunting and Revenge
paragraphs: Boom, boom, boom—!
The giant did not pause in the slightest. It turned and charged toward the next target, killing intent sharp and cold.
"Stop! Who exactly are you? Why are you slaughtering innocents for no reason?"
"If you have this kind of strength, you should be using it to resist the Everlight Order and fight for a path of survival for us!"
A powerhouse stepped forward, attempting to stop this massacre with words.
What answered him was a punch!
Like a falling star, it cleanly blasted him into fragments that filled the sky.
"Wait, don’t attack yet. Listen to me..."
Another powerhouse’s knees went weak, and he knelt in the void.
The giant clone did not pause. It simply stomped down, like crushing a speck of dust.
"You dare touch me! My father is—"
The third voice had only just sounded and had not yet spoken the name that might have intimidated all sides when a giant palm had already seized him and crushed him in its grip.
In the distance, James, Mosi, and Camille likewise did not stop.
Three figures crisscrossed through the chaotic harbor. With every arc of light that swept past, a Starship exploded, or a powerhouse fell.
In the blink of an eye, the harbor turned into purgatory!
Beside Daniel’s ears, system prompts rang out continuously.
[Ding! You have killed 100 Divine-grade powerhouses... Obtained Origin Crystal ×13.9 billion cubic units!]
[Ding! Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×4, Primordial Grade secret treasure ×57, Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×80, Sacred Artisan Grade secret treasure ×111!]
"Keep killing!"
Daniel’s voice was cold and decisive.
At this moment, countless Starships were madly pouring out from the edge of the Black River Realm, fleeing in every direction toward the void outside the realm.
They were not only avoiding the butcher’s blade of the Everlight Order.
They were also fleeing from that apocalyptic demon-god-like existence at the harbor.
"Run!"
"Break out! Hurry!"
"Has that guy gone mad?"
"Could he be an insider planted by the Everlight Order in advance?"
Those living beings who were lucky enough to rush out of the realm looked back at the harbor soaked in firelight and blood, still filled with lingering fear.
"What exactly is he thinking? What does he gain by chasing us down? Can he escape the Everlight Order’s pursuit?"
On one Starship, the living beings were filled with confusion and lingering terror.
"Idiot. Even if he seizes a massive amount of resources, won’t it still end up benefiting the Everlight Order in the end? If that isn’t madness, then what is?"
"Are there so few powerhouses in the Endless Starsea who have been driven mad? In desperate situations, anything can happen."
"I actually think they might be vanguards arranged by the Everlight Order in advance!"
"That would explain it!"
Whoosh—!
Whoosh, whoosh—!
Countless Starships surged out from the fissures of the Black River Realm like arrows leaving the bowstring, almost covering half the starry sky.
On the white-bone Starships, the powerhouses of the Everlight Order watched coldly, like wolves watching a flock of sheep rushing out of a pen.
Smiles hung at the corners of their mouths.
There was no warmth in those smiles, only the calm cruelty unique to predators.
Many-Armed Tyrant stood at the bow of the ship, his gaze cold.
He slowly spoke.
"Begin."
With a single order,
tens of thousands of spider-silk-like rays of light rose from several white-bone Starships!
Those rays interwove into a net, stretching across tens of millions of miles, like a giant curtain woven from Laws that suddenly descended.
Whoosh—!
Whoosh, whoosh—!
Millions of Starships were like flying insects crashing into a spiderweb. Their speed plummeted, and invisible chains wrapped around their keels and engines.
"The hunt begins."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s voice was calm, but it was like pressing the switch of a killing machine.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Countless figures poured out from the white-bone Starships. Scarlet light burned in their eyes, like starving beasts finally smelling blood.
Among these powerhouses were sages, demi-sages, and even Oracle-grade beings!
Most of them were prisoners captured by the Everlight Order and forced to sign servant contracts. A small minority were direct-line elites cultivated by the Order itself.
They were like fierce tigers released from cages, pouncing toward the trapped Starships.
"Lorraine!"

A powerhouse watched helplessly as his younger sister was cut down by the blade of the Everlight Order. His eyes turned blood-red, and he burned his life to unleash the strongest strike of his life, blasting that murderer apart.
But in the next instant, he himself was drowned by several attacks.
"Father, Mother!"
"Brother!"
A young woman knelt among the wreckage of a Starship. Her tears were forced back into the depths of her heart by overwhelming hatred.
She raised her head, her voice hoarse but clear.
"I am willing to sign the servant contract."
The powerhouses of the Everlight Order had seen such scenes too many times.
Some living beings chose to die rather than submit.
Some chose to live shamefully.
And she chose the latter.
Many times, only by surviving would there be a chance for revenge!
The Order powerhouse waved his hand, and a pitch-black potion hovered before her.
"Drink it. After fifty thousand years, you will regain your freedom."
He said coldly, "A mere low-grade sage... far too weak. You want revenge? Harder than reaching the heavens!"
Hearing such blunt words, the woman’s face turned deathly pale, but she did not hesitate at all. She raised her hand and swallowed the potion.
She raised her head, her eyes filled with bone-deep hatred.
"Even the Everlight Order does not fear my revenge. Why should I fear them? If I do not avenge this hatred, I swear I am not human!"
"Heh."
That Order powerhouse merely sneered, then turned and left.
He had seen far too many of these!
There were countless living beings within the Order who had chosen to sign contracts for the sake of revenge.
But the Everlight Order had never feared this.
They even deliberately cultivated their enemies!
As long as you were strong enough, even a venomous snake had its use.
Because in this starsea, Strength itself was the pass.
Even Many-Armed Tyrant himself had joined the Everlight Order with a heart full of vengeance after his clan was exterminated by them years ago.
But now, he was already a T6 Oracle-grade, guarding one side of the Order!
The Order did not care what he hid in his heart.
It only cared what he could bring to the Order.
This was the Everlight Order’s ugly yet stable law!
Above the harbor.
[Ding! You have killed 569 Divine-grade powerhouses... Obtained Origin Crystal ×108.9 billion cubic units!]
[Ding! ...Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×6, Primordial Grade secret treasure ×94, Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×156, Sacred Artisan Grade secret treasure ×1,333!]
In a short time, Daniel’s gains skyrocketed again.
James and the others also returned fully loaded.
The three of them landed back inside the Imperial Bow Ark and handed over all their gains.
According to their agreement, Daniel gave each of them one Primordial Law Grade secret treasure and two Primordial Grade secret treasures as payment.
"Are we going too far by slaughtering so freely like this?"
Camille asked in a low voice, his brows slightly furrowed.
"It’s nothing."
James shook his head, his tone carrying an almost cold clarity.
"If we don’t kill them, the Everlight Order will. Rather than letting that wealth fall into the Everlight Order’s abyss, it is better for it to fall into our hands."

"Besides, when faced with life and death, most of those powerhouses will choose to surrender to the Everlight Order. They will be driven as cannon fodder until they slaughter others in the next war..."
"Rather than letting them slowly exhaust themselves in endless killing, it is better to give them a clean ending."

chapters.title: Chapter 385 -385-The True Prey!
paragraphs: After hearing those words, the fog shrouding Camille’s heart slowly dispersed.
He had originally felt some hesitation and confusion.
After all, all living beings were struggling in a desperate situation. He did not want to make things worse for them.
But James was not wrong.
Once they fell into the hands of the Everlight Order, there were only two outcomes: death, or a fate worse than death.
Rather than being driven to exhaust themselves in endless slaughter, it was better for everything to end here. At the very least, their wealth and possessions would not be fed to beasts for nothing.
"If you want redemption, you have to pay for it with your life."
Daniel’s voice was low but clear.
"I am not a saint, nor do I intend to become one."
"If I do not seize resources, I will have no resources to grow, no resources to become stronger. Behind me stands an entire race. I have no path of retreat."
"In this starsea, I cannot protect everyone. I only seek to protect those I want to protect. As for right and wrong—that is something only the weak agonize over."
He paused, his gaze sweeping across the distant starlight and blood glow.
"In the world of the strong, there is no seat for the weak. There is no absolute right or wrong in this world either, only tangible gains and losses."
After saying this, he took a deep breath.
"Kill our way out!"
"While the Everlight Order is still enjoying its feast, every extra bite we snatch is one more bite gained."
The Imperial Bow Ark suddenly accelerated, like a spear piercing the night, shooting out of the Black River Realm.
Outside the Black River Realm, the place had already become an Asura battlefield.

The Everlight Order’s Airspace-Sealing Formation was Primordial Law Grade Strength. Without a restriction-breaking treasure or space-tearing Sacred Art of the same grade, escaping this locked void was simply impossible.

Moreover, this Airspace-Sealing Formation was far from ordinary. It had been repeatedly improved by great Oracle-grade hands, making it difficult even for powerhouses with space-breaking methods to easily tear space apart.
This made the situation extremely troublesome.

The Oracle-grade beings rushing out from the Black River Realm tried to tear open the Airspace-Sealing Formation. Some attempted to break through with brute force, some bombarded it using Primordial Law Grade treasures, and some joined forces, trying to use quantity to break the blockade.
But just as they made their attempts, Many-Armed Tyrant personally led a group of T4 and T5 Oracle-grade beings toward them like a tide.
Some Oracle-grade beings who tried to break through the blockade were suppressed on the spot. Some were forced to surrender. Others decisively self-destructed to end everything.
In the end, only a tiny handful of lucky ones barely escaped alive...
The inescapable net had spread across nearly the entire starfield, like the open maw of a giant beast, swallowing countless fleeing Starships.
Anyone caught in the net would suffer a sharp drop in strength and sluggish speed, like prey trapped in a swamp.

Meanwhile, the powerhouses of the Everlight Order were like wolves charging into a flock of sheep, freely unleashing Law Sacred Arts and secret treasures. When their killing grew intense, they were too lazy even to take prisoners and simply cut everything down.
Amid this storm of blood and slaughter...
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark appeared at the edge of the battlefield like a shooting star.
Crash—!
The sacred ship collided with the heavenly net. Its speed was immediately hindered, and the hull trembled slightly.
"Basin of Greed!"
Daniel took out that bottomless secret treasure.
Seven-colored light surged from the mouth of the basin like a tide, wrapping around the heavenly net.
The net was like a snake seized by its vital point. It abruptly contracted, struggled a few times within the light, and was swallowed by the Basin of Greed in one gulp.
"That works too..."
James was dumbfounded.
"My lord’s methods are truly inconceivable."
Camille murmured in amazement, though battle intent had already ignited in his eyes.
"Time to work."
Daniel glanced back at them.
Three figures flew out of the Imperial Bow Ark like falcons that had scented blood, pouncing toward their chosen targets.
As for Daniel, his gaze fell upon the dozens of Divine-grade powerhouses from the Everlight Order ahead.
"You thought I would only kick the helpless while they were down and target those poor souls fleeing for their lives?"
The corner of his mouth slowly lifted, revealing a cold smile.
"Everlight Order—you are my true prey."
"Voidbound Grail!"
"Supreme Chaotic Reincarnation!"
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Immortal Icon, Titan Body!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
Ninety-nine clones surged forth, each transforming into a Titan giant several hundred thousand meters tall. Every movement of their hands and feet was like stars pressing down.
Giant palms covered the sky and descended with a roar, as though the entire heavens had collapsed.
The supreme sage rank unfolded with them, like a fissure opening in the abyss, crushing and devouring the enemy’s sage ranks inch by inch.
In the blink of an eye, those dozens of Divine-grade powerhouses from the Everlight Order did not even have time to scream before they were reduced to ashes amid shock and despair.
The nearby powerhouses watched this scene with their own eyes and felt a chill run down their spines.
"This... who is this person?"
"Could he be Oracle-grade? He flattened dozens of sages in one move?"
At the same time—
[Ding! You have killed 69 Divine-grade powerhouses... Obtained Origin Crystal ×76.1 billion cubic units!]
[Ding! ...Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×3, Primordial Grade secret treasure ×17, Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×19, Sacred Artisan Grade secret treasure ×175!]
The smile at the corner of Daniel’s mouth deepened.
"After these few waves, the gains alone are already comparable to several years of the Black River Realm’s transaction flow."
"No wonder the Everlight Order chose plunder as its foundation. Robbing is indeed the fastest path."
Before his words had even faded—
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several figures shot out from the Everlight Order’s battle line and charged straight at Daniel, their killing intent sharp as blades.
The leader’s gaze was gloomy, his voice carrying suppressed shock and fury.
"A mere Divine Sovereign dares rampage through the territory of my Everlight Order? Are you tired of living?"
Daniel did not even lift his eyelids.
"All of you combined are not enough for me to warm up."
Hearing this, the rage of those Divine Descendants burned even hotter.
One of the powerhouses suddenly raised his hand. His arm stretched violently like rubber, reaching toward Daniel at a speed that almost tore the air apart.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Invisible ripples flashed around Daniel.
He reincarnated one tiny instant each from the past and future, stacking the weight of those two strands of time onto himself. The might of his sage rank instantly surged hundreds of times.
Rumble—!

That extended arm had not even touched the corner of Daniel’s clothes before it was shredded into powder by the aura leaking from his supreme sage rank. The flesh and blood were greedily devoured by the sage rank.
"Celestial Grasp!"
Daniel struck out with a backhand palm. The phantom of the Astral Realm appeared in his palm, as though carrying the weight of an entire galaxy.
Three Divine Descendant powerhouses resisted with all their strength, yet they were still sent flying by this palm, tumbling several times through the air before barely stabilizing themselves.
In the distance, the Oracle-grade beings of the Everlight Order finally showed shock on their faces when they saw this scene.
"What exactly is this guy’s origin?"
"A Divine Sovereign suppressing Divine Descendants across two levels? Which race produced this monster?"
"Breaking Laws with pure force, so direct it is unreasonable! Even among Oracle-grade beings, I have never seen such a domineering method."
"Wait... his sage rank seems to still be growing..."
Before they could recover from their shock, the next scene left them completely speechless.

He had originally felt some hesitation and confusion.
After all, all living beings were struggling in a desperate situation.
He did not want to make things worse for them.
But James was not wrong.
Once they fell into the hands of the Everlight Order, there were only two outcomes: death, or a fate worse than death.
Rather than being driven to exhaust themselves in endless slaughter, it was better for everything to end here.
At the very least, their wealth and possessions would not be fed to beasts for nothing.
"If you want redemption, you have to pay for it with your life."

chapters.title: Chapter 386 -386-Retreat? Fight Another Round!
paragraphs: "This is the gift I prepared for you!"
A fierce light suddenly bloomed in Daniel’s eyes.
A token appeared in his hand out of thin air.

It was a slaughter-type secret treasure he had exchanged from the Golden Holy Mountain treasury using several billion points. Its might was no weaker than the small sword Chanelle Oracle-grade had gifted him!
"Embrace death!"
He swung his arm and threw it. The token transformed into a streak of light and shot forward.
"Roar—!"
The instant the light surged, a strange beast stepped out from the void.
Its entire body was covered in snow-white fur. Eight unfurled wings blotted out the sky, and its four thick legs were like stone pillars propping up the heavens.

The beast roared and pounced toward those miserable Divine Descendants. It swallowed one with each bite, like a bird of prey pecking at field mice. In the blink of an eye, several of them were devoured.
Whoosh!
At that moment,
an incomparably sharp saber light tore through the void without warning, like a slash cut from the depths of fate itself. It accurately swept across the beast’s neck and severed its head!
The enormous beast head tumbled into the stardust, while its body shattered apart like a collapsing mountain.
Many-Armed Tyrant stepped out from the void, his expression incomparably gloomy.
Behind him, arms spread out like vines crawling from the abyss. Every hand either held a different secret treasure or gathered a Law Sacred Art.
That saber strike just now had merely been casually swung by one of those arms.
"A bunch of trash. You cannot even deal with one Divine Sovereign."
His voice was not loud, but it swept past like a cold wind, chilling the backs of the Oracle-grade beings.
He slowly narrowed his eyes, locking his gaze on Daniel.
"As for you—you are dead."
The countless arms behind him moved like a peacock spreading its tail, or like the wings of death itself.
Daniel merely sneered.
[Ding! You have killed 5 Divine Descendants... Obtained Origin Crystal ×16.9 billion cubic units!]

[Ding! ...Detected selling behavior. Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×1, Primordial Grade secret treasure ×4, Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×13, Sacred Artisan Grade secret treasure ×25!]
Not only had he forcefully seized the Everlight Order’s heavenly net, he had also crushed a large number of Order Divine-grade powerhouses with one palm.
Now, he had used that slaughter token to send several Divine Descendants on their way!
The good things dropped by those Divine Descendants had clearly been accumulated from previous plundering.
But now, all of it had fallen into Daniel’s hands.
Being high-profile would naturally attract predators!
Many-Armed Tyrant had personally entered the battlefield!
"No matter what your identity is, you will stay here today."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s voice was icy.
The countless arms behind him moved in unison, unleashing countless Law Sacred Arts and secret treasures like a torrential storm.
But Daniel had already withdrawn his clones and sage rank, returning to the Imperial Bow Ark.
He closed his hand and crushed an Oracle-grade secret treasure.
It was a one-time supreme treasure condensed from the will and Strength of a great Oracle-grade, usable for offense, defense, support, or breaking restrictions.
Ordinary powerhouses might not see even one in their entire lives, but Daniel had casually exchanged for several as reserves using points.
The instant the secret treasure shattered, a deep light bloomed from Daniel’s palm and enveloped the entire Imperial Bow Ark in the blink of an eye.
Many-Armed Tyrant’s overwhelming attacks crashed against the light curtain like a flood striking bedrock. Waves splashed everywhere, yet the barrier did not move in the slightest.
"Oracle-grade secret treasure?!"
Many-Armed Tyrant’s eyelids twitched violently, and his expression darkened.
He could tell that the level of that defense had been personally condensed by at least a T7 or higher Oracle-grade.
"This brat... seems to have quite the background!"
Daniel sat inside the ship, the corner of his mouth slightly raised, though his eyes carried a trace of coldness.
"A one-time T8 Oracle-grade treasure cost me over ten billion points. Without great Oracle-grade strength, don’t even think about shaking it."
Many-Armed Tyrant was only T6, still one step away from great Oracle-grade, so naturally he could not break through that barrier.
Daniel did not linger in battle. He recalled James, Mosi, and Camille.
"Brother Faustus, are we retreating?"
James looked toward the densely packed Everlight Order powerhouses in the distance, his tone carrying a trace of unease.
"Retreat?"
Daniel laughed, but a brighter light burned in his eyes.
"Why retreat?"
"Let’s keep playing with them."
He piloted the Imperial Bow Ark and plunged once more into the most crowded and violently contested area of the battlefield.
That was also where the Everlight Order powerhouses were most concentrated.

Tens of thousands of living beings were tangled together in slaughter within that stretch of void. Streams of secret treasure light crossed and fell like star rain, while the rumbling collisions of Law Sacred Arts shook the entire starry sky.
This battlefield had become purgatory!
The Imperial Bow Ark charged into it like a giant stone smashing into the center of a lake, instantly drawing countless gazes.
"Basin of Greed!"
Wherever the seven-colored light passed, every secret treasure touched by the light was sucked into the basin without the slightest ability to resist.
"My sacred sword!"
"Damn it! What the hell is that thing?!"
"Stop! Stop right now!"
Countless roars and wails intertwined, but none could stop the Basin of Greed from harvesting the sky full of secret treasures like a whale swallowing the sea.
In just a short moment, more than ten thousand Divine-grade secret treasures all fell into the basin.
Daniel withdrew the Basin of Greed, and his Sacred Art unfolded immediately after.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
That giant palm that blotted out the sky appeared once again, descending like the collapse of the heavens.
The phantom of the Astral Realm burned behind him, and Law power poured into the palm.
Rumble—!
Where the giant palm fell, the figures of tens of thousands of living beings toppled like wheat.
Only a small number of Oracle-grade beings and Divine Descendants barely survived, while every powerhouse below Divine Lord Grade had their souls destroyed in an instant.
The number of living beings on the entire battlefield was suddenly reduced by ninety percent!
At the same time, tsunami-like system prompts exploded beside Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have killed 16,494 powerhouses... Obtained Origin Crystal ×196 billion cubic units!]

[Ding! ...Detected selling behavior. Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained Primordial Law Grade secret treasure ×4, Primordial Grade secret treasure ×246, Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure ×1,940, Sacred Artisan Grade secret treasure ×3,451!]
The system prompts continued for a long time.
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
This wave was an insane profit!
"Hahaha, that’s about enough. Let’s switch battlefields!"
He suddenly turned his head, his gaze sweeping behind him.
In just a short while, Many-Armed Tyrant had already chased after him.
Sacred Art Laws filled the sky like a furious tide, smashing against the Imperial Bow Ark, yet they failed to leave even a white mark on the hull.
Daniel sneered, leisurely steering the sacred ship around with the calm ease of someone taking a stroll after dinner, then plunged once again into the chaotic starsea to continue hunting.
Many-Armed Tyrant was so furious that the Laws around him trembled.
A dignified T6 Oracle-grade, the infamous tyrant of the Everlight Order, had actually been toyed with by a junior.
Where was he supposed to put his face?
And what made him even more furious was that the brat was actually refusing to leave!?

chapters.title: Chapter 387 -387-Who Is Robbing Whom?
paragraphs: "Hahaha... Brother Faustus, you really know how to play!"
"The Everlight Order robs others, and we rob them along with everyone else—this is what thrill really means!"
James watched Many-Armed Tyrant rage with his heart pounding, yet he was also extremely excited.
Provoking a T6 Oracle-grade to his face was something he would not dare do even in his dreams!
Buzz—!
The Imperial Bow Ark was like a silver-scaled fish. With a fierce flick of its tail, it darted toward another battlefield packed with powerhouses.
Daniel always struck where the prey was fattest, precise as a hunting falcon.
Wherever Divine-grade treasures gathered densely, the light of the Basin of Greed would spray out.
That light swept across like a sickle cutting through wheat, harvesting madly!
Immediately after,
Star Dome Shattering, sage rank reincarnation, Celestial Grasp, and several other greater Sacred Arts poured down in turns like a thunderstorm!
He struck and left, clean and efficient as autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves.
He came and went in only a few minutes, but the gains were so rich that they made one’s heart race.
So, every time Many-Armed Tyrant arrived in a towering fury, Daniel had already swaggered away with his spoils, leaving behind only a ruined mess and Everlight believers staring at one another.
The Imperial Bow Ark slipped through this chaotic starsea like a slippery loach, stirring the Everlight Order’s originally airtight plundering formation into complete chaos.
According to the Everlight Order’s script, this should have been an incredibly satisfying raid!
But once Daniel interfered, the entire scene changed sharply.
The hunt was forcibly turned into a farce.
The robbed Everlight powerhouses even developed an absurd illusion in their hearts.
"Who exactly is playing the role of the plunderer?"
Their voices carried a rare daze.
"Is it us, or that ghost-like intruder?"
"Why... do I feel like we are the ones being looted?"
One powerhouse’s voice was dry.
"Who exactly is this guy?"
"His actions are blatant mockery of our Everlight Order!"
Many-Armed Tyrant was so furious that the Law power within him boiled like magma.
The Imperial Bow Ark was a Primordial Law Grade flying treasure. In terms of speed, it far surpassed Many-Armed Tyrant.

Moreover, the blockade of the heavenly net was no different from nothing to Daniel. Many-Armed Tyrant could only watch helplessly as Daniel came and went, like watching a fly buzzing before his eyes yet being unable to swat it.
Powerless!
Many-Armed Tyrant had not tasted this feeling in hundreds of thousands of years.
"That should be enough."
Daniel suddenly grinned.
"The Everlight Order will probably hate us to the bone after this."
"They have planted many hidden agents in other universes too."
James’s tone carried caution.
"We’ll need to be more careful in the future."
"It’s fine."
Daniel waved casually, unconcerned.
"Once we return to the Canaan starfield, let them try touching us."
The Canaan starfield was Golden Holy Mountain’s foundation.
Golden Holy Mountain’s roots there were deep, its heritage unfathomable.
Even a colossal force as lawless as the Everlight Order would not easily start a war there.
The reason Daniel dared to act so wantonly now was mostly thanks to Golden Holy Mountain’s Ivahpin World.
Only after advancing to Divine Sovereign did he understand how enormous the price was to construct a special space like the Ivahpin World!
This was not something a T9 Oracle-grade could accomplish.
Such a special space had to have been built by an Eternal Sage at the very least, and it could even be entered and exited freely regardless of any special situation!

During the time he was trapped in the Chaosverse, he had relied on this special world to continuously exchange his plundered gains for points, then use those points to empty Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury.
With points in hand, it was equivalent to holding the accumulated wealth of countless powerhouses over countless billions of years.
That was why he dared to directly clash with the Everlight Order and even rob them in return!
Although the Everlight Order was fierce, it was not rooted in any one universe.
Their lair was far away in the Everlight Sea. Every expedition consisted of plundering legions sent out one after another, led by T6 Oracle-grade beings.
Under normal circumstances, they would not easily provoke a T5 Oracle-grade either.

The Black River Sage was an exception. The Everlight Order had grasped his weakness. He only wanted to leave some foundation for his clan and was unwilling to fight to mutual destruction. That was why the Order had been able to break the formation and slaughter so easily.
But Daniel was different.

Relying on the Millionfold Boost system, he exchanged massive amounts of supreme resources for points, then used points to buy treasures, then converted treasures back into resources, creating a snowballing cycle.
Now, he had made an enormous profit.
It was time to stop.
"Withdraw!"
Daniel pushed the Imperial Bow Ark’s power to its limit, preparing to tear through the void.
However, the Everlight Order’s Airspace-Sealing Formation was not easy to break through.
"This magic formation is not simple. It will take some time."
Daniel poured energy into it continuously. The Imperial Bow Ark hovered in the starry sky, slowly prying open a tiny crack at the edge of the Airspace-Sealing Formation.
"At least two minutes are needed!"
Daniel raised his brow.
Before his words had faded—
Whoosh!
Many-Armed Tyrant appeared not far away, a cold sneer hanging from the corner of his mouth.
"Now you want to leave?"
"Heh... you are not going anywhere."
Boom—!
The aura of a T6 Oracle-grade suddenly erupted, and Law Sacred Arts poured down upon the Imperial Bow Ark like a violent storm.
The sacred ship was struck violently, and the space-breaking process was forcibly interrupted.
"Voidbound Grail!"
Daniel still had a second space-breaking treasure. The Holy Grail suddenly flew out, Law ripples spreading like water across a pond as it fully tore at the Airspace-Sealing Formation.
As another Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure, it had the ability to break the seal, but still required time.
"Ridiculous!"
Many-Armed Tyrant’s expression was icy.
"I may not be able to break this turtle shell, but I can keep you trapped!"
Boom, boom, boom—!
He suppressed the Voidbound Grail while reinforcing the Airspace-Sealing Formation, sharply increasing the difficulty of breaking through space.
"In the name of the gods..."
James could not help cursing.
"This old bastard just won’t go away!"
After all, if a T6 Oracle-grade was determined to entangle them, it was indeed troublesome.
"Small problem."
Daniel did not panic. His palm closed around an Oracle-grade secret treasure.
It contained a full-strength strike from a T7 Oracle-grade, and had once again cost him over ten billion points!
But compared to this heaven-shaking harvest, it was only a necessary expense.
"Many-Armed Tyrant!"
Daniel suddenly called out.
"Oh?"
A trace of mockery rose at the corner of Many-Armed Tyrant’s mouth.
"What, you want to negoti—"
Before he could finish speaking—
Crack!
At that instant, Daniel crushed the secret treasure without hesitation!
Boom—!
The void suddenly froze.
A long spear as black as night manifested out of thin air.
The spear shaft was entirely ink-black, so heavy it seemed capable of swallowing all starlight, while the spear tip was crimson as blood.
It was as though it had been repeatedly soaked in the blood of countless vengeful souls. Its solidified killing intent had condensed into substance, trembling faintly upon the spear tip.

An overwhelming pressure spread from the spear body. Numerous transcendent Laws wrapped around it like vines, each emitting an aura that chilled the heart. Space itself let out faint groans beneath that pressure.
It was the projection of a certain T7 Oracle-grade’s natal Sacred Artifact!

chapters.title: Chapter 388 -388-Losing Both the Bait and the Catch
paragraphs: Whoosh—!

The long spear transformed into a blood-colored streak of light that tore through the void, shooting straight toward Many-Armed Tyrant. Along its path, space was plowed open into a charred black rift that refused to heal for a long time.
"Oracle-grade secret treasure..."
Many-Armed Tyrant’s mouth twitched, leaving him speechless.
This was already the third time!
The first time was a ferocious strange beast carrying the full-power strike of a T5 Oracle-grade.
The second was a defensive light sphere, a protective secret treasure of a T8 Oracle-grade.
And now, another long spear—a T7 attack treasure!
Any one of these would be enough to bankrupt an ordinary Divine Descendant, yet this brat threw them out one after another like candy.
"Absurd! Completely absurd!"
The fury in Many-Armed Tyrant’s heart nearly burned through his chest.
"Even I don’t have many Oracle-grade secret treasures, yet a Divine Sovereign is wholesaling them here?!"
Cursing was one thing, but he knew the weight of this spear.
A full-power strike from a T7 Oracle-grade was something he absolutely did not dare take head-on.
He wanted to dodge, but discovered that he had already been locked onto by the spear. No matter which direction he tried to escape, the spear tip followed him like a shadow.
He wanted to tear space apart and flee, but the surrounding void had long since been compressed as solid as iron. He could not pry open even the slightest crack.
"Damn it!"
Many-Armed Tyrant gritted his teeth so hard his molars nearly shattered and mobilized all his Strength.
Law Sacred Arts surged out like tides. Secret treasures layered one after another before him as he desperately braced himself against this world-destroying strike.
Boom—!
The long spear turned into a flash and arrived in an instant.
Like a blade of judgment cleaving down from the heavens, it fiercely pierced into Many-Armed Tyrant’s defenses.

In that instant, golden light exploded. Secret treasures shattered one after another like firecrackers. Under the spear light, Law Sacred Arts were like paper curtains, collapsing at a touch without even managing the slightest obstruction.

The countless arm phantoms behind Many-Armed Tyrant were also severed one by one by the spear edge. More than half broke apart with crackling sounds, broken arms and severed limbs scattering through the void like dead branches.
Pfft—!
Many-Armed Tyrant was blasted tens of thousands of miles away. He smashed through three small meteoroids along the way before barely stabilizing himself.
He opened his mouth and spat out a large mouthful of blood, his face terrifyingly pale.
He had forcibly endured the full-power strike of a T7 Oracle-grade.
But the price was incomparably tragic. His body was like a shattered bronze mirror, and spiderweb-like cracks spread across his sage rank.
"This strike... destroyed at least tens of thousands of years of my accumulation!"
Many-Armed Tyrant clutched his chest, hating so fiercely that his teeth itched.
He forced his mind power toward the direction where Daniel had been, only to find that the void there was completely empty. The Imperial Bow Ark had long since vanished.
Daniel and the others had already taken advantage of the time when he was knocked back to tear open the Airspace-Sealing Formation and escape!
"Pfft!"
Many-Armed Tyrant spat another mouthful of blood, scarlet mist spreading through the void.
"Damn ant, don’t let me catch you!"
His furious roar echoed endlessly through the empty starsea, shrill and stifled.
This Everlight Order operation should originally have been an incredibly profitable deal. Who would have expected Daniel to appear halfway?
Since the Order’s founding, they had never encountered anything like this.
Not only had they failed to earn anything, they had suffered a disastrous loss!
The forces under his command had been slaughtered by Daniel until they were scattered and broken, losing at least thirty percent, including direct-line Divine Sovereign Grade powerhouses.

Most of the dead Divine-grade beings were only cannon fodder who had signed contracts. If they died, so be it. What truly made Many-Armed Tyrant’s heart bleed was his own tens of thousands of years of accumulation.
If this injury were not nourished by supreme sacred medicine, relying on time alone would likely take over a hundred thousand years to recover fully.
This loss was far too great!
With a dark expression, Many-Armed Tyrant took out an ancient wheel from his robes.
He activated Strength and traced along the threads of causality.
Click, click, click—!
The wheel slowly turned, and causal threads appeared in the void like a spiderweb.
Soon, Daniel’s basic information appeared before Many-Armed Tyrant.
Faustus. Human. Golden Holy Mountain. The prodigy who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak. The strongest demi-sage...
But when he tried to investigate deeper, the information became blurred, as though covered by a layer of mist from a higher dimension. No matter how he urged the wheel, he could not see clearly.
"Canaan starfield... Golden Holy Mountain... Faustus..."
Many-Armed Tyrant narrowed his eyes, his thoughts unreadable.
Meanwhile,
Daniel had already used the spatial fissure torn open by the spear’s power to drive the Imperial Bow Ark out at full speed.
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark shot into the free starsea like an arrow released from a bowstring.
"Hahaha, that was too exciting!"
James slapped his thigh inside the cabin.
"Brother Faustus, you are truly something!"
"Even a T6 Oracle-grade was toyed with by you!"
The corner of Daniel’s mouth also lifted slightly, though he was quietly calculating in his heart.
As long as he had enough points, Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury still held quite a few Oracle-grade secret treasures. Forget T6—even T7 and T8 might not be impossible to confront!
He began counting the gains from this trip.
The harbor alone had already produced resources worth several tens of billions of points.
After leaving the realm, the slaughter along the way brought in several hundred billion more.
Although he had exchanged for several secret treasures in the middle, the points that finally fell into his pocket still amounted to around fifty billion.
This did not include the pile of Divine-grade secret treasures that had not yet been converted.
He reorganized all the secret treasures and counted them.
Eight Primordial Law Grade secret treasures, two hundred and twenty Primordial Grade secret treasures, and more than three thousand secret treasures below Sacred Artisan Law Grade!
If all of them were exchanged for points, he could gain at least another hundred billion.
In addition, there was a large batch of Divine-grade materials he did not plan to exchange, keeping them for other uses.
"I’ll keep the secret treasures and Divine-grade materials for now."
Daniel already had plans in mind.
His supreme sage rank had no upper limit and could devour anything. Secret treasures and Divine-grade materials were perfect for feeding it.
The greater Sacred Art Star Dome Shattering also needed advancement materials.
Moreover, keeping good things in his hands could keep the players hungry and motivated, giving them something to strive for.
There were still many mouths to feed. No amount of secret treasures would feel excessive.
"Let’s go. We return to Golden Holy Mountain first!"
Daniel changed course, and the Imperial Bow Ark drew a streak of light as it headed straight for the Canaan starfield.
After this advancement, all their treatment needed to be reassessed.
James, Mosi, and the others could obtain formal member qualifications, and access to the Ivahpin World would also be opened to them.
As for Daniel, this trip was to negotiate his own treatment.
Peak Divine-grade treatment was no longer enough to satisfy him!
"I need to advance to Divine Descendant."
Daniel pondered.
"Divine Descendant requires mastery of multiple transcendent Laws."
Although Daniel’s current sage rank strength had already reached the standard, that did not count.
Only when he personally comprehended or obtained transcendent Law power could he advance in Rank.
As for the Laws deduced from the Chronoverse Prologue Codex...
At present, he had only deduced a low-grade Law and had not encountered the Fate Law of Causality again.
Therefore, his Fate Law of Causality remained at high-grade.
"This time, when I go to Golden Holy Mountain, I need to find an advancement sacred land."
Daniel thought inwardly.

"There are many kinds of sacred lands. Some specialize in producing secret treasure embryos, some are made specifically for bitter cultivation, and what I need is a place that can improve Law comprehension."
"The ones most suitable for me are naturally the Reincarnation Law and the Fate Law of Causality."
"In theory, as long as I raise my Reincarnation Law to high-grade, I can step into Divine Lord Grade."
"Then, if I raise both the Reincarnation Law and Fate Law of Causality to transcendent grade, I can advance to Divine Descendant."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 -389-Returning Home, Meeting Chanelle Again
paragraphs: Divine Descendant!
This was a Rank infinitely close to Oracle-grade.
Once he successfully advanced, the first several Holy Tribulations would no longer be anything to fear.
"Besides, I gained the favor of the World Will in the Astral Realm. Even without the system’s assistance, I can now comprehend numerous Laws on my own."
"Since the core of my sage rank is the Law of Reincarnation, I should devote most of my efforts to studying the Reincarnation Law."
With that thought, Daniel already had a clear plan in mind.
"First, evolve Star Dome Shattering!"
He took out numerous Divine-grade materials and treasures, feeding them into the greater Sacred Art.
As the Divine-grade materials and treasures merged into it, the phantom of Star Dome Shattering immediately began to change.
What had originally been nothing more than the remnant projection of the Astral Realm was now rapidly evolving, growing, and maturing!
If the energy contained within a complete star system were defined as ten, then the previous Astral Realm projection had only been worth a little over one.
But now, with the continuous infusion of Divine-grade materials and treasures, the star system within the projection was evolving at an astonishing speed.
It quickly surpassed its initial stage and gradually condensed into the form of a genuine star system!
Its energy level had now reached five.
In other words, the power of Star Dome Shattering had increased by more than twofold.
Now, even one of Daniel’s ordinary skills carried heaven-shattering might. If this Strength were layered onto other Sacred Arts, the resulting power would be almost unimaginable.
"That will do for now."
Daniel halted the evolution of Star Dome Shattering.
Although he still possessed a great quantity of treasures and Divine-grade materials, he had no intention of pouring all of them into this Sacred Art.
"My sage rank still needs to evolve."
Daniel exhaled softly.
Leaving only a handful of practical treasures by his side, he poured all of his remaining spoils into his supreme sage rank.
The instant those treasures touched the boundary of the sage rank, they silently dissolved into nothingness, transforming into countless fragments of Laws drifting through the air.
Meanwhile, the supreme sage rank itself resembled an ancient beast that had slumbered for countless epochs.
It greedily opened its invisible maw, devouring every last material. Every inch of its territory trembled, writhed, and expanded.
The evolution had begun.
Daniel held his breath, watching every moment of the transformation with unwavering focus.
From the depths of his sage rank came a heavy, rhythmic pulse.
It was as though the earth itself were turning over beneath the surface, as though the entire world within his sage rank were slowly reconstructing its own bones.
Time flowed on...
When the final fragment of treasure was consumed, the trembling abruptly ceased, like the final note of a grand symphony.
Daniel immersed his mind power into the depths of his sage rank, carefully examining every subtle change.
"The core of the supreme sage rank is the power of the Reincarnation Law."
He spoke softly.
"Its level has now reached the ultimate tier."
Before this evolution, he had only been capable of overlapping the Strength from one microsecond in both the past and the future.
Now, that span had been forcibly extended to three microseconds.
"Three microseconds."
Daniel opened his eyes. Deep within his pupils, rings of stars seemed to revolve.
"Three microseconds into both the past and the future. The accumulated Strength has also tripled."
His power had climbed another step.
Yet his satisfaction did not last long.
Glancing at the storage space that was now mostly empty, Daniel silently calculated.
This single round of feeding had consumed nearly seventy percent of his wealth.
"What an enormous appetite."
A bitter smile appeared on his lips.
"If I ever want to extend the span of reincarnation to thousands—or even tens of thousands—of years, I’d probably have to pour the accumulated foundations of several entire universes into it."
He looked toward his supreme sage rank.
That vast realm, both illusory and real, expanded and contracted slowly like the breathing of an abyssal beast that could never be satisfied.
The farther one walked down this path, the more terrifying it became.
The weight of it was almost suffocating.
He decided to personally seek the true essence of the Reincarnation Law.
After all, reincarnation itself was the core of his supreme sage rank.
Its entire framework and evolution were built upon it.
If he could personally push open that door, it would be equivalent to drawing water directly from the source rather than relying on the sage rank as a reservoir.
"But... the ultimate-tier Reincarnation Law..."
Daniel frowned slightly.
"Advancing to that level is as difficult as a mortal climbing a sheer cliff with bare hands. There’s simply nowhere to gain leverage."
"If only I had a basic Reincarnation Law to serve as a foundation, it would save me an enormous amount of effort."
Fortunately, he was not empty-handed.
A faint golden glow appeared deep within his eyes.
True Sight.
One of the two greater Sacred Arts he had personally created.
It existed solely to deconstruct and analyze the power of Laws, like a universal key capable of prying open the gates of truth.
His other creation was Star Dome Shattering—
The battle axe he wielded, created solely to smash apart his enemies.
"Even an ultimate-tier Law..."
Daniel murmured.
"True Sight can still dismantle its impossibly intricate patterns into their most primitive fragments... and piece together a path that I myself can walk."
The boundless starry sky resembled an enormous scroll spread open by a silent deity.
The stars drifted across it slowly, maintaining the same rhythm for countless ages.
The Imperial Bow Ark steadily and swiftly crossed one starfield after another.
Before long, the boundary of the Canaan Starfield appeared beyond the viewing window, its familiar radiance spreading before them.
Soon afterward, the sacred vessel slowly descended into the harbor of Golden Holy Mountain’s headquarters.
The hull trembled gently as it settled into its berth.
Daniel gradually emerged from his prolonged meditation, traces of profound Law comprehension still lingering deep within his eyes.
Although he had only just begun to grasp it, he had already vaguely touched upon the path of reincarnation.
"We’re finally here."
Putting away the Imperial Bow Ark, he entered the main hall of Golden Holy Mountain headquarters alongside James, Mosi, and the others.
The moment they stepped into the central district...
A figure silently appeared before them.
It was a middle-aged man clad in a silver-gray robe.
His gaze was gentle, yet unfathomably deep.
It was Oracle-grade Chanelle.
"Faustus..."
Chanelle stepped forward with a smile.
"Congratulations on your triumphant return."
His gaze slowly swept across every member of the group, like an old master craftsman inspecting blades he had personally forged.
Although he had long known that they had all advanced, witnessing them in person still caused a slight ripple to appear within his eyes as he sensed their newly forged sharpness.
"Excellent."
"You have all remained true to your own paths."
Chanelle nodded gently, the smile on his face deepening.
Two Divine Radiant experts.
One Divine Sovereign.
Especially Daniel—
The moment he stepped into Divine-grade, he had already stood at the level of a Divine Sovereign.
By himself, he had suppressed Divine Lords, driven back Divine Descendants, and even forced numerous Oracle-grades into refusing to make a move lightly.
Such talent and achievements could no longer be described merely as "rare."
He resembled a newly ignited star, so brilliant that one could scarcely look directly at him.
Chanelle knew full well that the man standing before him was destined to leave his name upon the history of the starsea.
He silently rejoiced.
Rejoiced that it had been he who had first brought Daniel into Golden Holy Mountain.
No matter what happened in the future, Daniel would always bear, to some extent, the mark of Chanelle’s own lineage.
And during the time Daniel and the others had been trapped within the Chaosverse...
Chanelle had been one of the very few who had continued to stand behind them.
One of the few guardians who had never wavered.
Now that they had returned safely, the respect Daniel and the others felt toward Chanelle was entirely sincere.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 -390-Joining Golden Holy Mountain
paragraphs: "Lord Chanelle."
"It has been a long time, Lord Chanelle."
Daniel and the others bowed in unison, their posture respectful.
The small sword Chanelle had once given Daniel had saved his life at a critical moment.
Afterward, Chanelle had repeatedly supported him during headquarters council meetings and had never shown the slightest doubt in him.
Daniel remembered all of these favors in his heart.
"My lord,"
Daniel slowly spoke.
"We returned this time also to discuss matters related to improving our treatment."
Back when he had still been only a demi-sage, he had already obtained treatment equivalent to a peak Divine-grade member.
James and Mosi, meanwhile, had merely been registered members.
Now that all of them had advanced, and he himself had stepped into the Divine Sovereign realm, it was time to redefine the status they deserved.
The Endless Starsea never pitied seniority.
It only recognized strength!
Whoever held heavier authority would have the louder voice.
Hearing this, Chanelle nodded.
"All of you, follow me. I will personally take you to negotiate treatment worthy of your strength."
He was actually going to personally lead Daniel and the others to apply for their upgraded treatment.
Given his status as a T7 Oracle-grade and a great Oracle-grade existence, this gesture was no different from treating the three of them as his own direct students.
Daniel, James, and Mosi exchanged glances. Each could read the emotion in the others’ eyes.
They did not refuse. Silently, they followed behind Chanelle and walked toward Golden Holy Mountain’s member administration office.
It was a towering palace, with countless powerhouses coming and going inside.
Chanelle’s appearance immediately caused a commotion.
"Lord Chanelle actually came in person. Is it because of those powerhouses behind him?"
"To be personally guided and received by a great Oracle-grade... what kind of treatment is this?"
"Could they be descendants of some core big shot?"
"What the hell? Look carefully. Doesn’t that look like Faustus and James?"
"So that’s it. No wonder they can receive this kind of treatment."
The name Faustus did not only resound throughout the Myriad-Star Cosmos. By now, his deeds had also spread among the various universes.
Especially in the Canaan Starfield of the Myriad-Star Cosmos, Faustus’s reputation was incomparably famous!
However, much of that fame carried hostility and resentment!

During the time he had been trapped in the Chaosverse, Daniel’s puppet clone had commanded countless players and nearly brought all the small worlds of the Visca Galaxy under his control, madly extracting resources without regard for cost, like a swarm of locusts sweeping across a wheat field.
His harvest had indeed been astonishing, but it had also drawn a tide of hatred toward him.
Who knew how many powerhouses and forces he had offended? There were even colleagues from Golden Holy Mountain who had suffered losses beneath the merciless iron hooves of the players.
However, those voices had never managed to surface.
The Strength of Chanelle’s faction was like an invisible iron wall, firmly blocking all questioning and blame outside the door.
Those people were furious over Faustus’s actions, but they could only swallow their anger back down.
And now, Chanelle had personally appeared and walked into the palace side by side with Faustus and the others.
This was no different from publicly declaring to all powerhouses:
They are under my protection.
You had better be smart.
The instant Chanelle stepped into the hall, a high-grade steward hurried forward to greet him.
The steward himself possessed considerable strength, being at peak Divine-grade.
But his eyesight was sharper than his Rank.
He merely glanced at the young yet steady figures behind Chanelle and immediately understood. He bowed at once.
"Lord Chanelle, you have actually come in person... Please come in. Honored guests, please come in as well."
"Mm."
Chanelle gave a low response.
The group entered the palace.
The palace was embedded with exquisite spatial formations. Although its exterior was not ostentatious, the interior contained an entirely different world.
Every entrant would be guided into an independent compartment, private and solemn.
Inside each compartment were several stewards and one presiding officer.
Chanelle stopped and said to the people behind him,
"James, Mosi, step forward first."
"Display your strength. Let them witness it with their own eyes."
Golden Holy Mountain had a fairly rigorous promotion process.
Although Chanelle held great authority, he could only directly raise someone to the treatment level of peak Divine-grade.
If they wanted anything higher, they had to follow the rules!
James and Mosi exchanged a glance, then stepped forward in response.
Boom!
Boom!
The two unfolded their sage ranks without holding anything back.

Two Divine Radiant Grade auras surged up like tides at the same time, one on the left and one on the right, pressing every inch of air inside the compartment until it felt heavy. Even the candle flames tilted slightly beneath the invisible force.
"Divine Radiant Grade powerhouses."
The presiding officer hurriedly raised his hand, a thin layer of sweat already forming on his forehead.
With Chanelle present, how could he dare make things difficult in the slightest?
"They may be granted Divine Radiant Grade treatment."
James and Mosi both looked toward Chanelle at the same time.
Chanelle’s brow lifted almost imperceptibly.
It was an extremely subtle movement, but it was enough for James to understand.
He immediately cleared his throat and spoke with a certainty that could not be ignored.
"Uh... my lord, what we hope to obtain is Divine Sovereign Grade treatment."
Divine Sovereign Grade?
The presiding officer’s eyes widened.
They had the strength of Divine Radiant Grade, yet they wanted Divine Sovereign Grade treatment?
"Divine Sovereign Grade?"
His tone carried unconcealable shock. He was just about to refute them when Chanelle interrupted.
"When these two young powerhouses were still demi-sages, they could already cross Ranks and kill Divine-grade enemies."

"Now that they have reached the Divine Radiant realm, suppressing those of the same Rank and defeating Divine Sovereigns across Ranks should not be difficult for them. Is it excessive to grant them Divine Sovereign Grade treatment?"
Uh...
Was that not excessive?
The presiding officer’s lips moved several times, but the words on his tongue were swallowed back down.
He looked at Chanelle’s calm expression, then at James and Mosi’s eyes that did not evade him at all.
He had personally felt the strength of the sage ranks James and Mosi had displayed just now. Fighting across Ranks would indeed not be difficult for them.
After a long while, he smiled and waved his hand.
"Very well... you may receive Divine Sovereign Grade treatment."
There was a trace of helplessness in his tone.
He turned and gave several stewards a look. The group of stewards immediately hurried into action, seals rising and falling.
"The treatment upgrade still requires some time. You two should wait for a while."
Chanelle gave James and Mosi this instruction, then turned his gaze toward Daniel.
"Faustus, it is your turn."
Daniel strode forward, but first gave Chanelle a slight bow.
"My lord, I have a follower whose combat power is no weaker than James and Mosi."
"May I ask whether he may also join Golden Holy Mountain?"
"Oh?"
Chanelle’s gaze turned toward Camille, who had been silently following them all this time.
"Camille, unfold your sage rank!"
Daniel spoke.
Camille’s heart warmed.
He knew very clearly that Daniel was paving the way for his future.
Everything a follower had was tied to the one they followed. If Daniel had not been willing to recommend him, Camille would have had no complaints.
Yet Daniel had always treated him as a companion and called him a comrade-in-arms.
Camille took a deep breath, his eyes sharp as swords.
Boom—!
A Divine Radiant Grade aura poured out without reservation, enveloping the entire compartment in a field of fierce sharpness.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 -391-Assessment?
paragraphs: Camille cultivated the sword path. He had once received personal guidance from Hyman, a T6 Oracle-grade of the Chaos Humans, and had been given the cultivation method for the Blade of Ruin.
His sage rank was pure to the point of obsession.
Although there was only one sword within it,
the aura contained in that sword was cold and profound, as though it could pierce through the sturdiest shield wall and make the spine of anyone who looked at it turn cold.
Daniel glanced sideways at the presiding officer, his tone calm as usual.
"Camille, that is enough."
Hearing this, Camille immediately withdrew his sage rank, and the compartment abruptly became quiet.
Chanelle looked at the presiding officer with a smile, his gaze gentle.
The bitterness on the presiding officer’s face grew even stronger.
"Prepare a Divine Sovereign Grade treatment contract for this young powerhouse as well."
The stewards’ footsteps became even more hurried.
"Faustus,"
Chanelle suddenly spoke, his tone carrying a trace of expectation that was difficult to detect.
"Unfold your sage rank."
Daniel nodded slightly and raised his right hand, slowly spreading his five fingers.
A supreme sage rank slowly unfolded behind him, like the domain of an ancient god being awakened.
Boom—!
The first roar was the majestic wave of energy unleashed as the sage rank unfolded.
That sacred domain covered heaven and earth, actually filling all the reserved space within the compartment.
It was like a tide pouring into a wine cup, so full that it was almost about to overflow.
What was even more shocking was what happened next.
The pressure leaking from the sage rank descended like an invisible mountain, directly pressing several stewards inside the compartment to the ground. They could not even raise their heads.
They lay prostrate on the floor, even their breathing carrying trembling tails.
Every one of these stewards was at peak Divine-grade Rank!
In the outside world, any one of them would be powerful enough to stand alone and oversee a region.
Yet now, merely the aftershock leaking from the supreme sage rank had pressed them flat to the ground.
This degree of difference was almost absurd.

The presiding officer himself was also a Divine Lord Grade powerhouse. But under the pressure of this sage rank, he felt like a wild rabbit trapped beneath the shadow of an ancient dragon. Every nerve in his body was screaming.
He could clearly sense that deep within that sage rank, some indescribable existence seemed to be dwelling there, overlooking him with an incomparably indifferent gaze.
This was dimensional suppression at the level of Laws.
It was an impassable gulf between levels of strength!
"E-enough... This is too exaggerated!"
Sweat slid down from the presiding officer’s forehead.
After all, he was a Divine Lord Grade powerhouse. Although he was far from top-tier within Golden Holy Mountain, he could still be considered someone with status and reputation.
But before Daniel’s sage rank, all he felt was powerless submission.
Daniel blinked lightly, and the supreme sage rank retreated like a tide.
"Then, with my strength, what kind of treatment can I obtain?"
The presiding officer wiped away the cold sweat on his forehead, and his gaze involuntarily drifted toward Chanelle.
Suddenly!
A deep voice descended from the void.
"A Divine Sovereign realm cultivator should naturally receive Divine Sovereign realm treatment. Is there even a need to ask?"
Daniel’s pupils contracted slightly.
Was someone here to cause trouble?
Chanelle’s expression instantly darkened.
"Lucius! What do you mean by this?"
He coldly curled his lips.
"I would like to know, when were you given the authority to decide member advancement?"
Whoosh—!
A figure appeared silently.
The figure had a youthful face and wore a snow-white mage robe. A gentle yet biting smile hung at the corner of his mouth.
"Chanelle."
The powerhouse named Lucius tilted his head slightly. His gaze passed over Chanelle and landed on Daniel.
"Did I say something wrong?"

"A Divine Sovereign realm cultivator receiving Divine Sovereign realm salary and resources is perfectly reasonable. This is official procedure. I am not interfering. I am merely stating a truth even children understand."
At the same time,
Chanelle quickly transmitted a piece of information to Daniel.
Lucius!
Daniel calmly examined the T7 Oracle-grade before him, quickly sorting out the chain of events in his heart.
Lucius had an extremely favored student named Logan!
He was a Tier 3 Oracle-grade who also occupied a great deal of territory in the Visca Galaxy.
Back when Daniel’s puppet clone had swept through those small worlds, he had directly clashed with Logan.

Logan could not enter the small worlds himself and could only watch helplessly as his territory was stripped away again and again. Because of that, he had written countless letters and used every connection he had in Golden Holy Mountain, vowing to punish Daniel for the crime of overstepping boundaries.
But the one standing behind Daniel was Chanelle!
And Chanelle’s lineage was one of the top forces within Golden Holy Mountain. Behind him stood a T9 Oracle-grade.
Logan’s many accusations had failed to stir even the slightest ripple.
That was how the feud had formed.

Now, as Logan’s mentor, Lucius naturally intended to stand up for his student. When he heard that Faustus and the others had returned from the Chaosverse, and that Chanelle was personally accompanying them to handle promotion matters, he rushed over immediately.
He had only one goal:
to make sure Faustus obtained no benefits at all!
Lucius’s calculation was simple. Since you, Faustus, were a Divine Sovereign, then obediently take Divine Sovereign treatment. Do not even think of taking a single bit more.
Chanelle was extremely dissatisfied with this.
His bottom line was that Daniel’s treatment absolutely could not be lower than Divine Descendant!
There were two entire major stages between Divine Sovereign and Divine Descendant, and the difference in treatment was like the gap between heaven and abyss.

If Daniel were truly made to receive only Divine Sovereign Grade allocation, he would not only lose actual resources, but would also be slapped hard in the face before everyone in Golden Holy Mountain.
On the surface, Lucius was acting according to procedure.
In truth, he was publicly cutting away at Chanelle’s dignity.
How could Chanelle possibly show him a good expression?
He spoke coldly.
"What Faustus has opened is a supreme sage rank—his potential is enormous and rarely seen in history."
"Moreover, his strength far exceeds his Rank itself. He can instantly kill those of the same Rank, suppress Divine Lords, and his combat power directly approaches Divine Descendant!"
"Divine Sovereign Grade treatment is clearly unworthy of him."
Lucius, however, had clearly come prepared. The smile on his face did not move in the slightest.
He unhurriedly turned his gaze toward the presiding officer, his tone warm.
"Your Excellency is the supervisor in charge here. I hope you will handle this matter fairly. It would be best not to allow certain fame-seeking frauds to fish in troubled waters!"
The presiding officer was caught between two T7 Oracle-grade beings. He felt as though he were standing on a cliff as narrow as a blade.
To the left was an abyss.
To the right was also an abyss!
No matter which side he leaned toward, he would inevitably draw the wrath of the other.
"Faustus possesses the potential of an Eternal Sage. He should enjoy Divine Descendant treatment!"
Chanelle sensed the hesitation in the presiding officer’s eyes and immediately strengthened his tone.
"In the Endless Starsea, how many empty names and hollow reputations exist? How many fallen prodigies are as numerous as the stars?"
Lucius refused to give an inch.
"Some prodigies are praised to the clouds in rumors, yet cannot withstand a single real test."
"Heh—!"
A cold laugh suddenly rang out.
Chanelle and Lucius turned their heads at the same time.
The source of that laugh was Daniel.
Daniel looked directly at the presiding officer, his gaze calm.
"What is the formal promotion process?"
The presiding officer quickly glanced at Chanelle, then answered in a low voice.
"One must undergo an assessment trial."
Only then did Daniel slowly turn his head and look toward Lucius.
There was no anger in his eyes.
No provocation.
Only a kind of calm confidence from above.
It was like a true swordsman, when questioned whether his weapon was sharp, silently drawing his blade.
"Then conduct the assessment."
He said,
"So that certain dogs will stop barking at the side."
"As for what kind of treatment I deserve..."
He raised his chin slightly.
"I will personally obtain it."
