chapters.title: Chapter 392 -392-Sky Trial Platform
paragraphs: That sentence was like a poison-tempered arrow.
Lucius’s face stiffened in an instant.
Then a livid shade surfaced over it, and the curve at the corner of his mouth froze completely.
"I, Faustus—formally apply for a treatment assessment!"
No matter which force one joined, there was such a rule on the surface.
Pass the trial, and the treatment one received would be determined by actual results!
This was Golden Holy Mountain’s formal procedure.

However, as the years passed, intricate factions had long since formed within the various major forces. Usually, as long as a recommender with enough weight vouched for someone, the formal assessment would become nothing more than a procedure. Displaying a bit of strength was often enough to pass.
The last time Golden Holy Mountain had opened an official promotion trial was already a matter from millions of years ago.
At that time, it had been for a Tier 4 Oracle-grade who possessed Tier 5 actual combat power.
In the end, his trial results allowed him to obtain Tier 5 treatment.
And that powerhouse was none other than Lucius!
Golden Holy Mountain had not opened the formal path of trial for a member in an extremely long time.

With Chanelle, a T7 Oracle-grade, personally vouching for him, and with Daniel’s achievements and reputation laid bare for all to see, the matter should originally have been settled with a single word.
Who would have expected Lucius to interfere halfway? In order to vent anger on behalf of his student, he had personally stepped forward to block Daniel’s path of promotion.
"This is also an opportunity."
Daniel thought inwardly.
"Let them witness my strength with their own eyes."
His deeds had already been repeatedly spread across the various universes.

A contemporary Starchosen, the strongest demi-sage of the Myriad-Star Cosmos, the miracle child who had instantly killed those of the same Rank in the Astral Realm, slain Divine Lords across Ranks, and suppressed Divine Descendants...
But rumors were ultimately only rumors.
They were like songs sung by bards. No matter how moving they sounded, they could not compare to the shock of witnessing the truth firsthand.
Daniel wanted every living being present to see with their own eyes that not a single word in those songs had been exaggerated.
When Chanelle heard Daniel’s words, his gaze slowly shifted toward Lucius. A cold smile flashed deep within his eyes.
He did not speak, but that look already said everything for him.
"Trial?"
Lucius’s mouth rose, and his smile carried the calm confidence of someone certain of victory.
"Very good!"
"Then let me personally see whether you are truly worthy of those praises."
He turned toward the presiding officer, his tone rising slightly.
"Open the Sky Trial Platform. Prepare the assessment."
"I would like to see exactly how much true ability you, Faustus, actually have."
Sky Trial Platform!
It was an ancient place specially established by Golden Holy Mountain to measure the true combat power of its members. The platform itself was an extremely high-grade Divine-grade secret treasure.

According to legend, it had come from the hands of the Eternal Sage who founded Golden Holy Mountain. It was a supreme treasure forged with the Laws he had personally poured into it as its framework, and shaped by supreme sacred power.
The trial platform could manifest terrifyingly powerful trial puppets, with the highest simulation reaching the level of a T7 Oracle-grade.
Moreover, the entire platform was built in the open air. Any headquarters member only needed to raise their head to take in everything happening on the platform.
When the presiding officer saw Daniel take the initiative to propose a trial, the heart that had been lodged in his throat finally dropped back into place.
Behind Chanelle stood a T9 Oracle-grade.
Behind Lucius, there was likewise a T9 Oracle-grade backing him!
A contest between two such giants was not something a mere Divine Lord Grade presiding officer like him could possibly interfere in.
He gave Daniel a grateful glance, then raised his voice.
"Open the Sky Trial Platform immediately!"
"My lords, Lord Faustus, please move over."
Dong—!
Dong, dong—!
Deep bell tolls rang out from the giant bell above the trial platform. The sound waves were heavy and distant, instantly echoing through the entire Golden Holy Mountain headquarters.
Countless powerhouses who were meditating, discussing matters, or chatting idly all raised their heads, their expressions varying.
"What is that sound?"
One powerhouse frowned and looked toward the sky.
"I have stayed at headquarters for hundreds of years, and I have never heard such a commotion."
"Is it an enemy invasion? Or an emergency summons?"
Another powerhouse had already gripped the weapon at his waist.
A few elder figures with greater seniority abruptly widened their eyes, disbelief surfacing on their faces.
"That is the opening bell of the Sky Trial Platform! A powerhouse is about to participate in a trial!"
"Trial? Hasn’t that thing been unopened for ten million years?"
"The rule theoretically still exists. It’s just that no one has taken it seriously for far too long..."
"Go, go, go. This kind of thing is rarely seen. Let’s see what is happening!"
Several streaks of light shot up from the ground, rushing toward the source of the bell tolls.
The Sky Trial Platform stood majestically within headquarters.
It was a broad stone platform, its four sides covered in dense formation patterns like spiderwebs. Every engraved mark faintly glowed.
Above the platform hung a giant bell. Its tolls were neither hurried nor slow, as though counting down to the battle about to begin.
At this moment, Daniel was already standing below the trial platform.
His hands were clasped behind his back, his expression as calm as ever.
James, Mosi, Camille, and the others had also followed over. Yet there was not a trace of worry on their faces. Their relaxed expressions made it seem as if they had come to attend a banquet.
Chanelle stood at the side expressionlessly, his thoughts unreadable.
Lucius wore that smile between mockery and indifference.
The presiding officer raised his hand and cast a forbidden spell. The protective formations around the trial platform suddenly withdrew.
Transparent Law barriers slowly rose in the void, as though the gates of an invisible beast arena had been opened.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Streaks of light gathered from every direction. Golden Holy Mountain’s powerhouses surged in like a tide, but all of them sensibly stopped not far away.
"Lord Chanelle, Lord Lucius... and Faustus, James..."
An Oracle-grade narrowed his eyes, sweeping his gaze over the figures below the platform one by one.
"Could it be Faustus who opened the trial?"
"The Sky Trial Platform has not moved in ten million years. To witness it with my own eyes today can be considered quite an interesting event."
Another elderly Oracle-grade stroked his long beard, curiosity and emotion in his gaze.
"Why are Lucius and Chanelle standing together?"
"Exactly. Haven’t they always been as incompatible as fire and water?"
A powerhouse lowered his voice, as if sharing some secret.
"You may not know this, but I heard that Lucius’s student Logan suffered a great loss because of Faustus in the Visca Galaxy..."
"Oh? Then there will be a good show to watch."
As more and more figures gathered, the entire region gradually grew noisy.
The presiding officer looked toward Daniel and was just about to explain the rules.
But before he could speak, Daniel’s figure had already landed on the trial platform.
Whoosh—!
The moment he stepped onto the platform, the formation restrictions activated instantly.
Transparent Law barriers rose from the four corners, isolating the platform from the outside world, like a crystal dome covering the entire battlefield.
Daniel’s gaze landed on the presiding officer, his tone calm.
"What is the maximum number of enemies allowed in the trial?"
"Ten."
Chanelle spoke first. His voice was not loud, but it clearly spread across the entire area.
The corner of Daniel’s mouth slowly rose, revealing an almost unrestrained smile.
"Then I will fight ten alone."
The presiding officer’s pupils shrank violently.
That confidence washing over him was like a young lion lazily stretching while surrounded by countless beasts.
And yet, every observer could feel the Strength hidden beneath its skin.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 -393-Ten Divine Sovereigns? Instant Kill with a Wave!
paragraphs: A sense of respect naturally arose in the presiding officer’s heart, and he hurriedly began operating the controls with both hands.
Whoosh, whoosh...!
The space above the trial platform suddenly distorted, and ten burly figures stepped out from nothingness.
They were ten Divine Sovereign Grade trial puppets, each fully condensed from Laws. Every one of them stood like a silent iron tower.
Boom, boom, boom—!
Ten sage ranks unfolded at the same time. Their lights overlapped and intertwined, instantly covering the entire trial platform in heavy pressure.
The spectators could not help but draw in sharp breaths.
"It really is Faustus!"
"But what he said just now was that he wanted to fight ten alone? Can he withstand that?"
"Rumor says Faustus could instantly kill opponents of the same Rank in the Astral Realm. He should... he should be able to, right?"
"Should? Listen to your own tone. Does that sound like you believe it?"
On the trial platform.
"That’s it?"
A short laugh escaped Daniel’s mouth.
He slowly raised his right hand and spread his five fingers. His supreme sage rank descended at once!
Boom—!
That sacred domain spread out overwhelmingly, like an inverted night curtain suddenly falling down, covering the ten puppet sage ranks with a force that seemed capable of devouring everything.
What made hearts tremble even more was what happened next.
The moment that sage rank touched the enemy domains, it revealed its true ferocity—
it was devouring them!
Daniel’s sage rank was like the maw of an abyss that had been starving for ages. It madly tore at the edges of those ten sage ranks, ripping fragments of Laws piece by piece into its own territory.

The ten puppet sage ranks were like a flock of sheep surrounded by wolves. They desperately shrank to the smallest possible range, struggling to resist that devouring force, yet they were still compressed and eaten away inch by inch.
Crash—!!!
When this scene fell into the eyes of every spectator, it was like a thunderbolt striking the surface of a lake.
"In the name of the stars... what kind of sage rank is that?"
"What a savage domain! It can actually devour the enemy’s sage rank—I have never seen such a Law creation!"
"Could this be... the supreme sage rank said to be opened only by an extremely small number of heaven-favored prodigies?"
"It seems those rumors were not exaggerated at all. If anything, they were too conservative. Faustus may truly be unmatched in the Divine Sovereign realm."
On the platform, the ten Divine Sovereign Grade puppets did not simply wait for death just because their sage ranks were suppressed.
Whoosh, whoosh...

Each of them unleashed simulated Law Sacred Arts. Some puppets even condensed the phantoms of secret treasures from Law power. Blades, long spears, and giant shields surged toward Daniel from every direction.
However, those attacks were ultimately only simulated power, barely touching the standard line.
Daniel stood proudly at the center of the trial platform, the smile at the corner of his mouth unmoving.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
After its advancement, the supreme sage rank could stack three microseconds each from the past and future. Stacking the sage rank power of three microseconds—
that was not merely three times stronger.
It was a terrifying amplification that surged geometrically!

The sage rank power of three microseconds was compressed into every inch of the present, like pouring the weight of an entire lake into a single cup. That pressure was enough to crush all solid things.
Boom—!
Merely the pressure of the sage rank itself cracked the first Divine Sovereign Grade puppet apart.
Fragments of Laws scattered in every direction, like a clay figurine smashed by a heavy fist.
Boom!
Rumble!
The second, the third, the fourth...
They exploded one after another.
From the start of the trial until now, Daniel had not even moved a finger. Relying solely on the pressure of his sage rank, he crushed ten opponents of the same Rank into dust.
Dead silence!
The spectators below the platform seemed to have been seized by the throat. For a time, not a single voice could be heard.
Soon, thunderous cries and gasps erupted like a tidal wave.
"In the name of the Creator!"
"This... this can no longer be explained by common sense!"

"He swept away ten opponents of the same Rank with only his sage rank? Wait—I suddenly feel like all these tens of thousands of years of bitter cultivation have been on the wrong path from beginning to end."
"There has always been a difference in talent on the transcendent path, but this level of suppression... is already something beyond talent."
"Could Faustus be the reincarnation of some Eternal Sage? Otherwise, how could he possess such terrifying battle power?"
"My whole mind is falling apart..."
Daniel slowly withdrew his sage rank.
Amid the Law wreckage covering the ground, he turned around. His gaze crossed the crowd and landed directly on Lucius’s livid face.
He tilted his head slightly, his tone relaxed as though he were making casual conversation.
"Continue."
He said to the presiding officer,
"Still one against ten."
His posture was so relaxed that he did not seem to be standing on a trial platform at all. It was more like he was strolling through his own courtyard.

Below the platform, the powerhouses of Golden Holy Mountain looked at one another. The shock in their hearts had not yet faded, but the next round that was about to begin ignited even deeper anticipation!
"Wonderful... truly wonderful to the extreme!"
"A scene like this should be witnessed by even more powerhouses."
"Faustus’s rise today is destined to be recorded in the archives of Golden Holy Mountain!"
James and the others were the most familiar with Daniel. They had always been full of confidence in his strength, so they were not surprised.
Although Chanelle had always thought highly of Daniel, even he had not expected Daniel to be monstrous to this degree.
With only his sage rank, he had suppressed ten powerhouses of the same level.
"My intuition was indeed correct."
Thinking this, Chanelle’s originally irritated mood improved greatly.
"Hmph... Faustus!"
Lucius remained expressionless on the surface, but inwardly, he was gritting his teeth.
"This guy really does have some ability... Damn it. Such a monster, and Chanelle picked him up for cheap."
Daniel’s voice still echoed across the trial platform.
"I will fight ten alone."
The moment his words fell, the presiding officer immediately formed hand seals and activated the formation.
Whoosh, whoosh—!
The space above the trial platform distorted once again, and ten figures more solid than before stepped out from the ripples.
This time, standing opposite Daniel were Divine Lord Grade trial puppets.
Each one emitted the heavy pressure unique to the Divine Lord stage, like ten silent fortresses slowly emerging from the fog.

Their auras steadily climbed above the standard line of Divine Lord Grade. Simulated Law weavings and Holy Relic phantoms coiled around them, clearly making them far more difficult to deal with than the previous batch of Divine Sovereign creations.
The sage ranks of Divine Lord Grade were also far sturdier than those of Divine Sovereign Grade!
Although they still retreated under the crushing pressure of Daniel’s supreme sage rank, they were not directly shattered by the sage rank power.
They struggled to stand beneath the immense pressure, like reefs raising their heads amid raging waves.
"Roar—!"
The ten puppets erupted with low roars at the same time.

Law weavings lit up in unison, intertwining into a vast net of light that covered the sky. The simulated Holy Relics drew various trails through the void, like ten hunting falcons pouncing on the same target at once.
For a time, the entire trial platform was cut apart by crisscrossing light, and the air was filled with the scorched smell left behind by burning Laws.
At this moment, even more streaks of light arrived from every part of Golden Holy Mountain.
The powerhouses who arrived late hovered in the outer air, their gazes seized tightly by the formation of the ten attackers.
Some powerhouses sucked in cold breaths. Others whispered urgently into their companions’ ears. The pupils of every powerhouse reflected the boiling radiance on the trial platform...
They wanted to see how the young man standing at the center of the storm would deal with this ferocious encirclement!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 -394-Ten More Divine Descendants!
paragraphs: Heh!
The corner of Daniel’s mouth revealed undisguised contempt.
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
Boom—!

The phantom of the Astral Realm suddenly spread across the heavens. The power of a star system, like an ancient giant beast awakened from slumber, poured its vast and heavy Strength into Celestial Grasp.
That giant palm stretched across the entire sky above the trial platform, sweeping toward the ten Divine Lord Grade puppets.

Not only did it block all the incoming Law weavings and simulated Holy Relics, it also crushed those lights like sand with unstoppable momentum, swatting away the illusory weapons and shields one by one before pressing down on all the puppets without losing force.
It was a curtain of sky that covered the entire Sky Trial Platform!
The ten Divine Lord Grade puppets scattered in all directions, only to discover that no matter where they fled, the giant palm followed them closely, as though the entire sky were closing in on them.
After its advancement, Star Dome Shattering’s might had surged dramatically. Together with Daniel’s own rise in strength, the power of Celestial Grasp had also risen accordingly.

And the continuous enhancement of the supreme sage rank was like an invisible heavy hammer, tempering the Strength of that giant palm again and again until it became even more solid, even more impossible to resist.
Rumble!
Rumble!
Rumble!
One Divine Lord Grade puppet exploded beneath the giant palm, fragments of Laws scattering everywhere.
Then came the second, the third...
Daniel’s palm strike descended like it was crushing a row of clay jars standing on the ground.
In the blink of an eye, all ten Divine Lord Grade powerhouses had turned to dust.
Rumble—!

When the final Divine Lord Grade puppet shattered beneath the palm, the remaining force of the giant hand slammed heavily onto the surface of the trial platform, shaking the entire platform violently.
Layer upon layer of formation restrictions were triggered at once. Countless Law runes lit up and faded under the impact, like a grand display of rune fireworks.
A heaven-shaking uproar erupted among the watching powerhouses.
The gathered living beings opened their mouths wide, their gazes following the calm figure on the platform as though they were looking up at a walking legend.
"In the name of the gods... this is too exaggerated..."
"Are you kidding me? Faustus is fighting across Ranks!"
"That may be true, but those trial puppets are only at the standard line after all. In a one-on-one fight, they are actually far inferior to true powerhouses of the same level."
"But even so, this is terrifying enough! Instantly killing Divine Lord Grade powerhouses across Ranks—ask yourselves honestly, which of you can do that?"
"With such talent, even granting Faustus Divine Descendant treatment would not be excessive at all!"
"No objection..."
"Agreed!"
Deep within Golden Holy Mountain, inside a certain secluded plane isolated from the world,
several great figures seated in the void all turned their gazes toward the Sky Trial Platform.
Their mind power had already descended here from the moment the first bell rang.
After all, the Sky Trial Platform had not been opened for millions of years. Its opening again was naturally worthy of their attention.
"Faustus... very good."
One existence spoke calmly, his words carrying undeniable weight.
"At least a future great Oracle-grade."
Another great figure nodded slightly, his fingertips gently tapping the armrest of his seat, as though estimating what kind of brilliance this unpolished gemstone might eventually reveal.
"Since he belongs to my lineage, it would not hurt to tilt resources toward him appropriately."
The T9 Oracle-grade behind Chanelle slowly spoke, his voice carrying firm decisiveness.
Daniel’s gaze was sharp as a torch, staring directly at the presiding officer.
Under that gaze, the presiding officer felt a chill run down his spine. A thought surfaced in his mind that even he found absurd.
"Surely this one does not plan to fight ten Divine Descendant Grade puppets as well..."
He coughed dryly twice. His impression of Daniel was truly not bad, so he decided to take a slight risk and speak first.
"Ahem... In my humble opinion, this trial has already gone far enough."
"The potential and strength displayed by Lord Faustus are more than enough to qualify him for the treatment of a Divine Descendant powerhouse."
Hearing this, a genuine smile rose at the corner of Chanelle’s mouth.
Lucius’s expression, however, was so gloomy it almost seemed capable of dripping water.
"I originally wanted to make things difficult for that Faustus, but instead I helped him build his reputation and pave his steps upward."
Lucius secretly gritted his teeth. The feeling of lifting a stone only to smash his own foot made him unable to suppress a cold snort.
James and the others showed joy on their faces.
That was treatment across two whole major stages!
The resources and authority enjoyed by a Divine Descendant would be considered extremely generous in any force.
Most of the watching crowd also felt that Daniel fully deserved it.
His bottomless potential alone was worth Divine Descendant treatment.
Moreover, he was already so astonishingly brilliant today. Who would believe that he would stop here?
He would eventually step into the hall of Oracle-grade!

Since that was the case, granting him sufficient treatment in advance would not only allow this star to grow even more brilliantly, but would also deepen his sense of belonging toward Golden Holy Mountain.
Under countless gazes, Daniel slowly turned his head.
His gaze passed over the crowd and landed directly on Lucius’s livid face.
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, and his voice was calm, yet carried a certain tension that quickened the heartbeat.
"I want to continue challenging Divine Descendant."
He paused.
"Ten of them!"
Boom—!
Before his voice had faded, the watching powerhouses erupted as though a pot had exploded.
"By the stars! I had long heard that Faustus has always been wild and unrestrained, but only today have I truly witnessed it!"
"Unbelievable! Such kingly bearing is truly convincing!"
"Ten Divine Descendants... Though they are only trial puppets, and their true combat power is far inferior to real Divine Descendants, that is still ten of them!"
"Even Faustus’s supreme sage rank may find it difficult to suppress puppets infinitely close to Oracle-grade as easily as before."
"Too arrogant... Faustus is far too arrogant!"
Daniel paid no attention at all to the audience’s discussion.
His face remained calm and effortless.
Divine Descendants?
If real, living Divine Descendants stood opposite him, he naturally would not be so overconfident.
Using Oracle-grade secret treasures could indeed clear the field instantly, but that would ultimately be external power and would not display the sharpness of his own strength.

True Divine Descendants all mastered transcendent Laws. If he wanted to defeat them head-on using his own strength, he could only rely on a prolonged battle of attrition, grinding down their defenses bit by bit.
But right now, what he had to face was only a group of trial puppets whose strength barely touched the standard line of Divine Descendant.
Even the Holy Relics in their hands were all simulated phantoms.
Against opponents like these, he had enough confidence to rely on his own power.
Chanelle did not speak to stop him.
He believed that since Daniel had spoken, he must have his own support.
In truth, this young man had already brought him far too many shocks beyond expectation.
"Arrogant fool!"
Lucius snorted coldly.
But deep within his heart, a hidden trace of anticipation quietly surfaced.
Perhaps Faustus would stumble in the next challenge and earn himself a reputation for pride and arrogance!

chapters.title: Chapter 395 -395-Clashing Head-On with Ten Divine Descendants
paragraphs: Divine Descendant...
One against ten!
The powerhouses gathered around the Sky Trial Platform were still increasing in number.
From every corner of Golden Holy Mountain headquarters, even more streaks of light were rushing over, like streams flowing into a great river.
"We’re not too late. Faustus is still on the platform. I heard he already instantly killed Divine Sovereign Grade opponents of the same level!"
"That is already old news! He passed the Divine Lord Grade round too, and it was still an instant kill!"
"What he’s fighting next is Divine Descendant! Hurry, hurry! This is going to be the most exciting part!"
On the Sky Trial Platform,
Daniel gave the presiding officer a slight nod.
The presiding officer was momentarily stunned.
Since he had taken charge of this position, he had never seen such an "overreaching" request.
But after thinking it over, this was actually fine.
Since the challenger had raised the difficulty himself, he only needed to follow the procedure. There was no need to keep struggling between the two Oracle-grades.
He took a deep breath and activated the deepest layer of the trial platform’s formation.
Whoosh, whoosh—!
Ten figures with even more condensed auras stepped out from the void, like ten silent knights emerging from the mist.
Every one of them emitted the heavy pressure unique to Divine Descendants. Their bodies seemed to be draped in armor woven from rules.
Boom, boom, boom—!
Ten sage ranks unfolded at once, like ten dazzling stars rising from the horizon at the same time. The entire trial platform was enveloped in solemn, heavy pressure.
However, under the pressure of those ten layers, Daniel’s supreme sage rank remained motionless like a lighthouse forged from iron.
Even when facing ten times his own Divine Descendant power, it still did not bend.
A bright light ignited deep within Daniel’s pupils.
"Voidbound Grail!"
"Titan Body!"
"Immortal Icon!"
"Star Dome Shattering!"
"Sage rank reincarnation!"
"Celestial Grasp!"
The Voidbound Grail floated above the trial platform, its mouth facing downward. An invisible ring of Laws rippled outward.
When it touched the sage ranks of those Divine Descendant puppets, their domains all dimmed by several degrees.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
In an instant, ninety-nine figures appeared on the trial platform!

They stood shoulder to shoulder with Daniel’s true body, making a total of one hundred. Every clone emitted the same fierce aura as the original, like an army in perfect formation drawing its blades at the sound of a horn.
At the same time, Daniel’s Titan Body and Immortal Icon had also completed their enhancements.
All the clones suddenly expanded to hundreds of thousands of meters tall. The entire trial platform seemed cramped beneath their feet.

In the palms of every Daniel gathered the power of the two great Sacred Arts, Star Dome Shattering and Celestial Grasp. With the continuous enhancement of the supreme sage rank and the layered amplification of the Holy Grail’s power, that Strength had been pushed to a peak that made the scalps of the spectators go numb!
One hundred sky-covering giant palms rose at the same time, like meteors falling from a hundred directions!
Every ten giant palms locked onto one Divine Descendant Grade puppet. The pressure carrying stellar gravity and Law-crushing force arrived before the palms themselves!
Wherever the palm winds passed, the light of Law weavings was forcibly extinguished, and the phantoms of simulated Holy Relics shattered apart.
It was an unstoppable, magnificent force like Stellar bodies falling!
"Attack!"
The ten Divine Descendant puppets let out low roars at the same time.
Each of them activated Law weavings and simulated Holy Relics. Light interwove around them, forming rings of defense.
They sensed the terrifying Strength contained within Daniel’s Sacred Arts. Like beasts smelling the scent of their natural predator, they did not dare be careless in the slightest.
Boom, boom, boom—!

The giant palms descended. The Divine Descendant puppets were shaken so violently that their bodies swayed, and spiderweb-like cracks appeared on the surfaces formed by their Law weavings, like the marks left on porcelain after being struck by a heavy hammer.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Another wave of shocked cries erupted among the spectators.
"By the endless stars... the might of one palm actually damaged Divine Descendant puppets!"
"This has already exceeded the scope of my understanding. It is simply unbelievable!"
"No, seriously, is Faustus really human?"
"This is too absurd. I’m afraid even the bloodline talent of the Starbeast race would pale before Faustus!"
Buzz—!
A vast tide-like energy suddenly surged from the depths of Daniel’s supreme sage rank and poured entirely into Immortal Icon.

The bodies of the one hundred Daniels expanded again at the same time. Bones and meridians rose section by section within the light, and every Immortal Icon transformed into a Titan giant hundreds of thousands of meters tall, standing upon the trial platform like mountains.
They swung fists comparable to stars, smashing down onto the Divine Descendant puppets like a violent storm. Every strike carried a heavy roar that seemed capable of shattering the void.
Boom, boom, boom, boom, boom—!
Whenever a clone was destroyed, Daniel could quickly summon a complete replacement.
Infinite summoning.
Endless and inexhaustible, as though there would never be a moment of depletion.
Boom, boom, boom—!

Under Daniel’s relentless assault, the entire Sky Trial Platform trembled without end. The light of the formations flickered bright and dim, as though even those ancient restrictions could no longer bear the pressure.
"Divine Descendant Grade powerhouses do indeed master many transcendent Laws. They are somewhat troublesome."
Daniel’s eyes were sharp as he swiftly scanned the battlefield.
"But they are ultimately only virtual creations. And I have enough time to dismantle them piece by piece."
Under the continuous suppression of the Voidbound Grail, the Divine Descendant puppets could barely unleash sixty to seventy percent of their full Strength.

On Daniel’s side, the supreme sage rank continuously poured endless sage rank power into him. On top of that, the all-purpose greater Sacred Art, Star Dome Shattering, provided comprehensive amplification.
Even though he was only in the Divine Sovereign realm, he still firmly pressed those Divine Descendant Grade puppets down and beat them from above!
Punch after punch fell, heavy and powerful like a blacksmith hammering iron.
"Celestial Grasp!"
Daniel repeatedly unleashed this powerful Sacred Art. Every time the giant palm swept across the sky, it forced those puppets back several steps.
The cracks on their bodies grew more and more numerous. Their light became increasingly dim. They were being ground down inch by inch.
This battle was complete one-sided suppression!
Daniel firmly grasped the rhythm of the battlefield, like a precise chess match being pushed step by step toward its conclusion by his hand.
Victory was only a matter of time!
Sure enough, after only about ten minutes...
Boom—!
A sky-covering giant palm fell heavily, directly smashing one Divine Descendant Grade puppet in half. Law fragments exploded and scattered in every direction.
The first Divine Descendant was blasted into scraps!
After that, one after another...
The states of those Divine Descendant puppets had already been more or less the same. One after another, they shattered beneath the giant palms, like dying candles extinguished one by one in a storm.
Three, four...
Eight, nine!
When the final puppet cracked apart into light dust beneath the giant palm, only Daniel remained on the entire trial platform.
Fragments scattered across the ground reflected the lingering glow of the formations like shattered mirrors, illuminating his unmoving figure.
Unmatched!

chapters.title: Chapter 396 -396-The Holy Mountain Leader Appears and Sets the Tone
paragraphs: Ten Divine Descendant Grade trial puppets had been forcibly worn down and erased by Daniel, leaving only fragments of fading light scattered across the ground.
Among the watching powerhouses, waves of sharp inhales rose one after another.
"A Divine Sovereign fighting ten Divine Descendants, and he actually won!"
"Creator above, can someone tell me what I just saw wasn’t an illusion?"
"Compared to Faustus, the accumulation from my tens of thousands of years of cultivation is completely worthless!"
"I’m afraid it won’t be long before Faustus becomes the most terrifying existence beneath the threshold of Oracle-grade."
"When that time comes... the true show in this starsea may only just begin."
On the trial platform, fragments lay scattered everywhere.
Daniel stood at the center of that broken radiance, his expression calm.
He tilted his head slightly, his gaze passing through layer after layer of powerhouses before landing on Lucius’s livid face.
Lucius was a T7 great Oracle-grade, while he was merely a Divine Sovereign.
The difference in Rank between the two was like an entire starsea.
Yet now, there was not the slightest trace of fear in Daniel’s eyes. He remained calm and composed.
With such open provocation, Lucius still could not act out in public.
If this were somewhere private, he would naturally have a thousand methods to make this arrogant junior suffer.
But today, Chanelle was only a few steps away. His eyes were like two silent blades hanging at Lucius’s neck.
No matter how fiercely Lucius’s anger burned inside him, he could only swallow it down and allow Daniel’s provocation on the trial platform.
"Well?"
Daniel stared at Lucius.
There was no pride in his eyes, only a calmness that made others uncomfortable.
"Hmph!"
Lucius gave a cold snort, short and heavy.
Only then did Daniel turn his head, his gaze falling on the presiding officer.
The presiding officer quickly nodded.
The image of Daniel crushing ten Divine Descendant Grade puppets by himself had been deeply branded into the depths of his mind.
Right now, just being glanced at by Daniel made him feel uneasy from the bottom of his heart.
It was the instinctive awe that arose after witnessing absolute Strength.
"Congratulations, my lord, on passing the trial!"
He hurriedly responded.
"Then how will my treatment be arranged..."
Daniel raised his brow slightly.
The presiding officer was just about to speak, when suddenly—
Buzz—!
An aura descended abruptly from above the heavens, enveloping every living being present.
That aura was heavy and ancient, carrying a majesty that could not be blasphemed.
It was the aura of a top-tier great Oracle-grade—
T9 Oracle-grade!
Whoosh—!
A figure appeared silently in midair.
His skin was dark, and his features were simple and honest, like an old farmer who had worked in the fields for countless years.
If not for the Law power circulating around him in waves, anyone might have mistaken him for an ordinary old man by the roadside.
Where he stood, space twisted on its own, as though he existed between reality and illusion.
"Leader!"
Chanelle bowed, his posture respectful.
"Lord Leader!"
Lucius also hurriedly spoke.
"We greet the Leader!"
The many powerhouses gathered here all lowered their heads in unison, their voices rising and falling like waves.
Leader?
"So he is the current leader of Golden Holy Mountain?"
Daniel looked toward the old-farmer-like powerhouse, his gaze flickering slightly.
"T9 Oracle-grade... This should be a clone."
Daniel understood in his heart.
Almost every Oracle-grade possessed clones.

After all, advancing as an Oracle-grade required a length of time so vast it could drive one to despair. Without clones to handle various affairs and comprehend different Laws at the same time, it would be nearly impossible to manage everything.
Moreover, above the head of every Oracle-grade hung the blade known as the Holy Tribulation.
If they survived it, they could continue forward.
If they failed, they would be completely erased from the Time River, leaving not even the slightest remnant behind.
The terror of that tribulation was far beyond ordinary destruction.
Only an Eternal Sage could pay an enormous price to rescue and resurrect the deceased from the river. Yet the higher the Rank, the more terrifying the price of resurrection became.

To this day, Daniel had never heard of any Eternal Sage resurrecting a T9 Oracle-grade. From this, one could see just how great the price was—so great that even existences standing at the peak of the starsea could not casually endure it.
The leader’s appearance left many Golden Holy Mountain powerhouses both shocked and confused.
The leader rarely appeared in ordinary times, let alone personally descending upon a trial site.
Daniel frowned slightly as a thought surfaced in his heart.
"Could it be... he came for me?"
The leader’s gaze passed over the powerhouses and landed directly on Daniel.
Deep within those cloudy eyes, it was as though an entire starry sky had sunk there.
He slowly spoke, his voice hoarse and steady.
"Faustus..."
"Grant him quasi-Oracle-grade treatment."
Boom—!
The moment the leader’s words fell, undisguised joy appeared on Chanelle’s face.
In contrast, Lucius’s pupils abruptly shrank, and all color vanished from his face in an instant.
"Faustus... what right does he have?"
The bitterness and unwillingness in Lucius’s tone were almost impossible to conceal.
The watching powerhouses immediately erupted.
"Quasi-Oracle-grade treatment! By the endless stars... Faustus is only Divine Sovereign Grade!"
"A Divine Sovereign receiving quasi-Oracle-grade treatment? Since Golden Holy Mountain’s founding, there has probably never been such a precedent!"

"The leader personally descended and personally finalized Faustus’s treatment... This level of regard has far surpassed ordinary appreciation. He is probably paving a path to the heavens for Faustus!"
At that moment,
a voice transmission entered Daniel’s ears.
It was Chanelle’s voice, carrying unconcealable delight.
"Faustus, congratulations!"
For Daniel to obtain quasi-Oracle-grade treatment as a Divine Sovereign was a level higher than Chanelle’s original expectation.

More importantly, this decree had been personally issued by the leader of Golden Holy Mountain before everyone present. No matter how unwilling Lucius and his people were, they could not openly oppose it in the slightest.
Treatment personally granted by the leader was not merely a material advantage.
It was also an invisible edict, declaring to everyone present:
Faustus was a seed Golden Holy Mountain would cultivate with all its strength!
Faustus had broken a record and erected a milestone no one before him had ever touched.
With Divine Sovereign Grade strength, he had obtained quasi-Oracle-grade treatment!
Since the founding of Golden Holy Mountain, countless prodigies had emerged, yet never had anyone received such high treatment at such a low Rank!
But not a single member present felt unconvinced in their hearts.
Faustus had already proven through strength that he deserved it!
After announcing that command, the leader of Golden Holy Mountain slowly dissipated in midair.
Just like when he had descended, it was abrupt and without the slightest warning.
However, everyone present had long since grown accustomed to this.
What level of powerhouse was the leader of Golden Holy Mountain?
For him to personally descend for Faustus and personally set the tone with his own words—this action alone was enough to explain everything.
Faustus had already entered the view of those few pairs of eyes at the very top of Golden Holy Mountain.
And he had been placed in an extremely important position.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 -397-The Favor of a Great Oracle-grade
paragraphs: After the Leader departed, Chanelle finally turned unhurriedly toward the presiding officer.
"Did you hear clearly what the Leader just said?"
"I heard clearly."
At this moment, the presiding officer no longer felt the slightest pressure.
He only needed to follow procedure, and that "procedure" had been personally set by the Leader. No one would dare raise any objection now.
Golden Holy Mountain’s organizational structure had always emphasized rotation and balance.
The position of Leader rotated once every ten thousand years, with the leaders of the major internal factions taking turns assuming it, ensuring relative fairness and impartiality.
Once the Leader was chosen, he held the vast majority of the organization’s key authorities.
Therefore, within Golden Holy Mountain’s system, the Leader’s word was like law. It required no further review.
"Lord Faustus, please follow me."
The presiding officer tactfully opened a path down from the platform before Daniel.
Daniel followed him to complete the corresponding procedures: document filing, token replacement, authority registration...
Once the full process was completed, he had officially obtained quasi-Oracle-grade treatment.
Only then did he truly understand what this treatment actually meant.
"Golden Holy Mountain allocates ten million points every year!"
Daniel blinked.
He recalled that when he had received peak Divine-grade treatment, he had only received five hundred thousand points per year.
Now, that number had increased by a full twenty times!
How many resources could ten million points be exchanged for within Golden Holy Mountain’s system?
If calculated according to the exchange price of a standard Divine-grade puppet, it would be enough to buy one hundred thousand of them.
That was an army powerful enough to crush most small forces!
James and the others’ treatment was only three million points per year, equivalent to just one-third of Daniel’s.
From this alone, one could see just how weighty those ten million points were.
"Not bad."
Daniel smiled.
He possessed the Millionfold Boost system. Although he could not tamper with the points themselves, the resources exchanged with points could be enhanced in quality through the system.
What difference was that from multiplying the value of his points?

He often made bulk exchanges worth tens of billions of points, and there were still several tens of billions of points sitting unused in his account. These ten million points were merely a drop in the bucket.
However, some authorities were things that points could not buy.
"Unlimited access to Oracle-grade lectures in the Ivahpin World..."
When Daniel saw this line, his eyes immediately lit up.

This privilege was extremely precious. Previously, he had not even been able to knock on the door of Oracle-grade lectures. As it turned out, that was an area only unlocked by quasi-Oracle-grade authority, and with unlimited access at that!
This meant that as long as an Oracle-grade was giving a lecture or sharing cultivation insights, he could sit below and listen at any time.
"This will make it much more convenient for me to farm divine energy."
Daniel thought to himself.
The divine energy he obtained could be enhanced through the Millionfold Boost system. In essence, it was an endless source of divine energy production.
This privilege alone already made the treatment more than worth it.
"Second-floor authority for the [Treasure Vault] has been unlocked. Points may be used to exchange for even more supreme Divine-grade materials."

"Second-floor authority for the [Sanctuary of Ten Thousand Laws] has been unlocked. Points may be used to exchange for even more supreme Law Sacred Arts. Those are the essence of Golden Holy Mountain’s countless years of accumulation."
"Mission bounty authority has also been upgraded. High-grade missions with rewards below five billion points may now be accepted."
"His residence in the gold-grade sacred realm has also been changed to a more luxurious one."
The gold-grade token in Daniel’s hand had been replaced with a brand-new token, and all the authority attached to it had been fully upgraded as well.
He lowered his head and looked at the new token in his hand.
[Gold-grade Token (Rare)]
Owner: Faustus
Authority: Quasi-Oracle-grade
Privileges:
Possesses an exclusive mansion within the gold-grade sacred realm, built to quasi-Oracle-grade specifications.
All four categories of Golden Holy Mountain territories—[Sacred Lands], [Perilous Lands], [Forbidden Lands], and [Secret Realms]—may be entered freely without separate application.

For the above four categories of territories under Golden Holy Mountain’s jurisdiction, residency may be applied for directly. The free period is five hundred years. After the period expires, points may be spent to extend the stay, up to a maximum of ten thousand years.
May receive urgent intelligence released by Golden Holy Mountain immediately, without needing to spend points on a subscription.
May directly contact any powerhouse within Golden Holy Mountain below T9 Oracle-grade without spending points.
Current faction influence range: Visca Galaxy.
Note: The gold-grade token is the identity symbol of a formal member of Golden Holy Mountain. This token is divided into several ranks, with authority increasing step by step according to Rank.
"The authority of the gold-grade token has changed quite a bit."
Daniel examined each line thoughtfully.

"The free residency period and maximum limit for the four types of territories have both increased tenfold. The fourth privilege has changed from requiring a point subscription to being free. The fifth privilege has been raised from a limit of T8 Oracle-grade to T9 Oracle-grade... These are all upgrades brought by quasi-Oracle-grade treatment."
Daniel, James, and the others had all obtained results matching their respective strength, and they were all rather satisfied.
However, at that moment, Chanelle signaled for Daniel to stay behind alone.
Daniel’s thoughts shifted slightly.
"Lord Chanelle must have another important matter to discuss with me."
Daniel had always had an excellent impression of Chanelle.

Back when he had been trapped in the Chaosverse and his puppet clone had acted outside for a long period of time, the grudges he had created through his mad plundering had all been secretly blocked by Chanelle’s faction.
After everyone else dispersed, Chanelle walked up to Daniel and spoke with a smile.
"Faustus."
His eyes carried deep appreciation.
"When I first met you, I felt that you were different from others."
"Later, you won enormous benefits for the Canaan Starfield. I was willing to apply for you to become a formal member and made an exception to grant you peak Divine-grade treatment."
"And your growth and potential along this path have not disappointed my judgment."
Chanelle nodded slightly.
"You have done very well."
Daniel listened quietly and did not rush to respond.
He knew that Chanelle’s words were only a prelude. The true subject was still to come.
Sure enough, Chanelle’s expression became slightly more restrained, and his tone also grew heavier.
"Faustus."
He paused, his gaze resting on Daniel’s face for a breath.
"The one I rely on behind me is a T9 Oracle-grade—Lord Fulvius."

"Lord Fulvius is one of the members of Golden Holy Mountain’s core council. His strength is unfathomable, and among the T9 Oracle-grades of the Myriad-Star Cosmos, he is also one of the most powerful existences."
When Chanelle spoke this name, the respect in his eyes came from the heart.
"Just now, Lord Fulvius sent me a message and asked me to pass it on to you—he is willing to offer you some assistance in the capacity of a Wayfarer."
Daniel’s heart tightened.
So he had already drawn the attention of Golden Holy Mountain’s highest level.
The Leader personally appearing had only been the first curtain rising.
Behind the scenes, the great figures of the core council had actually been watching his every move from the shadows all along.
As a member of the core council, Great Oracle-grade Fulvius could not openly break the existing system and raise Daniel’s treatment further through official channels.
So he would extend a hand in his personal capacity.
This private conversation with Chanelle was precisely under the instruction of Great Oracle-grade Fulvius!

"Did you hear clearly what the Leader just said?"
"I heard clearly."
At this moment, the presiding officer no longer felt the slightest pressure.
He only needed to follow procedure, and that "procedure" had been personally set by the Leader.
No one would dare raise any objection now.
Golden Holy Mountain’s organizational structure had always emphasized rotation and balance.
The position of Leader rotated once every ten thousand years, with the leaders of the major internal factions taking turns assuming it, ensuring relative fairness and impartiality.
Once the Leader was chosen, he held the vast majority of the organization’s key authorities.
Therefore, within Golden Holy Mountain’s system, the Leader’s word was like law.
It required no further review.
"Lord Faustus, please follow me."
The presiding officer tactfully opened a path down from the platform before Daniel.
Daniel followed him to complete the corresponding procedures: document filing, token replacement, authority registration...
Once the full process was completed, he had officially obtained quasi-Oracle-grade treatment.
Only then did he truly understand what this treatment actually meant.
"Golden Holy Mountain allocates ten million points every year!"
Daniel blinked.
He recalled that when he had received peak Divine-grade treatment, he had only received five hundred thousand points per year.
Now, that number had increased by a full twenty times!
How many resources could ten million points be exchanged for within Golden Holy Mountain’s system?
If calculated according to the exchange price of a standard Divine-grade puppet, it would be enough to buy one hundred thousand of them.
That was an army powerful enough to crush most small forces!
James and the others’ treatment was only three million points per year, equivalent to just one-third of Daniel’s.
From this alone, one could see just how weighty those ten million points were.
"Not bad."
Daniel smiled.
He possessed the Millionfold Boost system.
Although he could not tamper with the points themselves, the resources exchanged with points could be enhanced in quality through the system.
What difference was that from multiplying the value of his points?
He often made bulk exchanges worth tens of billions of points, and there were still several tens of billions of points sitting unused in his account.
These ten million points were merely a drop in the bucket.
However, some authorities were things that points could not buy.
"Unlimited access to Oracle-grade lectures in the Ivahpin World..."
When Daniel saw this line, his eyes immediately lit up.
This privilege was extremely precious.
Previously, he had not even been able to knock on the door of Oracle-grade lectures.
As it turned out, that was an area only unlocked by quasi-Oracle-grade authority, and with unlimited access at that!
This meant that as long as an Oracle-grade was giving a lecture or sharing cultivation insights, he could sit below and listen at any time.
"This will make it much more convenient for me to farm divine energy."
Daniel thought to himself.
The divine energy he obtained could be enhanced through the Millionfold Boost system.
In essence, it was an endless source of divine energy production.
This privilege alone already made the treatment more than worth it.
"Second-floor authority for the [Treasure Vault] has been unlocked.
Points may be used to exchange for even more supreme Divine-grade materials."
"Second-floor authority for the [Sanctuary of Ten Thousand Laws] has been unlocked.
Points may be used to exchange for even more supreme Law Sacred Arts.
Those are the essence of Golden Holy Mountain’s countless years of accumulation."
"Mission bounty authority has also been upgraded.
High-grade missions with rewards below five billion points may now be accepted."
"His residence in the gold-grade sacred realm has also been changed to a more luxurious one."
The gold-grade token in Daniel’s hand had been replaced with a brand-new token, and all the authority attached to it had been fully upgraded as well.
He lowered his head and looked at the new token in his hand.
[Gold-grade Token (Rare)]
Owner: Faustus
Authority: Quasi-Oracle-grade
Privileges:
Possesses an exclusive mansion within the gold-grade sacred realm, built to quasi-Oracle-grade specifications.
All four categories of Golden Holy Mountain territories—[Sacred Lands], [Perilous Lands], [Forbidden Lands], and [Secret Realms]—may be entered freely without separate application.
For the above four categories of territories under Golden Holy Mountain’s jurisdiction, residency may be applied for directly.
The free period is five hundred years.
After the period expires, points may be spent to extend the stay, up to a maximum of ten thousand years.
May receive urgent intelligence released by Golden Holy Mountain immediately, without needing to spend points on a subscription.
May directly contact any powerhouse within Golden Holy Mountain below T9 Oracle-grade without spending points.
Current faction influence range: Visca Galaxy.
Note: The gold-grade token is the identity symbol of a formal member of Golden Holy Mountain.
This token is divided into several ranks, with authority increasing step by step according to Rank.
"The authority of the gold-grade token has changed quite a bit."
Daniel examined each line thoughtfully.
"The free residency period and maximum limit for the four types of territories have both increased tenfold.
The fourth privilege has changed from requiring a point subscription to being free.
The fifth privilege has been raised from a limit of T8 Oracle-grade to T9 Oracle-grade...
These are all upgrades brought by quasi-Oracle-grade treatment."

chapters.title: Chapter 398 -398-Choosing Sides, Gadir Forbidden Land
paragraphs: "You possess a rare kind of presence."
Chanelle looked at Daniel with undisguised admiration in his eyes.
"You’ve crushed every opponent in your path, never tasting defeat."
"That kind of momentum is an indispensable foundation for becoming a truly powerful Oracle-grade."
"That is why everyone within the Golden Holy Mountain holds exceptionally high expectations for you."
He paused briefly before lowering his voice.
"But you must understand that the Golden Holy Mountain is far from united."
"Its internal factions are deeply intertwined, each pursuing its own ambitions."
"Lord Fulvius’ faction is currently the strongest contender in the upcoming struggle for leadership. He hopes you’ll stand on his side."
Chanelle’s gaze was calm yet profound.
The position of leader of the Golden Holy Mountain was never held permanently by a single powerhouse. Instead, it followed an ancient and meticulously maintained cycle of succession.
Every ten thousand years, authority would pass to a new ruler.

Over the endless ages, the various factions had constantly competed, negotiated, and forged alliances. Whoever earned the broadest support would gain the right to sit upon the throne overlooking the entire Holy Mountain.
Among the candidates for the next succession, the Great Oracle-grade Fulvius was undeniably the favorite.
He had also set his sights on Daniel, investing far more than simple admiration in him.
Daniel gave a slight nod, immediately understanding the implication.
"What gift has Lord Fulvius prepared for me?"
"A gift..."
A knowing smile spread across Chanelle’s lips.
"Lord Fulvius has prepared two gifts for you."
"The first consists of three Oracle-grade treasures."
As he spoke, he turned over his palm.
Three radiant treasures materialized out of thin air, resting quietly in his hand like three stars plucked from the heavens.
Each emitted an aura so overwhelming that Daniel could sense the immense power sleeping within them even from several steps away.
"Each of these serves a different purpose."
Chanelle pointed to them one by one.
"The blue one should look familiar. It’s the same type as the little sword gifted to you before—a T7 Oracle-grade full-power attack treasure designed purely for offense."
"The black one is a defensive treasure. Its protective barrier is powerful enough to withstand attacks from a T8 Oracle-grade."
"As for the red one, it’s a spatial escape treasure forged by a T9 Oracle-grade. Should you ever find yourself in a hopeless situation, it can tear open space itself and carry you to safety."
The blue treasure specialized in offense and was worth one hundred billion contribution points.
The black treasure specialized in defense and was worth just as much.
The red treasure was a final lifesaving trump card, valued at several hundred billion contribution points.
Together, the three treasures represented wealth worth several hundred billion points.
Any one of them, by itself, would be sufficient to become the ancestral treasure of an entire faction for countless generations.
The red treasure, in particular, was nothing less than a final chance at survival in the face of certain death.
There was no need to question the sincerity behind Lord Fulvius’ generosity.
Oracle-grade treasures were never things that could be forged casually. Every single one required immense time, painstaking craftsmanship, and precious resources.
Because of the tremendous difficulty involved in creating them, only a handful existed throughout the universe.
Daniel calmly stored all three treasures away.
He then looked back at Chanelle, waiting for the second gift.
Chanelle didn’t keep him waiting.
Slowly, he opened his other hand.
Resting in his palm was a small jade token.
It was smooth and flawless, its surface shimmering with an unusual radiance.
"This is an entry token for the Gadir Forbidden Land."
Chanelle’s expression became noticeably more serious.

"This item cannot be bought at any price. Even if you possessed billions upon billions of contribution points, you still wouldn’t be able to purchase one on the market. Its value is beyond imagination."
"Gadir Forbidden Land?"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
"What kind of place is that?"
"The Gadir Forbidden Land is one of several great forbidden regions jointly controlled by the Golden Holy Mountain and several other starfield powers."
Chanelle continued,
"It came into existence after the death of a T8 Oracle-grade. The remnants of that being’s Laws and universal truths naturally evolved into this forbidden realm."
"If fortune smiles upon you, you may discover that ancient powerhouse’s inheritance, Divine-grade treasures, or even high-grade Law Sacred Arts."
"Any one of those opportunities is enough to completely transform whoever obtains it."
"Even I intend to enter the Forbidden Land to comprehend the residual will of the T8 Oracle-grade’s Laws."
"To a T7 Oracle-grade, a T8 Oracle-grade is as the heavens are to the earth. The gap between them is simply too vast to bridge through cultivation alone."
"The token Lord Fulvius has given you opens the gate to that forbidden realm."
"As long as you possess this jade token, you’ll be qualified to enter."
"So that’s how it is."
Daniel nodded in understanding.
The Gadir Forbidden Land was actually the resting place of a fallen T8 Oracle-grade.
After the powerhouse’s death, the universe itself had transformed the remains into a massive forbidden domain.
Numerous starfield powers jointly occupied the region, while countless Oracle-grades flocked there in search of unimaginable opportunities.
"And it even contains an Oracle-grade inheritance..."
Daniel’s heart stirred slightly.
How many experts had completely changed their destinies after obtaining a complete inheritance?
The true value of this gift lay in its irreplaceability.
No amount of contribution points could buy such a token.
It was obvious that the Great Oracle-grade Fulvius genuinely regarded Daniel as a young sapling worthy of careful cultivation.
Daniel solemnly stored the jade token away.
Seeing him accept it, Chanelle’s smile widened.
"The Gadir Forbidden Land only opens once every ten thousand years. The next opening is still nineteen hundred years away, so there’s no need to rush."
Daniel nodded.
"When the time comes, simply activate the jade token, and you’ll automatically be guided into the Forbidden Land."
"I’ll be entering as well."
"If you run into any serious trouble, I’ll watch over you."
Daniel silently calculated the timeline.
He still had the quest[Chaos Starfire]to complete.
It required two objectives.
First, cultivate ten million quasi-Divine-grade players.
Second, conquer an entire star system within the Chaosverse.
Both objectives were still progressing, and neither would be completed anytime soon.
Since the Gadir Forbidden Land would not open for another eighteen hundred years, the timing was perfect.
It gave him more than enough time to finish those missions.
After offering Daniel a few more words of encouragement, Chanelle disappeared between the towering pillars.
Daniel stood there in thought before turning his attention back to the several hundred billion contribution points now at his disposal.
It was finally time to convert them into tangible strength.
The player population had grown to an astonishing scale.
Fortunately, thanks to his Millionfold Boost System, contribution points had never been in short supply, allowing him to exchange enough resources to equip an entire battlefield.
"I need to stockpile plenty of Sage-rank Templates for the players who’ll eventually break through to Divine-grade."
"I also need a large quantity of Divine-grade materials for the crafting professions to raise their skill levels."
"The strongest players have already reached the quasi-Divine-grade threshold, although there are only a few hundred of them so far."
"But the mainstream player base has already advanced entirely into the Supreme-grade..."
Throughout these endless years, Daniel’s puppet avatar had continuously coordinated the development of the player civilization.
Every piece on the board was firmly under his control.
At present, several hundred elite players had already reached the quasi-Divine-grade realm.
Meanwhile, the mainstream player population had surpassed three billion.
It was an overwhelming tide that no force could afford to ignore.
One of the greatest strengths of the Magitech system was its ability to allow ordinary players to wield combat power beyond their actual Rank.
It maximized the advantage of overwhelming numbers, transforming sheer population into genuine military strength and allowing countless players to keep pace with the rapidly advancing era.
Especially after the great war that had engulfed and absorbed innumerable small worlds, the players had been tempered in the fires of real combat.
They were no longer the confused newcomers they had once been.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 -399-A Legacy Faction, Triumph Academy
paragraphs: "Ten million quasi-Sages... that goal isn’t nearly as unattainable as it sounds."
Daniel possessed an enormous reserve of contribution points, which meant he also held limitless possibilities in his hands.
He could simply exchange them for special trial artifacts like the [Phantom Emporium], continuously generating the exact training opponents the players currently needed.
He first exchanged his points for one hundred quasi-Divine-grade Trial Grounds. After that, he purchased vast quantities of Sage-rank Templates, treasures, crafting materials, and Sacred Arts.
Entry-level Divine-grade treasures were perfectly suited for Supreme-grade players, while the burden imposed by those Sacred Arts remained within what they could withstand.
Daniel wasn’t intentionally restricting the players’ growth.
It was simply that higher-tier Sacred Arts were far beyond what the current player base could possibly master.
Steady, gradual progress was the wiser path.
His several hundred billion contribution points dwindled rapidly until only around one hundred billion remained. Only then did Daniel finally stop.
This journey to the Golden Holy Mountain had yielded tremendous rewards for every member of their group.
Both James and Mosi had successfully become official members, enjoying benefits that were worlds apart from what they had received before.
As for Daniel, he had obtained a privilege unprecedented in the entire history of the Golden Holy Mountain.
Just then, James and Mosi walked over with cheerful smiles.
Having only recently completed their promotion, both of them were in exceptionally good spirits.
"I heard Boss Faustus has built quite an empire in the Visca Galaxy."
James raised an eyebrow.
"Aren’t you planning to take us there so we can see it for ourselves?"
Mosi nodded.
"I’m in."
Looking at their eager expressions, Daniel couldn’t help but smile.
"If you’re both interested, then let’s head there together."
Deep within the Visca Galaxy.
The Aerial Realm floated quietly at the heart of the surrounding starfield.
After years of continuous nourishment and cultivation, the world had officially advanced into a Large Life World.
Its vast lands were now capable of supporting even beings above the peak of the Divine-grade.
Meanwhile, both Earth and Aetheria had successfully advanced into Medium Life Worlds.
Throughout all these years, Daniel’s puppet avatar had never stopped nurturing these three core worlds.
The trunk of the World Tree remained deeply rooted within the soil of the Aerial Realm.
Through its countless branches and roots, Daniel continuously extended its life force toward Earth and Aetheria, gradually elevating both worlds to ever higher levels.
Meanwhile, his true body possessed an endless supply of contribution points, ensuring that the Holy Relics and materials required to upgrade the World Tree had never once run short.
As a result, the Aerial Realm had rapidly ascended into the ranks of Large Life Worlds.
However, for the sake of Earth’s and Aetheria’s safety, Daniel had no intention of upgrading either world into a Large Life World before he himself reached the Oracle-grade.
A Medium Life World was already more than sufficient for their inhabitants to continue growing.
Daniel and his companions descended onto the land of the Aerial Realm.
As James and Mosi sensed the world’s vibrant vitality and unfamiliar atmosphere, they couldn’t help feeling somewhat surprised.
They had visited worlds thousands of times more magnificent than the Aerial Realm.
Yet the Arcane Machinery flourishing throughout this world was something neither of them had ever encountered before.
Even more importantly...
They could clearly feel that this world was rising with unstoppable momentum, overflowing with vitality and hope.
Daniel turned toward them.
"I intend to establish a legacy faction."
His voice was calm and resolute.
"Are you willing to help me?"
"A legacy faction?"
James’ eyes lit up.
That wasn’t some makeshift organization created by hanging up a fancy signboard.
It was a true institution dedicated to preserving knowledge and passing down a legacy from one generation to the next.
"Of course."
Mosi’s answer remained as concise as ever.
"I’d be honored."
James spread his hands with a grin.
"Who knows? Maybe I’ll even get to be your second-in-command."
"Haha..."
Daniel nodded slightly.
This idea had been brewing in his mind for a very long time.
In fact...
This was merely the opening move of an even greater plan.
"I’m not originally from the human race of Aetheria."
He spoke slowly.
"I come from Earth."
"My true homeland."
"The place where my entire journey began."
"My goal is to restore the honor of Earth’s human race and establish a human faction that truly belongs to our homeworld."
He paused.
"But I haven’t reached the Oracle-grade yet."
"Announcing ourselves to the entire universe now would carry far too much risk."
"So first, I’ll establish a legacy faction."
"Once I become an Oracle-grade..."
"I’ll officially raise Earth’s banner before the countless races of the cosmos."
Within the Endless Starsea, strength had always been the only authority that mattered.
Even an Oracle-grade rarely dared establish an independent faction casually.
In the eyes of the Great Oracle-grades and the Eternal Sages...
What was a mere Oracle-grade?
As for Daniel...
He hadn’t even crossed that threshold yet.
However, founding a legacy faction was already well within his capabilities.
His voice spread outward, passing through the clouds and sweeping across every corner of the Visca Galaxy.
"Hear my proclamation, all beings across the countless worlds!"
"I, Faustus, shall preserve the light of Earth’s human race and hereby establish the Triumph Academy!"
"Any powerhouse under my rule who reaches the Supreme-grade shall be eligible to join the Academy!"
His voice echoed into every ear.
It swept across countless citizens who were hunting monsters, leveling up, forging equipment, or simply chatting with friends.
Inside a bustling city.
A tavern glowed warmly beneath dim lantern light.
Several men sat around a round table, casually drinking as they chatted about equipment upgrades and the latest dungeon runs.
Their conversation was at its liveliest when—
A voice suddenly descended from the heavens without the slightest warning.
"Hear my proclamation, all beings across the countless worlds!"
"I, Faustus, shall preserve the light of Earth’s human race and hereby establish the Triumph Academy!"
"Any powerhouse under my command who reaches the Supreme-grade may join the Academy and work together to strengthen Earth’s human race!"
In that instant...
Every laugh, every conversation, every sound inside the tavern vanished.
The men stared blankly at one another.
Shock.
Confusion.
Then overwhelming excitement.
Crash!
A wine glass slipped from someone’s hand and shattered across the floor.
"Boss Faustus is founding another faction?!"
"Supreme-grade?! We all qualify!"
"A legacy faction dedicated to Earth’s civilization? Then there’s no way we’re missing this!"
"Holy shit! If we miss an opportunity like this, we’ll probably have to wait until our next life!"
"...Come on! Let’s go see what’s happening!"
Before anyone finished speaking, the once-crowded tavern emptied within only a few breaths.
The tavern door continued swinging back and forth.
The food on the tables was still steaming.
Yet every single customer had already rushed toward the Aerial Realm.
At the very same moment.
Players from every world throughout the Visca Galaxy began converging from all directions.
Without exception, everyone abandoned whatever they had been doing and headed straight for the Aerial Realm.
"Damn! Back when Stellar first launched, I missed my chance to join Boss Faustus’ guild and lost out on so many opportunities. Nobody’s stopping me this time!"
"A legacy faction for the entire human race of Earth..."
"That’s one hell of an ambitious plan."
"I’m getting into the Triumph Academy no matter what!"
Among the endless streams of people were countless native inhabitants as well.
Many veteran experts from Carodion had also come.
As members of the human race, they naturally qualified to enter the Academy.
From the very beginning, Daniel had never intended to exclude the native inhabitants.
Their population was unimaginably vast.
More importantly...
They shared the same ancestry.
And in the future, once Earth’s human race truly rose to prominence...
Daniel intended to bring not only them—
But perhaps the entire human race of the Myriad-Star Cosmos beneath the same banner.

sentences.text: "Ten million quasi-Sages... that goal isn’t nearly as unattainable as it sounds."
Daniel possessed an enormous reserve of contribution points, which meant he also held limitless possibilities in his hands.
He could simply exchange them for special trial artifacts like the [Phantom Emporium], continuously generating the exact training opponents the players currently needed.
He first exchanged his points for one hundred quasi-Divine-grade Trial Grounds.
After that, he purchased vast quantities of Sage-rank Templates, treasures, crafting materials, and Sacred Arts.
Entry-level Divine-grade treasures were perfectly suited for Supreme-grade players, while the burden imposed by those Sacred Arts remained within what they could withstand.
Daniel wasn’t intentionally restricting the players’ growth.
It was simply that higher-tier Sacred Arts were far beyond what the current player base could possibly master.
Steady, gradual progress was the wiser path.
His several hundred billion contribution points dwindled rapidly until only around one hundred billion remained.
Only then did Daniel finally stop.
This journey to the Golden Holy Mountain had yielded tremendous rewards for every member of their group.
Both James and Mosi had successfully become official members, enjoying benefits that were worlds apart from what they had received before.
As for Daniel, he had obtained a privilege unprecedented in the entire history of the Golden Holy Mountain.
Just then, James and Mosi walked over with cheerful smiles.
Having only recently completed their promotion, both of them were in exceptionally good spirits.
"I heard Boss Faustus has built quite an empire in the Visca Galaxy."
James raised an eyebrow.
"Aren’t you planning to take us there so we can see it for ourselves?"
Mosi nodded.
"I’m in."
Looking at their eager expressions, Daniel couldn’t help but smile.
"If you’re both interested, then let’s head there together."
Deep within the Visca Galaxy.
The Aerial Realm floated quietly at the heart of the surrounding starfield.
After years of continuous nourishment and cultivation, the world had officially advanced into a Large Life World.
Its vast lands were now capable of supporting even beings above the peak of the Divine-grade.
Meanwhile, both Earth and Aetheria had successfully advanced into Medium Life Worlds.
Throughout all these years, Daniel’s puppet avatar had never stopped nurturing these three core worlds.
The trunk of the World Tree remained deeply rooted within the soil of the Aerial Realm.
Through its countless branches and roots, Daniel continuously extended its life force toward Earth and Aetheria, gradually elevating both worlds to ever higher levels.
Meanwhile, his true body possessed an endless supply of contribution points, ensuring that the Holy Relics and materials required to upgrade the World Tree had never once run short.
As a result, the Aerial Realm had rapidly ascended into the ranks of Large Life Worlds.
However, for the sake of Earth’s and Aetheria’s safety, Daniel had no intention of upgrading either world into a Large Life World before he himself reached the Oracle-grade.
A Medium Life World was already more than sufficient for their inhabitants to continue growing.
Daniel and his companions descended onto the land of the Aerial Realm.
As James and Mosi sensed the world’s vibrant vitality and unfamiliar atmosphere, they couldn’t help feeling somewhat surprised.
They had visited worlds thousands of times more magnificent than the Aerial Realm.
Yet the Arcane Machinery flourishing throughout this world was something neither of them had ever encountered before.
Even more importantly...
They could clearly feel that this world was rising with unstoppable momentum, overflowing with vitality and hope.
Daniel turned toward them.
"I intend to establish a legacy faction."
His voice was calm and resolute.
"Are you willing to help me?"
"A legacy faction?"
James’ eyes lit up.
That wasn’t some makeshift organization created by hanging up a fancy signboard.
It was a true institution dedicated to preserving knowledge and passing down a legacy from one generation to the next.
"Of course."
Mosi’s answer remained as concise as ever.
"I’d be honored."
James spread his hands with a grin.
"Who knows?
Maybe I’ll even get to be your second-in-command."
"Haha..."
Daniel nodded slightly.
This idea had been brewing in his mind for a very long time.
In fact...
This was merely the opening move of an even greater plan.
"I’m not originally from the human race of Aetheria."
He spoke slowly.
"I come from Earth."
"My true homeland."
"The place where my entire journey began."
"My goal is to restore the honor of Earth’s human race and establish a human faction that truly belongs to our homeworld."
He paused.
"But I haven’t reached the Oracle-grade yet."
"Announcing ourselves to the entire universe now would carry far too much risk."
"So first, I’ll establish a legacy faction."
"Once I become an Oracle-grade..."
"I’ll officially raise Earth’s banner before the countless races of the cosmos."
Within the Endless Starsea, strength had always been the only authority that mattered.
Even an Oracle-grade rarely dared establish an independent faction casually.
In the eyes of the Great Oracle-grades and the Eternal Sages...
What was a mere Oracle-grade?
As for Daniel...
He hadn’t even crossed that threshold yet.
However, founding a legacy faction was already well within his capabilities.
His voice spread outward, passing through the clouds and sweeping across every corner of the Visca Galaxy.

His voice echoed into every ear.
